18.titleEn: Box Furnace or Muffle Furnace? Six Checks for Industrial Selection
18.summaryEn: Compare the actual heating structure, material, temperature, loading, acceptance conditions and supply scope.
18.contentEn:
The terms box furnace and muffle furnace can overlap between manufacturers and applications. “Box furnace” usually describes the chamber and loading arrangement; a muffle emphasizes separation of the heating chamber from the heat source or combustion products. Modern equipment does not always fit traditional names. A name alone cannot establish size, temperature limits or whether a separate muffle is fitted.

Suneng's protective-atmosphere muffle mesh-belt furnace documents include both a heat-resistant steel retort and mesh-belt conveying. Muffle and mesh belt can therefore describe different structural features of the same machine. When a quotation says muffle furnace, request a section or arrangement drawing showing the heating chamber, retort, heat source and loading path. Compare the actual structures, and specify retort leak testing separately from workpiece surface-quality inspection.

1. Actual structure: how are the chamber and heat source arranged?

Compare the chamber, muffle or separation layer, heating elements, door and loading passage. Use drawings for the particular model to determine whether heating is by direct radiation, an isolated heat source or circulation. A separation layer can isolate certain contamination sources but does not automatically ensure contamination-free samples under every operating condition.

2. Material and process: define the treatment objective

Sample analysis, sintering and metal heat treatment have different atmosphere, temperature, loading and exhaust requirements. Annealing, normalizing, heating before quenching, tempering and solution treatment cannot share one parameter set. Where quenching is required, confirm transfer after unloading, cooling equipment and subsequent operations. One heating furnace is not a complete heat-treatment system.

3. Operating temperature: separate maximum and continuous-use ratings

Both names cover products with different temperature ratings. Check continuous operating temperature, short-term maximum temperature, heating rate, atmosphere and loading separately, together with the heating elements, lining, supports and seals. One model’s temperature range does not define the limit of all box or muffle furnaces.

4. Loading and cycle: weight does not directly determine chamber volume

Workpiece shape, rack dimensions, spacing, support and thermal load jointly determine the effective working zone. Thin plates, long shafts and densely stacked parts of the same total weight may require different space and heating times. Calculate capacity from the loading arrangement and complete batch cycle; there is no universal kilograms-to-litres selection rule.

5. Temperature and quality acceptance: define the measurement scope

Agree the effective heating zone, test temperature, empty or loaded condition, sensor layout, stabilization time and acceptance criteria. There is no universal “industry ±10°C standard” for every industrial box furnace. A claim of “±5°C throughout the chamber” cannot replace a specific test result. Furnace-temperature compliance, workpiece temperature and product properties require separate verification.

AMS2750 specifies pyrometry requirements for equipment used in the thermal processing of metallic materials; CQI-9 is an automotive heat-treatment system assessment. Evaluate measurement, control, recording and calibration against the project’s applicable requirements. A configuration description is not a general certification. Conformity depends on the applicable edition, actual system and relevant assessment or test evidence.

6. Supply and cost: compare equivalent scope

Specify the effective working zone, load capacity, heat source, atmosphere, controls and records, handling, associated cooling, installation, commissioning and acceptance. Equipment price, running cost, maintenance intervals and service life depend on configuration and operating conditions; the equipment name cannot support a universal price or imported-equipment price ratio.

Founded in 2006, Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. assesses box furnaces and related equipment against the workpiece, material, process curve, load, site conditions and acceptance requirements. Dimensions, performance, delivery and service scope are governed by the confirmed technical proposal and contract.

Related public sources: SAE AMS2750H: Pyrometry. Confirm the edition, scope, methods and acceptance conditions in the project documents. Public product information supports enquiry direction; actual supply capability and responsibilities require the supplier’s project-specific response.

17.titleEn: What Can Industrial Furnace Automation Control? Temperature, Records and Acceptance
17.summaryEn: Define the control functions and measurement coverage, then verify furnace conditions and product results separately.
17.contentEn:
Control proposals for trolley furnaces, continuous-conveyor furnaces, box furnaces and copper-wire annealing lines should start with workpiece and process requirements. Define temperature control, conveying, recording and interlock functions separately.

One Suneng mesh-belt line document specifies operating-status displays, storage and retrieval of temperature parameters, and export of process data and charts as separate functions. Seeing information on a screen and retrieving it later therefore need separate checks. If the supplier provides only a screenshot, request an export sample for the required period and check whether it can be linked to the process being assessed. The listed functions do not prove that complete traceability has been connected.

Assess the workpiece material, load, temperature profile, cooling method and cycle. Zoned heating, temperature monitoring and feed control execute the confirmed process; they do not replace temperature-uniformity surveys or product-property testing.

Depending on the configuration, production records can include furnace-temperature curves, equipment states, alarms and workpiece or batch identifiers. Traceability also requires defined measurement objects, acquisition points, recording intervals, identifier relationships and storage arrangements.

An equipment demonstration and acceptance under actual production conditions are different. Verify capacity, energy use per unit of product and quality improvements against records for specified materials, loads and operating conditions. A single demonstration or a general assessment is not a substitute for measured results.

16.titleEn: Matching Trolley, Continuous-Conveyor and Rotary Hearth Furnaces to the Workpiece
16.summaryEn: Compare workpiece form, handling, heat transfer, control and downstream cooling rather than relying on the furnace name.
16.contentEn:
Trolley furnaces, continuous-conveyor furnaces and rotary hearth furnaces have different structures. Assess each proposal against workpiece form, loading and unloading, heat transfer and temperature control, and downstream cooling requirements.

Suneng roller-hearth quench-furnace documents distinguish in-furnace conveying from rapid discharge, while trolley-furnace documents organize work around batch loading on a trolley. First establish whether the project requires individual workpieces to pass through and transfer at the outlet, or complete batches to be loaded and unloaded. If the supplier provides only chamber dimensions, request a workpiece movement diagram and process-time schedule. Similar furnace names or temperatures cannot replace those comparisons.

In a conventional batch trolley furnace, trolley movement primarily handles entry, exit and transfer for loading and unloading. Uniformity during heating and holding depends on heat-source layout, suitable circulation, zoned control and the loading arrangement. A special moving-heating design must be identified separately; ordinary trolley speed is not a guarantee of uniform heating.

For continuous-conveyor equipment, distinguish uncoiled strip, individual plates and discrete parts before checking roller, mesh-belt or tray support. For a rotary hearth, assess the usable loading annulus, supports, handling and dwell time. Rotation alone does not ensure consistent heat treatment of every large workpiece.

Temperature curves, workpiece or batch identifiers and operating alarms can support process checks, within the coverage of the actual controls and sensors. Verify furnace temperature, workpiece temperature and product properties separately. Efficiency and energy-saving conclusions require operating data from comparable conditions.

15.titleEn: Which Workpieces Suit a Rotary Hearth Furnace? Check Support and Process Residence Time
15.summaryEn: Match the effective loading area, workpiece support, residence time and handling with the actual material, treatment and cooling arrangements.
15.contentEn:
Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. assesses rotary hearth furnace proposals against workpiece and process requirements. Suitability depends on shape, weight, support, the usable loading annulus and loading and unloading space. Large-diameter pipes and large components also require structural and fixture checks; the workpiece name alone does not establish suitability.

Suneng's rotary-hearth furnace configuration information lists hearth diameter, usable loading area, loading and unloading arrangements, and cooling separately. A hearth-diameter figure should be followed by a layout showing the usable area, workpiece spacing and entry and exit positions. Check rotation against the required process time and downstream cooling. The entire hearth surface is not necessarily usable loading area, and rotational speed does not define the complete process cycle.

Hearth rotation coordinates movement and process dwell time

A rotary hearth can operate continuously or by indexing, depending on the proposal. Match hearth speed, stations, heating zones and loading and unloading cycles to heating and holding time. Heat distribution also depends on heat-source layout, loading density, workpiece section and heat transfer; rotation alone does not guarantee uniform heating.

Distinguish the steel structure, refractory and insulation layers, hearth supports, drive and seals in the design. Measure temperature uniformity over the effective heating zone under agreed test conditions. The control system executes confirmed process settings; workpiece dimensions alone cannot automatically guarantee consistent internal material properties.

Define cooling, traceability and performance verification separately

Select post-furnace cooling and transfer time for the material and process. If separate cooling equipment is used, define its interfaces and supply responsibility. Hearth speed is not a direct measure of cooling capability.

Furnace temperature, station information and operating alarms may be recorded according to the actual configuration. Specify remote monitoring and traceability coverage in the technical agreement. Verify throughput and energy use per unit of product with comparable workpieces, process conditions, loads and reporting periods. Inspect surface quality and mechanical properties separately; there is no fixed improvement percentage applicable to every project.

13.titleEn: What Process and Control Conditions Should Be Confirmed for a Copper Wire Annealing Line?
13.summaryEn: Confirm wire count, payoff and take-up, tension, heating, cleaning, cooling and drying, with the automation and supply scope stated separately.
13.contentEn:
Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. assesses continuous annealing lines against the specifications and annealing requirements of copper and copper-alloy wire. Identify the material grade, wire-diameter range, incoming condition, required properties, line speed and pay-off and take-up conditions. Calculate heating length and the temperature profile for the process; one project’s parameters cannot be transferred to all wire products.

Suneng's copper-wire annealing line configuration information separates single- or multi-wire operation, pay-off and take-up arrangements, tension control, and cleaning and drying. After receiving a quotation for an automatic annealing line, identify the number of wires, reel arrangements and upstream and downstream interfaces. Then confirm whether cleaning, cooling and drying are included. Automatic temperature control alone does not establish that all handling operations are automated.

Specify heating, protection and cooling together

The main stages include pay-off and tension control, continuous heating and annealing, process-specific cooling and take-up. Whether preheating, cleaning, drying or other stages are needed depends on surface requirements and upstream and downstream conditions.

The heating-zone arrangement and circulation suited to the furnace structure help distribute heat. Surface oxidation also depends on atmosphere composition, oxygen and moisture levels, sealing, protected cooling and the incoming surface. Uniform airflow cannot replace these conditions. Select the protective arrangement for the material and actual equipment configuration.

Automatic control serves the agreed process

Set furnace temperature and line speed together with process time and required properties. The temperatures, speeds, tension, atmosphere readings and alarms that can be collected depend on the installed sensors and controls. The relevant traceability record is formed by linking these records to batch identifiers.

Efficiency comparisons require the same wire specifications, quality requirements, effective operating time and conforming output. Verify annealing through agreed mechanical-property and surface-quality inspections; constant-temperature control or automatic feeding alone cannot support a fixed improvement percentage.

12.titleEn: Suneng Annealing and Solution Treatment Lines for Further Steel Processing
12.summaryEn: Match strip dimensions, material, heating, cooling and supply responsibilities when planning an annealing and solution treatment line.
12.contentEn:
Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. develops equipment proposals for continuous annealing and solution-treatment sections used in metal strip processing. For coil-fed equipment, the workpiece is the continuous strip after uncoiling. Whole coils loaded into a furnace, individual plates and large discrete components require separate assessments of support, conveying and cooling arrangements.

Workpiece form determines conveying and support

A strip-line specification should identify the material grade, strip width and thickness, coil weight, incoming condition and surface requirements before defining roller support, tension control, strip tracking and upstream and downstream interfaces. A mesh belt or another support arrangement must be checked against the actual structure and operating conditions; the phrase “roller and mesh-belt support” cannot describe every production line.

Temperature, line speed and cooling must describe the same material and process

Set annealing or solution-treatment temperatures for the material grade and required microstructure. The high-temperature section’s design limit is not the target strip temperature; total furnace length is not effective heating length; and conveying speed is not necessarily stable production speed. Length and temperature figures from different projects must not be combined.

The process configuration must address heating, soaking, cooling rate, surface condition and downstream treatment together. For stainless steel that must pass rapidly through a sensitization temperature range, define staged cooling for the specific material and check strip shape and tension.

Confirm performance and supply scope separately

A temperature-uniformity requirement needs its effective zone, test temperature, loading condition and measurement method. Verify capacity and energy use for stated specifications and operating conditions. Define responsibilities for heating, cooling, conveying, controls and integrated commissioning; a local process section must not be presented as a standard complete annealing-and-pickling line or a guaranteed result.

11.titleEn: How Should a Strip Annealing and Solution Treatment Line Match the Workpiece and Process?
11.summaryEn: Match strip material, dimensions, loading, heating and cooling, then distinguish design-capacity calculations from the agreed acceptance conditions.
11.contentEn:
Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. develops equipment proposals for continuous annealing and solution-treatment sections used in metal strip processing. For coil-fed equipment, the workpiece is the continuous strip after uncoiling. Whole coils loaded into a furnace, individual plates and large discrete components require separate assessments of support, conveying and cooling arrangements.

Suneng's dual-strip stainless-steel annealing furnace documents list design-capacity calculations separately from final acceptance trials, using different materials, thicknesses and strip speeds. When a supplier provides one output figure, ask whether it covers one strip, two strips or multiple furnaces, and which product specifications and reporting period it uses. Match the products you intend to run to the relevant acceptance conditions; do not combine a design calculation and a different acceptance test into one guarantee.

Workpiece form determines conveying and support

A strip-line specification should identify the material grade, strip width and thickness, coil weight, incoming condition and surface requirements before defining roller support, tension control, strip tracking and upstream and downstream interfaces. A mesh belt or another support arrangement must be checked against the actual structure and operating conditions; the phrase “roller and mesh-belt support” cannot describe every production line.

Temperature, line speed and cooling must describe the same material and process

Set annealing or solution-treatment temperatures for the material grade and required microstructure. The high-temperature section’s design limit is not the target strip temperature; total furnace length is not effective heating length; and conveying speed is not necessarily stable production speed. Length and temperature figures from different projects must not be combined.

The process configuration must address heating, soaking, cooling rate, surface condition and downstream treatment together. For stainless steel that must pass rapidly through a sensitization temperature range, define staged cooling for the specific material and check strip shape and tension.

Confirm performance and supply scope separately

A temperature-uniformity requirement needs its effective zone, test temperature, loading condition and measurement method. Verify capacity and energy use for stated specifications and operating conditions. Define responsibilities for heating, cooling, conveying, controls and integrated commissioning; a local process section must not be presented as a standard complete annealing-and-pickling line or a guaranteed result.

14.titleEn: Which Treatments Can a 700°C Box Furnace Perform? Confirm the Material and Requirements
14.summaryEn: For a furnace rated for operation at 700°C, assess material-specific tempering, stress relief or annealing; do not assume conventional steel normalizing or stainless-steel solution treatment capability.
14.contentEn:
Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. provides box-furnace proposals for small and medium batches of workpieces. For a version rated for operation at 700°C, assess tempering, stress relief or specific annealing treatments against the material grade and required properties. It must not be applied directly to conventional normalizing of ordinary carbon or low-alloy steels, nor presented as generally suitable for stainless-steel solution treatment.

Suneng box-furnace documents list programmed temperature control separately from an electrically powered loading trolley operated by a person. If a supplier confirms automatic temperature control, that answers only the temperature-programming question. Ask who loads, unloads and transfers the workpieces for cooling, what mechanisms are used, and how these operations enter the batch schedule. This handling example comes from a different temperature version; it does not change the process limits of the 700°C version discussed here.

Match the process before specifying the equipment

The basic cycle comprises loading, heating, holding and process-specific cooling. Furnace temperature, holding time and the cooling route depend on the material, workpiece section, load and required properties. Copper and steel have different heat-treatment schedules and must not share a single generic process description.

Heating zones, sensor positions and circulation appropriate to the operating temperature help distribute heat. Measure uniformity in the agreed effective working zone under specified temperature, loading and measurement-point conditions. Instrument readings alone do not establish consistent internal properties throughout a batch.

Verify efficiency and quality separately

Loading arrangement, heating and holding time, cooling, loading and unloading all influence the batch cycle. Compare efficiency using operating records for similar workpieces, loads and reporting periods. Check surface quality and mechanical properties against product inspection requirements. Unloading and cooling arrangements are only part of distortion control and cannot guarantee zero distortion.

Temperature curves, operating states and alarms can be recorded according to the control-system configuration. Define remote monitoring, cooling data and batch-traceability coverage in the technical agreement. For a quotation, provide material, workpiece dimensions and weight, load per batch, process curves and acceptance requirements.

142.titleEn: Which furnaces and heat treatment lines does Jiangsu Suneng supply?
142.summaryEn: Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. supplies batch furnaces, continuous furnaces and heat treatment lines. Its services include equipment design and manufacture, systems integration, installation, commissioning and retrofits. Start with the workpiece, the process and the way production is organised, then select a furnace and its auxiliaries.
142.contentEn:
Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. supplies batch furnaces, continuous furnaces and heat treatment lines. Its services include equipment design and manufacture, systems integration, installation, commissioning and retrofits. Start with the workpiece, the process and the way production is organised, then select a furnace and its auxiliaries.

Which furnace types should you consider first?

Suneng’s batch range includes box, trolley, pit, bell, forklift-loaded, elevator-hearth and nitriding furnaces. Its continuous range includes mesh belt, pusher, roller hearth, rotary hearth and walking beam furnaces. Batch furnaces are loaded and unloaded one batch at a time. Continuous furnaces move workpieces through successive zones at a specified speed or interval. See the industrial furnace catalogue for individual models.

The furnace name gives you a starting point. The selection depends on how the part is loaded and heated and how it passes to and from adjacent operations.

Workpiece and production conditions Furnaces to consider What to verify
Large, heavy parts loaded and unloaded as a batch Batch equipment such as a trolley furnace Combined mass of parts and fixtures, usable space, support and loading access
Long parts such as shafts to be loaded vertically pit furnace In addition to the length and diameter, you should also check the lifting space, clamping and deformation requirements.
Small parts that can be spread consistently for continuous treatment Mesh belt furnace and corresponding production line Stable conveying, loading pattern, process residence time and downstream cooling
Plates, bars or workpieces transported in fixtures Roller hearth furnace, pusher furnace, walking beam furnace, etc. Suitability of conveyors and supports, and timing at upstream and downstream interfaces

Use the table to make a shortlist. Two parts of identical dimensions may need different equipment if their materials, loading densities or allowable distortion differ. Chamber clearance and maximum temperature alone cannot establish suitability.

Which applications do the heat treatment lines cover?

Suneng groups its lines by workpiece and process. The heat treatment line catalogue describes the individual routes.

Workpiece or process Examples of line configurations Key selection inputs
Small steel parts and fasteners Continuous mesh belt annealing and tempering lines, fastener quench and temper lines, and mesh belt carburizing, quenching and tempering lines Material and target performance; the process requirements of tempering, quenching and carburizing cannot be mixed.
Wire and strip Continuous copper wire annealing lines, and strip annealing and solution treatment lines Material brand, wire diameter or width specifications, and speed requirements for continuous operation
Construction machinery parts and forgings Track shoe press quench lines, lines for residual-heat quenching and tempering of forgings, and multi-furnace quench cells with a shared manipulator Deformation target, load transfer conditions; residual heat quenching must confirm the material and post-forging state application
Aluminium alloy parts and billets Aluminium alloy solution treatment and ageing lines, and pre-forging heating lines Brand and subsequent use; solution treatment aging and pre-forging heating correspond to different goals
Composite products Continuous curing lines for composite gas cylinders Resin system, curing requirements and product conveying mode

Specify each stage of a complete line. Identify heating, cooling, washing, loading, unloading, conveying and controls on the equipment list. The line name alone does not establish which items the quotation includes.

Choose between a single furnace and a complete line

Start with the material and treatment objective. Improving bulk properties, modifying the surface and reheating for forging call for different combinations of equipment. A maximum temperature by itself rarely defines the design.

Next consider the production pattern. Frequent changes of products, loads or processes favour a close look at batch flexibility. A steady supply of similar parts and stable upstream and downstream operations may justify a continuous line. Evaluate its normal utilisation as well as the peak output target.

Finally check the full sequence. Even with enough heating capacity, slow cooling, transfer or unloading can limit accepted output. Include workpiece data, process requirements, target output and site constraints in the enquiry.

Send Suneng drawings or photographs, material grades, normal and maximum dimensions, process requirements, loading arrangements and target output. For a retrofit, describe the existing equipment and the problem to resolve. Suneng supplies equipment and related services. It does not provide piece-rate contract heat treatment.

141.titleEn: What do Suneng’s installation, commissioning, training and after-sales services cover?
141.summaryEn: Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. provides installation preparation and site support, commissioning and verification, operation and maintenance training, documentation, repairs and spare parts support. Agree the services, customer responsibilities, acceptance requirements and costs before scheduling site work.
141.contentEn:
Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. provides installation preparation and site support, commissioning and verification, operation and maintenance training, documentation, repairs and spare parts support. Agree the services, customer responsibilities, acceptance requirements and costs before scheduling site work. See the installation and after-sales service guide.

What does each installation, commissioning and training stage cover?

Stage Service to confirm Customer responsibilities
Preparation for installation Check the equipment layout, foundation and energy interface conditions Provide the on-site size, foundation and energy conditions required for equipment
Install and connect Complete the installation, connection and inspection of equipment within the agreed range Coordinate the entry channel, lifting and on-site operation conditions
commissioning and verification Stand-alone commissioning, linked trial operation and agreed acceptance projects Provide the agreed test workpiece, operators and production conditions
Training delivery Operation and maintenance training, information transfer and delivery confirmation Designate equipment operation, maintenance and data receiving personnel

Before installation, identify who will carry out each site activity. A contract that includes installation and commissioning does not automatically include foundations, lifting, utility connections, field connections or third-party testing. Once responsibilities are assigned, the parties can establish when the site will be ready.

Commissioning verifies different things at different stages. An individual machine test can verify its movement. A line trial checks the interfaces between machines. If the purchase includes throughput or product quality targets, specify representative parts, operating conditions, tests and records in the technical agreement. Factory testing does not replace site acceptance.

How should training and documentation reach the people who use the equipment?

Suneng’s training covers operation and maintenance for the equipment configuration and documents supplied. The customer can nominate operators and maintenance staff in advance so that the right people receive the relevant instructions.

Check training against the agreed content. Staff should understand the equipment requirements, know where to find the applicable operation and maintenance instructions, and know whom to contact and what information to provide if something goes wrong. Follow the approved equipment documents and professional site training for operating and safety procedures.

Check the relevant drawings, manuals, agreed inspection and trial records, corrective-action records, maintenance information and spare parts list. The supply agreement and equipment configuration determine whether programme backups are included. A control system does not automatically come with every programme or software permission. See the guide to equipment handover documents.

The documents should match the equipment as delivered. If commissioning changes the configuration, reconcile the handover list and manuals. An obsolete model number can lead to an unsuitable spare part or maintenance plan.

What after-sales support is available, and how are timing and costs agreed?

Support can include fault reporting, technical assessment, repairs, spare parts and site attendance where needed. Provide the nameplate, symptoms, alarms, photographs, and the time and operating conditions when the issue occurred. Use the information already available. Do not carry out hazardous checks to complete a fault report.

Agree separate milestones for technical feedback, arrival on site and return to production. Remote diagnosis, availability of spares and site readiness all affect the schedule. A promise to respond promptly does not define a complete repair plan.

Check the warranty scope, start date and duration, and who pays for repairs, replacements, travel and transport. Repairs and spares can also be discussed after warranty. Charges and attendance times depend on the equipment and contract.

For installation or handover, send the project name, equipment list, site readiness and proposed dates. For after-sales support, start with the identity of the installed equipment and the symptoms observed.

140.titleEn: Has Suneng supplied an annealing furnace for stainless steel strip?
140.summaryEn: Yes. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. supplied equipment for the annealing furnace and solution-treatment cooling section of Henan Jinyubang Industrial Co., Ltd.’s continuous stainless steel strip annealing and pickling line. Suneng’s thermal-section scope included the furnace, cooling section, combustion equipment and controls. Separate equipment performs downstream pickling.
140.contentEn:
Yes. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. supplied equipment for the annealing furnace and solution-treatment cooling section of Henan Jinyubang Industrial Co., Ltd.’s continuous stainless steel strip annealing and pickling line. Suneng’s thermal-section scope included the furnace, cooling section, combustion equipment and controls. Separate equipment performs downstream pickling.

Which strip dimensions does the project design cover?

The 850 mm in the line name is its nominal size. The strip dimensions and process conditions in the technical annex provide a more useful basis for procurement.

Item Design conditions in the project technical annex
Material 200- and 300-series stainless steel strip
Strip width 480–750mm
Strip thickness 1.6–4.0 mm
Strip annealing temperature 1050–1150℃

For example, an 800 mm strip is narrower than the nominal 850 mm but wider than the design maximum of 750 mm in this proposal. Reassess the usable furnace passage, roller support and cooling coverage before considering that width.

How does the strip pass through heating and cooling?

In the project design, the strip runs continuously through preheating, rapid heating and soaking. The heating furnace has a design length of approximately 130 m. The strip then enters the solution-treatment cooling section for staged cooling, squeezing and hot-air drying before downstream handover. The cooling and drying section accounts for a further approximately 45 m. Allow space for both sections in the plant layout.

One easily missed interface is the strip temperature at handover. The strip passes through a hot-air dryer after water cooling. The technical annex notes that the dryer can reheat the strip at low line speeds. If the downstream process limits entry temperature, agree to check it at the dryer outlet. The Henan Jinyubang project description sets out the sections and supply boundaries.

What information is needed to assess another strip product?

List both the common specifications and the most demanding ones. For each, provide material grade, width, thickness, required line speed and annealing temperature. In a furnace section of fixed length, faster strip travel gives a shorter residence time. Assess thickness, target strip temperature and speed together when checking continuous capacity.

To fit a furnace into an existing line, provide a site layout showing the strip entry, downstream handover and existing cooling and drying equipment. This allows both parties to identify new equipment and the interfaces to be connected to the existing line.

139.titleEn: Does Suneng manufacture its own furnaces as well as integrate production lines?
139.summaryEn: Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures and integrates industrial furnaces and heat treatment equipment. It also provides installation, commissioning, retrofits and after-sales support. For each project, identify the equipment built in-house, the components purchased from others and the systems Suneng integrates.
139.contentEn:
Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures and integrates industrial furnaces and heat treatment equipment. It also provides installation, commissioning, retrofits and after-sales support. For each project, identify the equipment built in-house, the components purchased from others and the systems Suneng integrates.

What do manufacturing and integration each cover?

Manufacturing covers how an individual furnace, its structure and mechanisms are made, assembled and inspected against drawings. Integration covers how the furnace works with conveying, cooling, handling and control equipment. Suneng undertakes both individual equipment and equipment packages organised around a heat treatment process. See its company and manufacturing profile.

For a single furnace, check the equipment against the specification. For a line, also check the handovers between machines. A normally operating heating stage cannot establish line output if cooling or transfer cannot keep pace. Integration includes checking those dependencies together.

Bought-in instruments, fans or drive components do not by themselves establish that a complete furnace was resold. Check who designed and built the furnace and its systems, how bought-in components were specified and inspected, and who is responsible for the agreed delivery.

How do you verify which equipment was made in-house?

Use the table to discuss responsibilities with Suneng. It identifies what the buyer can check. The project documents and manufacturing records establish who performed the work.

Activity Evidence to request What the records establish
Manufacturing of furnace body and mechanical mechanism Corresponding drawings, production tasks, processing and assembly records Which object is actually produced by whom, and does it correspond to this equipment?
Out-purchased parts matching Configuration list, manufacturer and model, purchase and arrival inspection records What to buy and how to check the suitability, can't be written as Suneng self-made
Control system design and commissioning Electrical diagram, program delivery agreement, commissioning record Who is responsible for the design, modification and commissioning, and who will hand over the follow-up maintenance materials?
Whole line connection and verification Equipment arrangement, handover requirements, linkage trial operation and problem handling records How to cooperate with each equipment, and who will check the whole line agreement results?

A contract naming Suneng as supplier establishes a supply obligation. A claim of in-house manufacture also needs manufacturing records. When visiting a workshop, match the physical equipment, identifying number and records to the work being claimed.

If a critical component must be made in-house, specify the component, verification method and permitted subcontracting in advance. An undifferentiated requirement for entirely in-house manufacture can obscure the important parts and mix them up with ordinary purchased components.

Which other responsibilities matter when buying a complete line?

First, define each equipment and site interface. Show the scope of furnace, conveying, cooling and control supply, and responsibility for foundations, utilities, field wiring and lifting. Equipment package supply and engineering general contracting are different services. Suneng does not directly undertake engineering general contracts.

Second, tie acceptance to the purchase objective. Individual checks, factory tests, integrated site trials and workpiece tests verify different things under different conditions. A single machine’s factory record does not replace line acceptance where the contract specifies a complete-line result.

Third, assign after-sales support for purchased components. Alongside the brand, identify the contact, who arranges spares and site work, and who pays each cost under the contract.

To discuss a purchase with Suneng, provide workpiece and process requirements, the proposed equipment list and any manufacturing activities you specifically want to verify. The parties can then discuss the design, actual manufacturing responsibilities and delivery obligations together.

138.titleEn: Why can quotes for two trolley furnaces of the same size range from RMB 200,000 to 800,000?
138.summaryEn: For two trolley furnaces with the same quoted dimensions, check what those dimensions describe, the production duty and what each supplier delivers. Identical chamber dimensions do not establish the same effective working zone, load capacity, loaded heating performance or installation and acceptance scope.
138.contentEn:
There is an obvious price difference in the bogie hearth furnace of the same size. First, check the size definition, actual production tasks and delivery scope, and then check the configuration and business differences. The same length, width and height of the furnace chamber do not mean that the effective working zone, bearing, load heating, temperature performance and installation acceptance are the same; but the high price cannot prove that the equipment is more suitable for you alone.

The 200,000 and 800,000 yuan in the question are the quotations given by the questions. There are no corresponding two original quotations in this article, so it is impossible to determine which item has caused how much price difference, nor can these two numbers be regarded as the market price range of bogie hearth furnace. The following method is used to find out where the two plans are different.

Match the design duty as well as the dimensions

First, ask whether the size in the quotation is the external size, the geometric size of the furnace chamber, or the agreed effective working zone. Effective working zone is the loading area that can meet the process requirements according to the agreed conditions. Just looking at the nominal furnace chamber, it is impossible to judge whether the same batch of workpieces and fixtures can be arranged in the same way, and it is impossible to judge which positions the temperature requirements cover.

Even if the size definition is the same, continue to compare the total weight, fulcrum and load distribution of each furnace workpiece and fixtures. Light load, uniform spread and heavy parts are centrally loaded, and the tasks proposed for the furnace trolley platform, the bottom structure, the wheel track and drive are different. The quotation says the same "load", and it also depends on what loading conditions this number corresponds to.

When the temperature and operation system, load task and heat source mode change, the furnace lining, heating or combustion, furnace trolley structure and on-site support may be changed at the same time. You should first check the differences that will affect the whole design, and then compare the instrument brand or optional networking functions; this is a kind of price verification order, not a fixed cost ranking for all projects.

Equal temperature ratings and installed power do not guarantee equal capacity

The maximum use temperature is the same, which does not mean that the daily continuous work system and the workpiece heating process are the same. It is necessary to compare the actual loading of each furnace, what temperature to start from, how to arrange heating, soaking and cooling, and the complete production cycle. I only watch the demonstration of empty furnace heating, and I can't answer how long it will take to enter the next process after loading the workpiece.

The electric heating power is greater, and it is not automatically equal to the faster heating of the workpiece. Effective heating, furnace lining and fixtures heat absorption, heat transfer and on-site power supply conditions should correspond; the gas scheme needs to check the combustion, gas supply and smoke exhaust matching according to the same process tasks. The two heat sources should not only compare the unit price of equipment, and the new on-site supporting equipment should also be included within the same range.

There are many temperature zones and the brand of the control cabinet is expensive, which cannot prove that the temperature uniformity is better. You should check the effective working zone, test temperature, no-load or load status and judgment method, and then compare the requirements and verification arrangements under the same conditions. The temperature difference figure of the test conditions is not written, which cannot be directly used as evidence of high price and reasonable.

Ask which requirement each extra feature serves

Functions such as data preservation, formula management, networking and automatic entry and output of materials can have procurement value if they correspond to clear production organization, traceability or personnel arrangement. However, what functions have been added, what needs the buyer to cooperate with, and what information should be delivered clearly.

If daily work only requires simple procedures and records, there is no need to accept unused functions just because of "more advanced configuration". On the other hand, there are clear requirements for product traceability, and the low-price plan that lacks the necessary records cannot be regarded as the same delivery by manual supplementation after the fact. The judgment is based on your task, not the number of function names.

Compare prices on the same installed and accepted basis

One quotation includes transportation, installation, on-site connection, testing and information, and the other only includes the factory equipment. The two total prices do not correspond to the same delivery. In particular, "including installation", "guidance installation" and "buyer provides supporting equipment", it is necessary to continue to list the specific content and the boundary position, and we can't just compare these sentences.

Sort out the quotation differences into the following table, and ask the manufacturer to explain whether it is satisfied, where the difference is, and the quotation after completing the same range.

Comparative items What should be aligned with the two quotations? What costs or tasks may be involved? The basis for verification that should be requested
Size and loading Effective working zone, workpiece and fixtures, load distribution Furnace body, furnace trolley, furnace bottom, track and drive Size definition, furnace loading diagram and bearing conditions
Process and cycle Commonly used and the highest temperature, operation system, load process Furnace lining, heating or combustion, thermal engineering design and production capacity Schemes and verification arrangements under the same workpiece conditions
Temperature and control Test scope and status, necessary records and action functions Temperature measurement, control, recording and corresponding test work Function description, test conditions and delivery list
On-site and acceptance Transportation, installation, supporting connection, testing and training On-site work, professional support and verification fees Including, not including, the matters provided by the buyer and the position of responsibility
Business and service Tax transportation, payment, warranty, spare parts and service scope Quotation caliber and follow-up costs Quotation and terms of service with the same caliber

Are these different designs or different prices for the same delivery?

If the tasks of the first two layers are different, please ask the manufacturer to adjust the plan according to the same conditions first. The original price is not directly comparable for the time being. If the task is the same and the additional functions are different, quote the required functions separately from the optional functions to judge what problems are solved with the additional investment.

If the main technical tasks, acceptance and delivery scope are the same and there is still a price difference, the supply organization, delivery date, service and business conditions should continue to be compared, and the important differences should be explained. You can't find a reason for a certain price, and decide out of thin air that the cheap one is to cut corners, or the expensive one has a longer life and lower energy consumption.

When there is a quotation, two complete plans can be provided first, representing the workpiece and furnace loading conditions, process requirements and on-site scope. 137.titleEn: Who handles a fault when another supplier makes the quench tank or washer?
137.summaryEn: Consult the service arrangements in the purchase documents. If the tank and washer are in the line supplier’s scope, its contact coordinates the original equipment makers. For separate purchases, the buyer’s line lead or integrator coordinates them. The first contact need not be the party that ultimately pays for corrective work.
137.contentEn:
When quench tank and washing machine are externally purchased, first find the docking person according to the service division of labor agreed in the procurement document: if they are included in the scope of the supply and after-sales service of the whole line supplier, the whole line docking person shall organize the original equipment manufacturer to deal with it; if the buyer purchases separately, the person in charge of the whole line designated by the buyer or the integration party will coordinate with the relevant manufacturers. Who to contact first, and who will finally rectify and what expenses will be borne are two issues that need to be confirmed separately.

Therefore, you can't just look at the manufacturer's nameplate on the quench tank or the washing machine to determine the responsibility, and you can't conclude that it is caused by an out-purchased equipment as soon as you see that the product is not qualified.

One line contract or several independent purchases?

The whole line supplier can adopt the supporting products of professional manufacturers. The purchasing party should pay attention to whether their documents include supporting selection, connection design, joint commissioning and after-sales coordination. If all have been included, the agreed docking person should be allowed to receive the problem and the equipment side should be organized to verify it, instead of looking for each supplier from scratch.

If the quench tank and washing machine are purchased separately by the buyer, the working scope of the furnace factory may only reach the main furnace or the agreed connection point. At this time, it is necessary for the buyer to clarify who manages the workpiece conditions, equipment connection and process records uniformly. It can be agreed separately to ask the furnace factory to assist in checking, and the unpurchased whole-line coordination service cannot be defaulted as included.

Another situation is that the buyer designates the supporting brand, and the leader is responsible for the procurement and installation. Its design audit, applicability check and after-sales division of labor should also be listed alone, and who is responsible for all the problems cannot be judged only by the word "designated brand".

Hardness variation alone does not identify a quench tank fault

For the production line using liquid quenching, the final product performs conditions such as related materials, heating and soaking, furnace transfer, medium state, cyclic cooling and subsequent tempering. If there is no leakage in the tank and the circulation pump can run, it can only explain the corresponding phenomenon, but it cannot prove that the quenching conditions under the continuous incoming material meet the agreement.

When there is a product deviation, the leading party should organize the process personnel, the furnace factory and the quenching supporting party to match the materials of the same batch of products with the loading, heating record, transfer record, medium and supporting status and inspection results. Distinguish the working conditions where the deviation occurs first, and then judge which section should be checked. You can't just rely on a temperature reading or a hardness report to skip other links to determine the fault responsibility.

If the problem only occurs after a period of continuous production and does not occur at the beginning of the start-up, you should focus on checking whether the record covers the cumulative incoming materials and supporting operation status at that time; you can't only use the power-on demonstration to replace the evidence under continuous working conditions.

A running washer does not prove that the cleaning target is met

The cleaning effect needs to correspond to the shape of the workpiece, the incoming residue, the loading and stay conditions, and the agreed cleaning determination method. The appearance looks clean and cannot replace the agreed residue or follow-up process requirements.

If only a certain specification or a certain loading method is left, the difference between the problem batch and the normal batch should be compared first to check whether they are within the scope confirmed at the time of procurement. If the incoming material, rhythm or loading is changed later, it is also necessary to check whether these changes have been confirmed by each section of equipment. Changing the working conditions does not prove that there must be a problem with the equipment, nor does it prove that the equipment party can be directly exempted from liability. It needs to be judged in combination with the confirmation record.

When the follow-up requirements still cannot be met after cleaning, it is also necessary to distinguish between the performance of cleaning, drying and follow-up processes to avoid all the phenomena from other links to the washing machine.

Who should investigate each symptom?

The phenomenon that appears Who will organize the handling first? Which evidence should be dealt with first? You can't draw any conclusions directly.
There is a clear abnormality in the pump, transmission or conveying mechanism. Contact the docking person according to the service agreement and arrange the verification of the equipment. Record of equipment status, alarm, maintenance and supporting conditions If you see the abnormality of the parts, it is determined that all product deviations are caused by it.
The single machine is normal, but the material between the two sections is accumulated and cannot be continued. The person in charge of the whole line summons the upstream and downstream equipment and electrical control parties. Incoming materials of the same batch, operation rhythm, handover location, status and version records Just because of the accumulation of downstream materials, it is determined that there is a problem in the manufacture of downstream equipment.
Changes in quenching or product performance after continuous production The person in charge of the whole line organizes the process, furnace body and quenching supporting party Same batch of materials, heating, transfer, medium and supporting status, product inspection If the tank or pump can operate, it is determined that the quenching conditions are qualified.
Specific workpiece cleaning or drying does not meet the standard The person in charge of the whole line organizes the cleaning supporting parties and technical personnel. Incoming material residue, shape, loading, process and judgment record It looks clean with the naked eye, and it is determined that all the follow-up requirements have been met.

The above is the order of checking reports and evidence, not the operation procedures for troubleshooting. It involves equipment operation, media, safety protection and on-site testing, which are handled by the corresponding professionals according to the equipment documents.

What to include in a service request

The first report can explain: what workpiece, what batch, when it appeared, what the performance was, which segment affected, whether the product or operating conditions were changed at that time, and attach existing records. Write "production deviation" separately from "a device has been confirmed to fail" to avoid fixing the cause before verification.

The processing record should continue to be clearly written on the basis of the reason, the tasks of all parties, the modified content and the results of the re-examination. The final rectification of the division of labor, service scope and cost needs to be returned to the confirmed procurement documents and verification conclusions; this article does not make liability rulings for specific disputes.

136.titleEn: How do you accept a heat treatment line from several suppliers, and who handles problems?
136.summaryEn: Before signing, assign responsibility for each machine, its interfaces and the complete-line result. Name a single contact. Progress from factory checks to installed interfaces, line trials and agreed product tests. If a problem arises, the appointed lead coordinates the investigation before the records are used to assign corrective work.
136.contentEn:
When the transportation, quenching, cleaning and electrical control of the heat treatment line are provided by different manufacturers, the sub-equipment responsibility, the connection responsibility between the equipment and the result responsibility of the whole line should be clarified at the same time before signing the contract, and a unified problem docking person should be designated. Acceptance should be carried out from the factory inspection to the on-site connection, whole line operation and agreed product result verification. If there is a problem, the leading party shall first organize the investigation, and then determine the rectification division of labor according to the record.

It is not enough to just write "each manufacturer is responsible for its own equipment". Someone needs to be responsible for how to receive materials between the two devices, exchange status, save process records, and what to do when a single machine can run but fails to reach the whole line target.

Assign responsibility beyond the individual machine

The sub-project manufacturers are responsible for their own equipment, and do not automatically include the joint design of the front and rear sections. For cross-device connection, it is necessary to at least explain who puts forward the conditions, who completes the design on this side, who reviews the cooperation between the two parties, and who organizes verification.

For example, the upstream conveying equipment and the washing machine can be operated separately, but they may not be connected due to the receiving position, the incoming rhythm or the workingpiece loading conditions. If the two companies design according to different versions of workpiece data, the problem is not only "which machine is broken", but also involves the management of the whole line conditions.

You can put the connection requirements in the following table. The items in the table are used for the procurement division of labor, and the specific design and testing are completed by relevant professionals according to the project.

Connection position What should both parties confirm together? Responsibilities that must be implemented Evidence that should be left
Loading, conveying and main furnace Workpiece and loading range, receiving position, operation rhythm Who will put forward the transportation conditions uniformly, and which part of the design will be completed by both parties? Same version of process, connection diagram and work condition confirmation record
Main furnace discharge and quenching system Transfer mode, incoming load, medium and supporting capacity requirements Who puts forward the supporting conditions for quenching, who will review the connection and organize the verification? Supporting conditions, ability description and corresponding verification records
Chenching, material discharge, cleaning and drying Workpiece status, residue, continuous incoming material and follow-up process requirements Who determines the cleaning target, and who checks the conveying and cleaning capacity? Workpiece conditions, cleaning judgment methods and records
Each section of equipment and unified electronic control Status signal, data correspondence, control version and professional security requirements Who formulates the connection instructions, who completes the cooperation on all sides, and who organizes the joint verification? Confirmed signal and function description, version and test record
The final output of the whole line Representing the product, loading, production conditions, quality and yield caliber Who is responsible for the agreed results, and what workpiece and inspection conditions does the buyer provide? Acceptance plan, original record, product inspection and problem closure record

If the buyer purchases separately, the cooperation matters of each manufacturer should also be included in the corresponding procurement documents; only drawing a division of labor table within the buyer cannot prove that the supplier has accepted these tasks.

Four acceptance stages and what each can prove

The following four steps are phased suggestions to facilitate procurement management, which are not the legal steps implemented by all production lines. Projects can be merged or subdivided, focusing on the consistency of objects, conditions, judgments and signatories at each stage.

The first step is to check the sub-item equipment and verifiable connections at the factory. Check the equipment configuration, agreed functions, information and the tests that the manufacturer can complete on site. When the supporting equipment is not in the same location, which connections have not been verified should be listed in a single list, and cannot be written as all lines have been passed.

The second step is to check the actual connection after installation on the spot. Check whether the location of the equipment, public support, mechanical handover and control connection are in line with the confirmation plan, and deal with the matters reserved at the factory stage. The completion of the on-site connection cannot automatically prove the load production capacity, and the list of confirmed and to be confirmed at this stage needs to be left.

The third step is to verify whether the whole line can be connected continuously according to the agreed conditions. The relevant equipment parties jointly confirm the entry and output of the workpiece, the continuation of each section, the record correspondence and the agreed function. For protection and abnormal responses that require professional confirmation, they are included in special acceptance documents and do not need to be replaced by a no-load demonstration.

Step four, verify the agreed product results and complete the handover. If the contract target includes product quality and accepted output, it shall be tested and counted according to the pre-agreed method under the confirmed workpiece, loading and process conditions. At the same time, check the drawings, maintenance materials, procedures and record delivery, training and legacy matters. The specific test time, sampling rules and allowable deviations are determined by the project file.

Record machine operation, product quality and throughput separately

The operation of the single machine is normal, and the answer is the problem of equipment function; the whole line is normal, and the answer is the problem of equipment coordination; the product inspection and accepted output, the answer is whether the procurement target can be realized. These evidences should correspond to each other, but not replace each other.

If the contract only purchases the manufacture and function of a certain equipment, all product results cannot be attributed to the equipment manufacturer by default after delivery. On the other hand, the seller has accepted the quality or output target of the whole line, and cannot be required to collect according to the overall target label based on the itemized equipment checklist alone.

Before acceptance, it is also necessary to write clearly who provides the workpiece and materials, who confirms the process, and who completes the inspection. When product deviations are found, the materials, loading, process records and equipment status should be checked together to determine which layer the deviation occurs.

Use a common incident record to assign corrective work and close the issue

The unified docking person is responsible for receiving problems, summoning relevant parties, sorting out evidence and promoting handling; this coordination responsibility and the final fault responsibility should be agreed upon separately. The general docking person does not automatically replace the professional judgment of each equipment party, and cannot let the purchaser guess the contact of the company by itself when the reason is unknown.

The question sheet can record the time of occurrence, products and batches, phenomena, relevant equipment, original records, next check items and the person in charge. If multiple devices are involved, the relevant parties shall form a common conclusion; after modifying the supporting conditions or control version, the affected scope shall be re-verified according to the prior agreement. The unrecorded verbal "fixed" should not directly replace the basis for closing the problem.

The first communication can provide the process flow chart, the list of each equipment, the planned procurement method and the acceptance target. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. The public business or product information of the three companies includes the relevant directions of heat treatment line, but what kind of workpiece is suitable and which equipment can be undertaken uniformly needs to be verified separately according to your project.

This is a group of consulting candidates with sources, not a complete directory or manufacturer ranking. First, distinguish whether you want to buy fastener quenching and tempering line, forging quenching and tempering line, continuous carburizing system, or other heat treatment line, and then contact the corresponding manufacturer, and the list will have practical use.

Which lines do the suppliers list publicly?

Workpiece differences change the appropriate line

The roller-type quenching and tempering line suitable for large-scale forgings cannot be used as a substitute for the fastener mesh belt line with "with quench tank". The support, conveying, loading and transfer methods of workpiece are different, and the connection design between the equipment will also change.

Similarly, the process tasks of continuous carburizing system are different from quenching tempering quenching and tempering line. When contacting, you can ask the manufacturer to draw a suggested process on the same workpiece material and explain the reason for choosing the furnace type and conveying method. There is no explanation of how the actual workpiece passes each paragraph. For the time being, it is not appropriate to determine the list only according to the size of the company or the size of the furnace.

Check supply boundaries and verification arrangements

If the procurement target includes conveying, quenching, cleaning and unified control, the manufacturer should be required to list the self-made, out-procured and buyer-provided equipment item by item, and indicate who is responsible for the connection design, joint adjustment and problem handling. Having professional out-purchased equipment does not mean that the whole line cannot be delivered; if no one is responsible for cross-device connection, there will be obvious gaps.

Photos of similar devices can help judge the form of the product, but to verify the adaptability of the current project, you should also look at the process, capability description and verification plan. When there is no exact same historical project, we can discuss how to verify the difference; a similar photo cannot be used as proof of the same material, same output and same quality results.

If the output of the whole line is the procurement target, the statistical position should be the final output of the agreed product, and the loading, shift, replacement and inspection conditions should be clearly written. Looking for a manufacturer in Jiangsu, door-to-door communication and follow-up on-site arrangements are practical considerations, but it is necessary to confirm who will come to survey, check which on-site conditions, what materials to deliver, and how to arrange installation, commissioning and after-sales service. 134.titleEn: For a fastener quench and temper line, should you approach a mesh belt furnace maker or a line integrator?
134.summaryEn: A furnace maker can lead a new, well-defined mesh belt quench and temper project if it can coordinate conveying, quenching, washing and controls. A line integrator with heat treatment expertise may be better placed to connect existing machines, workshop logistics and several control systems. Check who can verify the complete process.
134.contentEn:
If you want to put on a fastener quenching and tempering line, if the main task is to build a new set of mesh belt quenching and tempering equipment with a clear process, and the furnace factory can coordinate transportation, quenching, cleaning and control, it can be led by the furnace factory; if you want to connect to multiple existing equipment, transform workshop logistics or unify multiple control systems, you can consider a whole line integrator with professional ability of heat treatment. The key is whether the candidate can catch the process connection and result verification of the whole line.

The whole line integrator here is the unit responsible for connecting different equipment into a production system. Being able to make a mesh belt furnace indicates the direction of a device, which cannot prove that it can deliver the quenching and tempering lines you need; combining several quotations together does not mean completing the whole line design.

Are the fasteners suitable for mesh belt conveying?

Fasteners cannot be selected only by the two names of "bolt and nut". Material, specification range, shape, loading method and quality requirements should be included in the plan. Quenching and tempering usually refers to quenching and high-temperature tempering, but the specific process should be determined according to the material and product requirements, and quenching and tempering cannot be mixed with carburizing, carbonitriding and other routes into a general scheme.

If the product can be belt loading and continuously transported according to the confirmed method, and can still meet the loading and process conditions after changing the specifications, the mesh belt line will have the basis for further comparison. If long parts are easy to hook, small parts may leak, or complex shapes make it difficult to stack and load transfer, the feeding, dropping and loading methods should be verified first. Just expanding the furnace or replacing a wider mesh belt may not solve these problems.

Let the candidate first explain how to follow the complete line of common specifications, maximum specifications and difficult specifications, which is more useful than just looking at the appearance of a main furnace.

Furnace maker as lead: check the stages after quenching

For quenching and tempering lines that use liquid quenching and need to be cleaned and dried, they can be checked step by step along the "up-heating-quenching-cleaning and drying-tempering-unlewing". The specific settings of cleaning and drying are determined according to the medium and subsequent requirements, and the fixed list cannot be copied.

After the discharge capacity of the main furnace is improved, if the continuous heat load, discharge conveying or cleaning capacity of the quenching system are not matched together, the whole line may still fail to achieve the target output. The volume of quench tank and the conveying speed of the washing machine cannot replace the description of the processing capacity under the corresponding working conditions alone.

Therefore, if the furnace factory is ready to take the lead, it should be able to explain what workpiece and loading conditions each section is designed according to, how to receive the next section, which equipment is outsouted, and where the output is finally counted. For the qualified product output required by the purchaser, the product inspection conditions should also be written into the verification arrangement, and the main furnace should not only be promised how much weight the main furnace will pass per hour.

Integrator as lead: identify responsibility for heat treatment

When the new line needs to be connected to the original cleaning machine, packaging line, workshop conveying and data system, it will be an important task to design the connection conditions and manage the information and version of all parties. Such projects can be considered to be organized by the integrator, but it should be clear who judges the ability of the heat treatment process and equipment.

For example, the existing cleaning function does not mean that it can handle the workpiece, residue and continuous incoming materials brought by the new line. The integrator shall arrange the corresponding equipment party and process personnel to check the applicable conditions, indicating which equipment should be retained and which need to be modified. If only layout drawings and automated demonstrations are provided, but there is no explanation of heating, quenching and tempering conditions, the purchasing party still cannot judge whether the product requirements can be realized.

When the supplier changes or the product range changes, there should also be a clear person to recheck the whole line. The original plan explains that the changed working conditions cannot be automatically covered.

Compare three ways of organising the purchase

Purchasing method Conditions that can be considered What should be verified before signing the contract? What will it affect if it is not clear?
Mesh belt furnace manufacturer takes the lead New heat treatment equipment is the main construction, and the furnace factory can coordinate the support before and after. Each segment's capability and process connection, outser-purchased equipment management, and whole-line verification scope The main furnace has been delivered, and the peripheral still needs to be temporarily coordinated by the buyer.
The whole line integrator takes the lead Multi-brand equipment, existing equipment and workshop systems need unified access. Heat treatment professionals, applicability of old equipment, design and change management of each connection point Automation can be demonstrated, but the actual workpiece or production target cannot be verified.
Buyers purchase separately Own team can continuously manage process, connection design, progress and acceptance. Internal general manager, unified information version, joint verification arrangement of all parties The sub-item equipment has arrived, but there is no person in charge of the connection and joint adjustment work.

The external purchase of quench tank or washing machine itself does not constitute a reason for elimination. What is more worth asking is: according to who confirms the working conditions of the outser, who reviews the supporting equipment, and who organizes to deal with cross-equipment problems. Buyers can purchase by themselves, but the coordinated services saved must be supplemented by the internal team.

Ask for a complete production duty at the first meeting

You can first provide photos or drawings representing fasteners, material and specification range, incoming status, quenching and tempering and inspection requirements, target accepted output, shift, and existing equipment and plant layout. Let the candidate explain his work scope along the actual path of the workpiece, submit the distribution of labor and verification arrangements, and then compare the prices.
