133.titleEn: Choosing an annealing furnace for metal workpieces or semiconductor wafers
133.summaryEn: Metal workpieces and semiconductor wafers require different annealing equipment. Suneng can assess enquiries for either application. Specify the material or wafer, process, loading and site conditions before defining the design and scope of supply.
133.contentEn:
The procurement of annealing furnaces should first distinguish the processing object: the equipment requirements of metal workpiece and semiconductor wafers should not be mixed together. Both types of equipment needs can be evaluated to Suneng; first explain the material or wafer, target process, loading and on-site conditions, and then determine the plan and supply scope.

It is also called "annealing furnace", which does not indicate that the equipment structure, atmosphere, process record and acceptance requirements are the same. This article only sorts out the information required for procurement evaluation, and does not give general process parameters or on-site operation steps.

Metal annealing: material, incoming condition and workpiece objective

First, provide the material, the status of the incoming material, the shape and size of the workpiece, the loading method, the target process and the production cycle time. Cyclical furnace loading and continuous conveying are checked separately, and the equipment form needs to correspond to the workpiece, process and plant conditions.

The supply and demand sides confirm the equipment temperature performance, process record and workpiece inspection requirements respectively. You can't judge that all workpieces are applicable based on furnace temperature, power or single furnace name alone.

Semiconductor annealing: wafer and process requirements

For semiconductor wafer annealing requirements, we can first provide wafer and loading instructions, target process, temperature process, atmosphere, cleanliness and pollution control requirements, as well as process records and testing materials. If the existing equipment is supported or replaced, the structure and interface of the original equipment also need to be explained.

These inputs are used to determine the scope of evaluation and do not mean that the specific chip process verification has been completed. The actual equipment structure, applicable conditions, supply content and acceptance method shall be agreed separately, and the furnace type description or parameters of the metal workpiece shall not be directly applied.

Specify heat source, atmosphere and equipment design separately

Electric heating or gas is only the direction of the heat source, which is not enough to show the processing capacity of the whole furnace. Furnace loading or conveying, effective working zone, atmosphere, cooling, recording and public support should be confirmed one by one in combination with the processing object and project conditions.

When it involves existing equipment, provide the nameplate, original manufacturer, model, drawings and current usage materials, and then judge the scope of retention, replacement or addition. Metal and semiconductor equipment are evaluated separately, and the experience or test results of one project are not generalized to another type of object.

Information for a technical enquiry

What should I explain first?Metal workpiece demandDemand for semiconductor chips
Workpiece or materialMaterial, incoming material status, workpiece form and loadingChip and loading instructions, target process
Process and environmentProcess basis, temperature process, atmosphere and cooling requirementsTemperature process, atmosphere, cleanliness and pollution control requirements
Production organizationEach batch of loading or continuous cycle time, model change and on-site conditionsBatch, cycle time, loading organization and on-site interface
Acceptance and informationEquipment record and workpiece inspection are agreed separatelyThe process record, test data and acceptance method are agreed separately.
Procurement scopeEquipment, supporting, plant utilities and installation division of laborEquipment, supporting equipment, interface and project division of labor

You can send the above information first, explaining "metal annealing equipment" or "semiconductor annealing equipment". When the information is incomplete, communicate the missing items first, and then determine the plan, quotation and acceptance scope; do not use unified energy-saving ratios, fixed specifications or unconfirmed performance as procurement commitments.

For metal continuous annealing or solution treatment needs, you can refer to Annealing solution treatment production line; Other annealing equipment needs can be Submit workpiece or chip and project conditions, confirm the scope of application first.

Frequently asked questions

Can metal and wafer annealing use the same furnace and parameters?

It cannot be directly used based on the name of "annealing furnace" or the rated temperature. Metal workpiece should first check the material, incoming material status, loading and target process; the wafer should also clarify the wafer and loading instructions, process atmosphere, cleanliness and pollution control requirements. The two types of requirements confirm the structure of the equipment and the acceptance method respectively.

What should be compared first for batch loading and continuous conveying?

First explain the loading or continuous cycle time, workpiece form and replacement arrangement of each batch, and then check the temperature process, atmosphere, cooling and on-site matching. Wafer devices may also be processed in batches, but this does not mean that the selection conditions of metal batch furnaces can be directly apply.

What is the minimum information needed for an enquiry?

First, explain the processing object, target process, loading situation, production cycle time and on-site conditions. Metal workpiece replenishment material, incoming material status and size; wafer replenishment wafer and loading, cleanliness and pollution control requirements. The nameplate, model, drawing and interface information are also required for the renovation of old equipment; the missing items should be communicated first, and then the scope of quotation and acceptance should be clarified.

Sources

  • ASM International "Annealing of Steel" (Public Summary, 2013): It is used to show that steel annealing has different process objectives, and to distinguish between periodic and continuous annealing furnaces.
  • ASM International "Annealing and Recrystallization" (Public Introduction, 2016): It is used to explain that the material composition, cold processing status and processing history will affect the heat treatment response. Before selecting, the material and the incoming material status should be checked.
  • Tokyo Electron TELINDY Series Official Product Introduction: It is used to explain that the wafer heat treatment equipment will distinguish the wafer loading, batch organization and loading area environment, and consider particle control; do not use the specific specifications or performance data of the manufacturer.

The above quotations are limited to public abstracts and official introductions, which are used to illustrate the background of selection. The inquiry list in this article is a summary of procurement information. It is not a unified mandatory standard, nor does it prove that Suneng has completed the verification of a specific chip process; the specific process, supply and acceptance scope still need to be confirmed by project.

132.titleEn: How does a mesh belt hardening furnace work? Process temperature and fault assessment
132.summaryEn: The mesh belt carries a suitable load through the heating zones and into quenching and subsequent operations configured for the line. Product results also depend on material, loading pattern, effective heating time, cooling and downstream treatment.
132.contentEn:
The mesh belt quenching furnace is transported through the mesh belt, the workpiece suitable for belt loading is sent to the heating area, and then transferred to quenching and subsequent processes according to the specific unit configuration. The mesh belt is responsible for conveying, and each temperature zone provides the heating conditions required by the process; whether the workpiece can meet the requirements also depends on the material, belt loading, effective heating time, cooling and follow-up treatment.

All mesh belt furnaces cannot be understood as the same oil quenching line, and a unified process temperature cannot be given based on the number of power or subdivisions alone. This article explains the judgment conditions of procurement and fault communication, and does not provide operating instructions for belt threading, hot belt replacement, water leakage treatment or parameter modification.

Is this a single furnace or a multi-stage line?

Continuous heating, protective atmosphere treatment, and quenching, cleaning and tempering connection may be configured differently. When purchasing, first list what equipment the workpiece goes through from feed to discharge, and how the adjacent processes are connected, and then compare the quotation range.

Workpiece must be suitable for tiling or controlled stacking on the mesh belt. Easy card net, rolling, serious stacking or workpiece that requires a special material plate cannot be determined to be suitable just because the size is small; the corresponding conveying scheme should be compared through the workpiece and belt loading conditions.

Set belt speed, heating length and process time together

In the corresponding effective heating section, the speed of the mesh belt increases, which will shorten the passage time of the workpiece. Therefore, increasing the speed cannot be directly equivalent to increasing the accepted output; it is also necessary to check the belt loading status, temperature zone conditions, heat load and upstream and downstream cycle time.

The process temperature should be determined by the material, quality target and the corresponding process basis. How to allocate the temperature zone should be confirmed in combination with the specific furnace type, loading and verification requirements, and the set value of another furnace cannot be copied. The installed power cannot prove alone that a certain steel piece can be processed and qualified.

Match each issue to the relevant documents

Problems encounteredWhat to sort out first?Conclusions that cannot be drawn directly based on this
I want to confirm whether the workpiece is applicable.Material, shape, single piece quality, belt loading and target qualitySmall parts or enough power must be suitable.
Insufficient output or fluctuation of resultsFEEDING, SPEED, EFFECTIVE LENGTH, TEMPERATURE ZONE AND COOLING RECORDSpeeding up can increase accepted output.
Mesh belt delivery abnormalityEquipment structure, phenomenon location, load and maintenance recordsAll furnace models adopt the same belt threading or adjustment method.
I don't know how to set the temperature zone.Material process basis, equipment partition and verification recordIf the number of subdivisions is the same, the temperature can be copied.
There is an abnormality in the cooling systemActual cooling structure, alarm and existing inspection recordsIf the abnormality disappears temporarily, it means that the system is normal.

For specific measurement, maintenance or parameter adjustment, the person in charge shall check the documents of the machine and the applicable work procedures. In the absence of this part of the basis, the information table in this article cannot replace the on-site disposal plan.

Assess equipment performance separately from product results

Equipment operation records, temperature records and workpiece quality inspection have their own corresponding objects. Mesh belt can be transported continuously, which cannot prove that the workpiece has not collided, is not deformed or is fully qualified; replacing a part cannot automatically prove that the performance of the whole line has been restored.

The technical agreement should list the actual test workpiece, belt loading method, process conditions, equipment records and workpiece judgment requirements. When comparing the production capacity or the effect before and after processing, use comparable working conditions and indicate which conclusions come from equipment testing and which from workpiece verification.

When preparing for consultation, give the workpiece, process, belt loading, target cycle time and abnormal record first. Can be combined Mesh belt furnace equipment and configuration boundary Catch up Maintenance and renovation services for industrial furnaces Confirm what information is needed in the next step, and do not promise the specific processing effect when the information is insufficient.

131.titleEn: How to review operating and maintenance procedures for a gas-fired trolley furnace
131.summaryEn: Check operating and maintenance instructions against the individual gas-fired trolley furnace, its current configuration and load. Confirm responsibilities and trace maintenance, faults and acceptance records. A procedure’s title alone cannot establish that it applies.
131.contentEn:
The operation and maintenance procedures of the gas bogie hearth furnace, first check whether it corresponds to the equipment, the current configuration and the actual furnace loading conditions, and then see whether the maintenance responsibility, problem record and acceptance materials can be connected. Just by looking at the title of the file, you can't judge whether the procedure is applicable.

This article is used to check procurement and maintenance materials, and does not provide on-site start-stop, lifting, maintenance or commissioning steps. Specific operation and maintenance requirements shall be confirmed by the responsible professionals according to the instructions, drawings and on-site management requirements of the equipment.

Match the procedure to the heat source and furnace design

If the equipment is heated by gas, the file should be configured with the burner, gas supply, smoke exhaust and control of the furnace. The documents of electric heating equipment cannot automatically cover the requirements of the gas system.

It is also called bogie hearth furnace, and the drive and control configuration of the furnace door and furnace trolley may also be different. When checking, first match the nameplate, equipment model and actual configuration with the version of the instruction manual; a document lacks the relevant system description, which can only show that the information needs to be supplemented, and it cannot be judged that the on-site equipment does not have this system.

Verify loading limits for the specific furnace

If the shape of the workpiece changes with the furnace material or the support method, the confirmed loading range should be rechecked. The workpiece can be put into the furnace chamber, which does not mean that it is located in the effective heating area, nor does it mean that the furnace trolley, track and drive are suitable for this set of loads.

The effective heating area is the workspace confirmed according to the agreed temperature measurement conditions. When checking the loading information, the workpiece, pads and tools should be considered together; the total mass, fulcrum position and load distribution correspond to the confirmed equipment documents respectively. These conditions cannot be replaced by a set of general length, width and height margins.

Identify the basis for each maintenance interval

If the equipment configuration and usage conditions are different, the maintenance cycle in the old article cannot directly become the maintenance plan of this furnace. The project, cycle and record requirements of each component shall be approved by the responsible person in combination with the corresponding instructions, parts maintenance documents and actual use.

The person in charge of procurement or maintenance should check which document each plan is based on, who is responsible, and what records are left after completion. Writing "regular maintenance" alone can neither explain which parts are covered, nor can it help to trace the next maintenance.

After a retrofit, reconcile document revisions and issue records

If the equipment undergoes combustion system, control or furnace trolley mechanism transformation, it cannot be assumed that the original operation and maintenance documents are still fully applicable. The person in charge should check the scope of change and the corresponding information version, so as to avoid the actual configuration and documents being different.

The repair record should also distinguish the problems found, agree on the scope of handling, complete the record and review the conclusion. The record says "repair completed", which only indicates the work covered by the record; if there are other equipment performance or workpiece inspection requirements in the contract, the corresponding acceptance materials are also required, which cannot be replaced by the repair sign-off.

Checklist for the existing documents

Check the objectWhat information are you looking for?Align what?
Device identity and configurationNameplate, supply list, instruction manual versionWhether the model, heat source and actual configuration correspond
Workpiece and loading rangeLoading diagram, material information, confirmed load conditionsShape, workspace, fulcrum and load distribution
Control and protect dataCorresponding control files, alarm and protection instructionsDoes the file version override the current configuration?
Maintenance and repair planParts maintenance files, plans and historyBased on, responsible person, project and record requirements
Transformation and acceptanceChange the list, update the drawings, review and acceptance recordsScope of changes, legacy problems and confirmation results

What to prepare before contacting the supplier

You can first prepare the equipment nameplate information, the version of the instruction manual, the workpiece and loading materials, the alarm or repair records, and the specific problems you want to solve. The selection of the new furnace can be checked. Bogie hearth furnace product and program boundaries; The maintenance or renovation needs of existing equipment can be from Maintenance and renovation services Enter the communication.

130.titleEn: Carbon deposits in a mesh belt furnace: which operating and maintenance records should you check?
130.summaryEn: The appearance of a black deposit does not establish how it should be removed. Identify the location, process, medium, equipment design and previous abnormalities. The responsible personnel should define treatment and verification from the documents for that equipment.
130.contentEn:
If there is a black attachment in the mesh belt furnace, the cleaning method cannot be determined by the appearance alone. First confirm the location of the attachment, the use process and medium, the structure of the equipment and the abnormal records, and then the person in charge shall formulate the processing and review requirements according to the equipment document.

This article answers what should be prepared before carbon cleaning and how to check the processing scope. It does not provide carbon burning, atmosphere switching, opening air induction or other on-site operation steps.

Match the deposit location to the operating conditions

The attachments in the furnace, mesh belt, workpiece surface or other parts should be recorded separately. Only the sentence "the furnace is carbonized" cannot judge which systems the problem involves, and it is impossible to confirm whether they are all the same attachments.

Organize the existing photos, operation and maintenance records, and put the time of the problem together with the changes of workpiece, belt loading, temperature curve, atmosphere or use medium. The relationship in time is just to investigate the clues, and it can't be directly regarded as the reason that has been identified.

Use more than a fixed interval to define the cleaning scope

There is no fixed carbonization cycle applicable to all mesh belt furnaces. The maintenance arrangement should be confirmed in combination with the specific equipment description, conditions of use, actual status and the existing maintenance system, and the cycle, temperature or time of another equipment should not be copied.

The mesh belt, support, transmission, atmosphere and cooling configuration of the current equipment will also affect the parts that need to be checked. When the information is not complete, supplement the identity and structure information of the equipment first; when the original document is inconsistent with the site, check the transformation record together.

DataIssues that should be cleared
Nameplate, equipment description, structural drawing and renovation recordWhether it is the same device and the same version of the device is discussed.
The location of the attachment and the existing photos and abnormal recordsWhich parts are affected and when will the phenomenon appear?
Workpiece, belt loading, process and media recordWhat are the operating conditions when the problem occurs?
Records of previous cleaning, repair and replacementWhich parts have been dealt with and whether the problem occurs again
Maintenance and review requirements in equipment documentsWho will confirm the specific plan and how to verify it after completion?

Check that the original issue has been resolved

The completion of the cleaning work does not mean that the transportation and workpiece results have been restored. The review project shall be agreed upon according to the actual processing scope, and the records of the processing part, equipment status, conveying performance and applicable process verification shall be kept respectively.

If the problem occurs repeatedly, the before and after work conditions and processing records should be put together for further analysis. You can't just remember "cleaned up" at a time. The comparison should match the same workpiece, belt loading and process conditions as much as possible, otherwise it is difficult to judge whether the change comes from the processing work or the production conditions are different.

Agree the scope of work using the equipment records

You can first prepare the equipment model, the location of the attachment, the recent major changes, the past processing records and the planned maintenance window, and then refer to Mesh belt furnace structure and applicable conditions Catch up Maintenance and renovation services for industrial furnaces Communication information gaps and evaluation scope.

Whether to undertake the specific cleaning work, what method is adopted, and what personnel and supporting equipment are needed should be confirmed separately according to the equipment and on-site conditions. This article does not eq. the preliminary communication of the data is equivalent to the approval of the carbon cleaning plan.

129.titleEn: Choosing oil mist and exhaust treatment equipment for a mesh belt furnace
129.summaryEn: Identify the stage producing the fumes, the operating conditions, and the existing collection and discharge system. A furnace label or a choice between electrostatic and plasma equipment cannot establish either the design or the emissions outcome.
129.contentEn:
Mesh belt furnace supporting oil smoke and exhaust gas purification. First, it is necessary to clarify which section the smoke comes from, under what working conditions, what the existing collection and discharge system is like, and then compare the treatment equipment. Only report "for mesh belt furnace" or only select a certain name of electrostatic and plasma, which cannot determine the scheme, let alone prove the emission result.

This article is used to sort out procurement information. It does not provide the safety design and operation steps of the purification system, and does not say that a certain type of purifier is applicable to all heat treatment lines.

Identify the source at the actual process stage

The mesh belt furnace can be a single-stage heating equipment, or it can be connected to processes such as quenching, cleaning, tempering and cooling. What processes and positions on the project need to be collected and processed should be confirmed one by one according to the actual equipment, and the whole line should not be regarded as a flue gas source.

Put the location of occurrence, the corresponding process, production load and the existing collection method together, so that the supplier of the processing equipment can judge whether the information is sufficient. When the data is missing, first clarify what on-site investigation or testing is needed; the composition and processing capacity cannot be determined by the color of the flue gas or the sentence "the oil smoke is very large".

Compare treatment options against the evidence and site interfaces

The applicability of different treatment routes should be confirmed in combination with the existing exhaust gas information, operating conditions, maintenance conditions and risk assessment of the project. The name of the equipment, the material of the filter element or the material of the shell cannot replace the complete scheme alone.

When there are already pipes, fans, collection covers and discharge ports, it should be written which reservations, which are added, and who will check the supporting conditions. Only buy the processing host, but there is no clear collection end and connection range. The quotation looks cheap, and there may be work that is not included on site.

The information provided firstWhat is used to judge?
Equipment list, actual process and flue gas appearance locationDo you need to check different sources separately?
Workpiece, production cycle time, used medium and existing test recordsWhether the plan is based on the actual operating conditions
Existing hood, pipe, fan, discharge informationWho is responsible for the retention, addition and connection work?
Installation space, public conditions and maintenance arrangementsWhether the equipment can be connected and whether the maintenance work can be carried out
Emission requirements and acceptance responsibilities confirmed by the projectHow to agree on the test object, working condition, method and delivery evidence

The protection design involving risks shall be confirmed by the corresponding responsible personnel according to the actual equipment and project conditions. This article does not provide general practices for fire prevention, gas treatment or system commissioning.

Distinguish equipment delivery from emissions acceptance

The completion of equipment installation, fan operation or visual flue gas reduction only indicates part of the status respectively. If the contract stipulates the discharge results, it should be clearly written in which position, under what production conditions, and by who according to what project requirements, and keep the corresponding records.

At the same time, the working boundaries of the equipment supplier, the on-site supporting party and the testing party are listed. You can't use the sentence "with a purifier to meet the standard" instead of the testing and acceptance requirements of the project.

Direct each question to the responsible party

For the interface problem of industrial furnace and whole line, you can first sort out the workpiece, process, equipment arrangement and existing supporting materials, combined with Mesh belt furnace equipment and whole line boundary Communicate. The specific selection, supply and emission testing of purification equipment should be confirmed by the undertaking unit and the scope of responsibility in the project respectively.

This article does not declare that Suneng independently manufactures electrostatic or plasma purifiers, nor does it make a commitment to the treatment capacity of certain pollutants or emission standards.

128.titleEn: How to assess a mesh belt furnace when the belt tracks to one side
128.summaryEn: Evaluate the furnace under the agreed part, loading, temperature, atmosphere and cycle. Match design and acceptance evidence for the lining, heating, control, belt supports, drive, tensioning and guidance. If the belt drifts, identify where and when it happens and what recently changed.
128.contentEn:
To judge the quality of mesh belt furnace, first look at whether it can complete the process under the agreed workpiece, belt loading, temperature, atmosphere and cycle time, and then match the design basis, equipment record and acceptance requirements of the furnace body lining, heating temperature control, mesh belt support, transmission tension and guidance. When encountering belt mistracking, first clarify the location, the working condition and recent changes, and then check the equipment files of the corresponding parts.

This article first lists the procurement and diagnostic materials. For specific inspection, measurement and adjustment methods, the responsible personnel need to check the instructions, drawings and maintenance procedures of the equipment, and do not provide in-operation adjustment instructions or unified adjustment quantities.

Define the operating conditions for acceptable performance

Different workpieces and processes have different requirements for equipment. Before purchasing, write down the material, size, single piece quality, belt loading method, unit time feeding amount, process temperature and time, atmosphere, cooling and upstream and downstream interfaces. When comparing equipment, use the same set of working conditions and supply range.

Small parts that can stabilize tiling or controlled stacking can be evaluated in the mesh belt furnace scheme; workpieces that are easy to lag, roll down, severely stacked or need special support should be checked first. It cannot be determined that it is suitable for this project based on the name of the furnace, the width of the mesh belt or the appearance alone.

Link structural design, records and acceptance

The furnace shell, furnace lining and heating elements are worth checking, but the material brand or brand cannot prove the quality of the whole machine alone. It is necessary to ask whether the material selection corresponds to the long-term temperature, atmosphere, load and maintenance conditions, and whether the configuration is consistent with the workpiece process.

The mesh belt speed, effective heating length and process time need to be checked together; loading and support, cooling and front and rear processes should also be matched. If the parameters of a certain component are suitable, it does not mean that the whole line has reached a stable accepted output.

Check the itemsWhat information do you need first?What is used to judge?
Workpiece and belt loadingMaterial, size, single-piece quality, number of belt loading layers, feeding recordWhether the workpiece is suitable for this conveying method, and whether the scheme uses the same working condition.
Furnace body and furnace liningStructural description, material list, applicable temperature area and maintenance documentsWhether the material selection and structure base covers the agreed conditions
Heating and temperature controlTemperature zone layout, process requirements, temperature control records and agreed test methodsWhether the temperature zone and time correspond to the process, and whether the test evidence can be traced
Mesh belt, support and transmissionMesh belt material, support method, transmission and tension structure, loading conditionsWhether the continuous conveying configuration matches the load, and whether the maintenance responsibility is clear
Whole line and deliveryIncluding items such as cooling, cleaning or tempering, interface lists and acceptance documentsWhat equipment does the quotation cover, and who is responsible for the capabilities and final acceptance of each section?

This table is used to compare the completeness of the scheme and information. It is not a unified material specification, nor does it replace the technical agreement of specific equipment.

For belt drift, record the symptom, equipment arrangement and recent changes

First, sort out the existing records: belt mistracking occurs in the feeding, furnace, discharge or return position; whether it occurs at the same time as a certain workpiece, belt loading state or replacement time; whether to replace the mesh belt, adjust the support, maintain the transmission or change the feeding method recently. Without these backgrounds, it is difficult to confirm the reason by "mesh belt to one side" alone.

Then compare with the actual structure of the equipment. The old information mentioned the head and tail rollers, rollers and bearing seats; the current mesh belt equipment may also use sprockets, guides and other support arrangements, which should be subject to the drawings of the machine, and the adjustment method of the general conveyor belt should not be directly transferred to all mesh belt furnaces.

Data check partsWhat materials do you bring?What needs to be confirmed with the person in charge of the equipment?
Mesh belt and jointMesh belt specifications, replacement records, existing status photosWhether it is consistent with the original design, and whether there is any change before and after the abnormality
Support and loadSupport layout, belt loading method, feeding recordWhether the conditions of use correspond to the design, and whether the problem changes with loading
Transmission and tensionTransmission diagram, tension structure description, maintenance recordWhat is the structure of this machine, and what data needs to be verified according to the device file?
Head and tail guidance and returnRelevant drawings, existing inspection or maintenance recordsWhich real parts correspond to the abnormal position? It cannot be judged only by the general diagram.
Input and output interfaceRecord of loading and unloading material arrangement, replacement and abnormal occurrenceIs there a phenomenon that occurs at the same time as the change of conveying connection and belt loading?

These are data check items, not all devices to carry out the same on-site operation one by one. The specific measurement position, allowable deviation and processing order should be confirmed by the responsible person according to the local file.

Specify equipment tests and product results separately

Procurement acceptance should first agree on the conditions of workpiece, belt loading, process, continuous operation and supply interface, and then write down the test item, recording method, judgment basis and responsibility. Equipment temperature control or conveying test and workpiece quality inspection correspond to their respective requirements, and there is no need to record a single record to replace all the results.

When the existing equipment needs to be repaired, keep the work condition, maintenance and abnormal records before and after the problem; when purchasing new equipment, the supplier is required to match the material selection, configuration, interface, test and delivery materials to the same version of the scheme. The evidence that has not been obtained is listed as pending confirmation and should not be supplemented by verbal "good quality" or fixed energy-saving percentage.

What to prepare for a technical enquiry

Prepare workpiece and belt loading information, process requirements, target cycle time, equipment model and drawings, belt mistracking location and existing records. First judge whether it is the selection of new equipment, the existing transportation problem, or whether it involves the process and the whole line interface at the same time, and then organize the technical communication.

Can be compared The applicable conditions of the workpiece and process of mesh belt furnace, use again What parameters are required for the quotation of industrial furnaces? (in Chinese) Sort out the inquiry input. The product page is the manufacturer's public plan description, and the specific ability and acceptance results still need to be confirmed by the project information.

127.titleEn: Buying a heat treatment line: should a furnace manufacturer or an integrator lead the project?
127.summaryEn: A furnace maker may lead a clearly defined new thermal system if it can coordinate the relevant auxiliaries. For several brands, existing machines and plant management systems, consider a capable integrator. A buyer with a dedicated engineering team can also coordinate the purchase.
127.contentEn:
The heat treatment line mainly revolves around the in-furnace process and supporting load transfer, and when the furnace factory can undertake the whole line design coordination, coordination and result verification, it can be considered to be led by the furnace factory. When the project spans a variety of equipment, multiple suppliers and in-factory management systems, it can be considered to be led by an integrator with corresponding capabilities. If the buyer has an engineering team with continuous investment, he can also coordinate the procurement by himself.

The choice is based on where the complex links of the project are and who has the ability and willingness to take the corresponding responsibility. Whether the company is called "furnace factory" or "integrator", it cannot prove the ability to deliver the whole line.

When does each procurement arrangement fit?

Organization method More suitable conditions Evidence to be supplemented before purchasing What does the buyer still need to bear?
The furnace factory takes the lead The main difficulty lies in the coordination of heat treatment technology and equipment, and the scope of peripheral equipment is relatively clear. In addition to furnace manufacturing, it can explain the responsibility of supporting selection, control coordination and whole line coordination. Confirm the product process, on-site conditions and acceptance targets
The integrator takes the lead Multi-brand equipment, multiple logistics or multiple systems need to be coordinated. It can prove its professional support for heat treatment, equipment collaboration experience and problem handling mechanism. Provide requirements and on-site constraints, and review the overall scope and changes
The buyer coordinates by himself There is a team that can manage design, procurement, installation and joint adjustment, and is willing to directly control the sub-item procurement. Internal person in charge, interface management method, progress and acceptance arrangement Continue to coordinate with all parties and bear the organizational costs of omissions and connection problems.

The integrator here is to organize multiple sets of equipment into a unit of an operable system. The centralized procurement of equipment does not automatically include process design, on-site engineering or product quality assurance; these contents should still be agreed on one by one.

Furnace maker as lead: who coordinates auxiliaries?

The furnace factory understands the heating process, which can become one of the foundations of the whole line leader. However, the production line also has actual links such as front and rear conveying, cooling, cleaning, fixtures and data recording. It cannot be presumed that these tasks have been covered by the manufacturing capacity of the furnace alone.

Let the furnace factory mark the self-supply equipment, out-purchased supporting equipment and the buyer's existing equipment on the flow chart, and explain one by one who proposed the input conditions, who reviewed the connection design, and who organized the joint adjustment after installation. If the reply is limited to "supporting manufacturers will solve it", it also depends on whether the supporting manufacturers accept the same working conditions and delivery responsibilities.

Having external purchase support does not mean insufficient ability. What really affects the delivery is whether the leader has mastered the key design conditions and whether it can promote the solution when there is a problem, rather than pulling the buyer back to the state of multiple coordination.

Integrator as lead: who makes the process decisions?

When the project includes multiple devices and systems, unified coordination can reduce the inconsistency of different units' respective designs and versions. However, the coordination ability cannot replace the professional judgment of heat treatment.

The buyer should check: who converts the process requirements into equipment conditions, who is responsible for the equipment selection, what products and shifts the whole line output is accounted for, and which personnel jointly completes the product verification. If the integrator only gives the overall layout and automated demonstration, but does not have the corresponding professional and process basis, it is still impossible to confirm that the scheme is suitable for the current workpiece.

It is also necessary to confirm who will recheck the relevant equipment when the supplier replaces or changes the process. Changes in a certain section may affect the front and rear receiving materials and data records; only ensure that each equipment is normal, and it cannot prove that the adjusted whole line target is still valid.

Buyer-led procurement: what must the internal team provide?

Separate procurement can directly compare various equipments, and it is also convenient to follow the existing suppliers. However, the equipment will not naturally form a unified responsibility because they have signed separate contracts.

The buyer needs at least someone to continuously maintain the general plan and equipment conditions, manage the information version, arrange for all parties to attend, and promote the closure of common problems. If there is no person in charge for these tasks, the temporary coordination will be after the equipment is ready, and the original procurement costs saved may be offset by waiting, rework and repeated commissioning.

This is a project organization cost judgment, which does not mean that separate procurement is necessarily more expensive. The more mature the internal team and the existing standards, the more conditions the buyer can coordinate by himself; when there is a lack of corresponding manpower, the required coordination work should be clearly purchased into the scope of the service.

Ask the supplier to trace the line from drawings to acceptance

Choose a real representative workpiece and ask the candidate to explain according to the process: where the workpiece enters, which equipment passes through, how to hand it over to the next section, and where to calculate the production and verify the results. Each connection point is required to correspond to the drawings, supply responsibilities and acceptance projects.

For example, two devices need to exchange the operating status, and you can't just write "retared connection". It should be explained what information the two parties delivered, who completed the docking, what conditions were used for verification, and who took the lead in troubleshooting after failure. What is checked here is the delivery responsibility, which does not replace the specific control and safety design.

If there are unresolved project conditions, its impact on the program, the processing path and the responsible person should be listed; the conditions that have been clarified should be reserved for confirmation. Writing all unknown items as default satisfaction will delay the problem to the manufacturing or on-site stage; when no missing items are found, there is no need to add problems for form.

Assign responsibility for each agreed result in the contract

The general manager, the sub-item responsible party and the acceptance signatory should respond. Don't just agree that a company is "responsible for coordination", but also clarify what results are coordinated, what needs to be provided by all parties, and how to record and close the problem.

126.titleEn: How to choose a heat treatment line supplier and verify its claimed output
126.summaryEn: Verify the workpiece and process first. Ask what sustained output the complete line can deliver, what comparable evidence supports it and who will verify it. Furnace speed alone does not establish the rate of accepted product.
126.contentEn:
To choose the heat treatment line manufacturer, it is recommended to screen according to the order of "whether the process can be matched, whether the whole line can be continued, whether the evidence can be verified, and how to accept the results", and then compare the quotations of the same range. Before the former item is clear, don't be taken away by the low price, automated demonstration or factory photos of the latter item.

This order is suitable for new construction and renovation projects involving multiple processes or multiple equipment. It solves how to keep and eliminate candidate manufacturers, and does not presuppose that large-scale or high quotations must be appropriate.

Define the workpiece and process

Also called heat treatment line, it may be processed in batches of small parts, and it may also handle plates, long parts or strips. The shape, loading method, material and process of the workpiece are different, and the transportation, heating, cooling and post-treatment combinations required are also different. If the manufacturer has a certain type of production line, it does not mean that the existing plan can be directly transferred to your products.

First, provide all candidate manufacturers with the same version of information: product and material, size and weight range, incoming status, main process requirements, loading method and quality determination basis. Let the other party repeat how to deal with these workpieces in their own words, and distinguish between confirmed conditions, tentative assumptions and contents that still need to be tested.

Being able to point out the information gap is usually more helpful for plan judgment than the sentence "can do it all". If the key process requirements are still changing, the direction of the equipment can be discussed first; at this time, the selection and quotation need to be assumed, and cannot be regarded as a formal commitment that the conditions have been determined.

Verify output for the complete line

The main furnace can reach a certain discharge speed, but the front and rear equipment may not be able to continue continuously. Any actual link in loading, cooling, cleaning, tempering, testing or discharge may limit the final output. Therefore, it is necessary to ask the manufacturer to explain where the output number is calculated, which workpiece and shift it corresponds to.

For continuous production, pay attention to whether each process can be connected continuously under normal loading; for batch production, pay attention to how to arrange furnace loading, processing, load transfer, waiting and unloading. Both types of projects need to explain the time occupied by changing products, waiting for materials and planned maintenance. If the equipment is full of the ability to pass through the equipment for the whole year, you will not get a reliable annual delivery capacity.

When comparing, pay special attention to: some schemes write the processing weight, some write the quantity of pieces; some write the theoretical ability, and some write the quantity of qualified products. Only when the object, statistical time and quality judgment are consistent, the output commitment can be compared in the same table.

Request evidence for comparable experience

Photos of similar projects can prove the existence of a certain equipment appearance, but cannot prove that the process, production capacity and scope of responsibility are similar to you. The customer's name cannot replace the specific technical evidence.

You can ask the manufacturer to provide authorized or desensitized process descriptions, equipment composition, design file style and corresponding test records. Focus on follow-up questions: what are the similarities, what conditions are different, and how to deal with these differences this time. When it comes to transformation, you should also check the information of old equipment, the scope of retention and the conditions for discontinued production, and you can't just look at the list of new equipment.

There is no exact same case, and there is no need to eliminate it immediately; but the manufacturer needs to propose an executable verification arrangement. On the other hand, there is a lot of information that cannot correspond to the current workpiece, and it cannot be considered that the risk has been eliminated.

Agree how delivery results will be demonstrated

Factory inspection, on-site adjustment and product verification answer different questions. Confirm the agreed equipment and functions at the factory stage, confirm the connection and operation after installation in the on-site stage, and the product verification also needs to correspond to the requirements of workpiece, loading, process and inspection.

If the procurement target includes stable output and product quality, it is necessary to write in advance what products to verify, how long it lasts, how to count, how to judge, and how to deal with it if the agreement is not reached. The specific value is determined by the project document; don't just write "meet the production requirements", and wait for the equipment to arrive and explain it separately.

Documents and training should also be included in the delivery. Lack of drawings, use of maintenance materials or agreed program backup, even if the equipment can run temporarily, the subsequent transformation, troubleshooting and spare parts management may still be affected.

Record the decision after each stage

Screening order Require the materials given by the manufacturer Conditions that can continue to be compared Situations where conclusions cannot be drawn for the time being
Process adaptation Workpiece and process understanding, equipment process, matters to be confirmed The plan covers the main products, and the assumptions and missing items are clear. Only the general furnace type is given, and there is no explanation of how to deal with the current workpiece.
Output matching Process capacity, shift and replacement arrangement, production caliber The counting position is consistent with the statistical conditions, which can explain the restriction link. Only report the maximum speed of the main furnace or the theoretical annual output.
Empirical evidence Similar information or verification plans that can be authorized to be verified The evidence can correspond to the main risks and the difference in this project. Only photos, customer names and promotional numbers
Responsibility for acceptance Phased testing, judgment basis, documents and problem handling Buyers and sellers have the same set of judgments on "completion" Only promise to run, without the scope of result verification.
Scope and price Including, not including, the list provided by the buyer and to be confirmed The main input and delivery scope has been unified. The quotation is different, and the total price is still directly compared.

When to compare supplier location and price

After the previous screening, it is easier to compare the price, delivery date and service distance. Close distance is conducive to arranging on-site communication, but it cannot replace the corresponding process capabilities; more configurations are not necessarily more suitable. If the additional functions do not meet the production needs, it will only increase investment and maintenance matters.

The specific plan and delivery conditions need to be confirmed by both parties.

125.titleEn: Who should you consult about a custom furnace chamber or an unusual heat treatment process?
125.summaryEn: For a custom furnace, start with actual workpieces, loads, fixtures, handling clearance and process conditions. Identify which requirement makes the design non-standard and who can verify it before comparing chamber sizes and quotations.
125.contentEn:
If you want to customize a furnace chamber or a heat treatment furnace with a special process, you can first contact Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. and AICHELIN Heat Treatment System (Beijing) Co., Ltd. to communicate the plan. Suneng is engaged in the design, manufacture and system integration of industrial furnaces and heat treatment equipment; the official website of AICHELIN provides heat treatment systems adapted to process needs. Both companies can be used as preliminary contacts, but whether to undertake your project still depends on special requirements, design boundaries and verification conditions. It cannot be determined that it can be delivered by "accepting customization" alone.

This article is compiled by Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Engineering Technology Team, and Suneng is also a candidate enterprise in the article. Candidate enterprises are listed according to the business data that can be checked this time, which does not constitute an independent ranking. When choosing a non-standard furnace manufacturer, the key is to ask the other party to explain: which requirements have mature implementation methods, which need to be redesigned, and which must be verified first.

Find a supplier for the special requirement

If the main change is the shape of the workpiece, the loading method or the on-site layout, you can communicate with Suneng about the scope of equipment design and system integration first. If the requirements involve the combination of specific processes and periodic and continuous equipment, you can also put forward system adaptation requirements to AICHELIN. AICHELIN's Industrial heat treatment system and component page There are multi-use furnaces, pit furnaces, roller hearth furnaces and auxiliary equipment.

This is just the order of contact, which does not mean that the two companies can replace each other. First, send the material, processing purpose, workpiece shape, loading method and target output to the candidate, and then ask him to clarify the scope that can be undertaken. If there is a relevant furnace type, it means that technical communication can continue; if there is a design and verification record close to the working condition, it is more suitable to judge whether the plan is suitable.

Check the actual load envelope in a custom chamber

The shape of the workpiece can be put into the furnace chamber, which does not mean that the furnace can complete the required process. Loading rack, support, loading and unloading tools, heating parts and necessary gaps will take up space; equipment with circulation systems should also consider the impact of loading on the flow channel. The length, width and height of the furnace chamber cannot be directly regarded as the allowed loading range.

The purchasing party shall ask the manufacturer to mark the workpiece, fixtures, allowed loading range, furnace door channel and equipment structure on the same layout drawing. Then clarify which effective working zone the temperature uniformity requirement is for - that is, the space agreed by both parties to meet the temperature requirements.

If the original loading or airflow organization is changed in order to stuff the workpiece, the test results in another loading state in the past cannot be directly followed. This judgment will affect the arrangement, heating and circulation scheme of the furnace chamber, as well as the quotation. It cannot be solved until the equipment is finished.

An unusual process can change the complete configuration

Within the range of constant temperature level, structural capacity and loading method, a small adjustment of the size may mainly affect the material and manufacturing workload. However, if the temperature level, atmosphere requirements, workpiece weight or load transfer method is changed, the material, sealing, heating, mechanical and control configuration may be changed at the same time, and the quotation of "lengthening the standard furnace" cannot be applied.

Therefore, before the quotation, it is necessary to distinguish which are the process conditions that must be met and which are the structural preferences that can be negotiated. For example, the quality target of the workpiece that must be met can be replaced by the size of the furnace that is convenient for manufacturing; the customer's preferred opening direction can be combined with the loading and unloading route and the on-site space comparison scheme. When involving special media and hot handling, the manufacturer is required to explain the responsibility of special design and review, and do not replace the safety design with the purchase list.

Special requirements What should be handed over by the manufacturer? What does the purchaser judge based on this?
Furnace chamber shape or workpiece special shape Layout drawing with workpiece, fixtures and loading and unloading channels Whether it can be loaded and unloaded, and whether the actual working area is sufficient
Temperature program or atmosphere requirements are special Corresponding instructions for process requirements and equipment configuration Which conditions have been met and which still need to be verified?
Heavy loading, complex combination or large change Agree on the loading conditions and the corresponding design and verification arrangements Can the evidence of the old plan be applied to this loading?
Requires fixed output or shorter turnover Including the cycle description of loading and unloading, heating, insulation and cooling Are there any restrictions outside the process time in the furnace?
Site height, passage or energy restrictions Overall layout and on-site access conditions Does the equipment have the conditions for installation and operation after arrival?

This table is used for procurement communication and does not give general gaps, bearing values or safety operation requirements; the specific values should be determined by the design and verification of this project.

How to assess a supplier without an identical previous furnace

It is difficult to find the same old equipment for non-standard projects under each condition. The conditions that most affect success or failure can be compared: whether the material is similar to the purpose of processing, whether the cross-section of the workpiece is close to the loading, whether the temperature is consistent with the atmospheric requirements, and whether the loading and unloading method is similar to the on-site restrictions.

Differences do not automatically deny manufacturers, but there must be a way to deal with the differences. For example, the old data only proves the temperature performance in a certain light load state, which cannot be used to ensure the result of intensive loading of this project. The manufacturer should explain what calculations, sample tests or stage verifications need to be supplemented, and how to adjust the plan when the verification does not meet the target.

Sample tests also have boundaries. The small sample results can help judge the direction of the process, but it cannot automatically prove the consistency of full furnace loading, continuous production and batch. The purchaser shall distinguish between process feasibility, equipment performance and product results under the agreed production conditions in the technical agreement, and write down the verification object, basis and responsibility respectively.

Document the requirements so they can be verified

It is recommended to prepare workpiece diagram or desensitization shape diagram, material and initial state, processing purpose, existing process requirements, loading and output, on-site size and energy conditions. Temporarily uncertain items can be marked, and the manufacturer will list the assumptions and their impact on the program, price and delivery date.

When entering the formal comparison, you should at least get the plan description, equipment scope, matters to be verified and acceptance arrangements corresponding to the requirements of the same version. If the key special requirements are still not realized, it is appropriate to complete this part of the evaluation first before determining the configuration of the whole machine; otherwise, the low quotation may only be temporarily not included in the work of solving the problem.

124.titleEn: Which suppliers should you approach for a turnkey heat treatment line?
124.summaryEn: For a turnkey line, identify the lead for process design and individual machine interfaces. Ask who supplies the furnace, quench tank, crane and fixtures, and who coordinates installation, integrated trials and acceptance of the agreed result.
124.contentEn:
If you want to hand over the furnace, quench tank, driving and fixtures to one docking company, you can first contact Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. and Jiangsu Fengdong Thermal Technology Co., Ltd. to check the scope of equipment systems that each can undertake. The business or product information of the two companies provides a basis for entering the program communication; whether to accept the unified supply and overall delivery of these four items also needs to be confirmed in writing by the manufacturer in combination with your workpiece, process and on-site.

When purchasing, it is necessary to further clarify the "one-family docking": who unifies the cooperation between the design equipment, who manages the external procurement support, who organizes on-site coordination, and who is responsible for the agreed results. Only four equipment quotations are placed in one file, and there may still be no one responsible for the connection work.

Which manufacturers should be considered initially?

The following are the communication objects based on relevant business or products, not the turnkey ability ranking.

Factory The scope of communication based on this Focus on verification when contacting
Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. Industrial furnace and heat treatment equipment design, manufacturing, system integration, installation and commissioning, transformation and after-sales support Who provides the furnace body, quenching equipment, fixtures and load transfer equipment of this project; whether to accept the unified docking of the equipment system and what results are responsible
Jiangsu Fengdong Thermal Technology Co., Ltd. The page of the continuous roller furnace on the official website is composed of loading, preheating, heating, quenching, tempering, unloading, etc. The main purpose is large-scale forging quenching and tempering. Is your workpiece suitable for this continuous conveying method? If you need driving load transfer and special fixtures, do you need to design or support it separately?

Suneng's business scope and project direction can be passed through Continuous heat treatment line page (in Chinese) Further communication; see the above product composition of Fengdong Continuous roller furnace page. The product page can only be used as a preliminary basis, and cannot replace the supply commitment and acceptance certificate of the current project.

Trace workpiece movement before selecting equipment

"Furnace plus quench tank" sounds similar. In fact, it may be continuous transportation, or it may be batch furnace loading, and the process connection is completed by load transfer equipment. The two organizational methods have different requirements for equipment arrangement, fixtures and handling arrangements.

If your workpiece needs to be loaded transfer with fixtures, the manufacturer should use workpiece, fixtures and load transfer methods as a set of inputs, indicating which positions and links the workpiece needs to wait from loading to discharge. Otherwise, the furnace chamber is quoted according to one loading method, and the quench tank and the driving are configured in another way, and it will be found that it cannot be matched at the scene.

The above-mentioned page of the continuous roller furnace in Fengdong also explains that the product does not use fixtures such as material plates and tools. Therefore, this page cannot be used as a proof of the scope of supply of "car plus special fixtures"; this does not mean that the manufacturer has no other plan. Continuous roller conveying products cannot replace the driving scheme with "with quench tank" alone. The form, batch and process route of the workpiece should be confirmed first, and then judge whether to adopt the existing product direction or to reorganize the equipment system.

Assign four groups of equipment responsibilities

Object What needs to be explained in the plan? I didn't say clearly what is easy to affect.
furnace Loading method, process requirements, entry and output direction and connection with the next process of workpiece and fixtures The furnace can complete the heating, but the process after discharge cannot be continued.
Tank quench and supporting Corresponding workpiece batch, process requirements, supporting system and on-site handover location Only compare the price of the trough, and miss the supporting equipment needed to achieve continuous production.
Driving and load transfer equipment Whether the manufacturer supplies or the buyer has it; who is responsible for the selection, layout, installation and relevant certificates? The furnace factory, the supporting party and the buyer use different on-site conditions and each thinks that the work has been completed.
fixtures Who designs, who produces, covers which products, and how to cooperate with furnace loading and load transfer A single workpiece can be put in, but the batch loading and remodeling cannot be completed according to the plan.

This table is used to divide the procurement responsibility, and does not give the lifting, load-bearing or equipment operation parameters. The specific design and verification are completed by the corresponding professionals according to the project.

When inquiring to Suneng, you can ask directly: "If quench tank is equipped with a lifting device, does this quotation also include workshop driving and special fixtures?" Please ask the manufacturer to list these three items separately, and each item should indicate who supplies, who installs, and who leads the commissioning with the whole line. If the vehicle uses the buyer's existing equipment, please also indicate who will check whether it can be compatible with fixtures and quench tank. The specific items that Suneng undertakes in this project shall be subject to the list confirmed in writing by both parties.

Who coordinates externally supplied equipment?

Equipment system suppliers can use the products of professional supporting manufacturers. The key to judging is not whether all the parts are manufactured in the same factory, but whether the leading party can put forward supporting requirements, audit the connection conditions, manage the version, and organize the supporting parties to solve the problem.

For example, the driving supplier has completed its own equipment inspection, which does not automatically prove that it has met the load transfer arrangement of this heat treatment line. The leader should also explain how the whole line is adjusted, which workpieces are used for verification, and who promotes rectification when connection problems are found. If the buyer still needs to coordinate all the supporting parties by himself, the actual service scope of the procurement is different from "one company responsible for the whole line".

Distinguish a turnkey equipment package from plant construction

Equipment supply, equipment installation and plant foundation, water and electricity preparation may be borne by different units. When making an inquiry, it should be required to list "including, not including, provided by the buyer, to be confirmed" item by item, and the handover location should be drawn in the layout materials. If the missing part is made up later, the total price and construction period will be changed, and the low price will lose its comparability.

Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. Do not directly undertake the general contracting of the project. Involving off-furnace engineering and professional support, the undertaker should be determined according to the project, and Suneng's equipment system integration business cannot be written as all-inclusive work in the factory.

For the initial consultation, you can first provide the material, shape and weight of the workpiece, the process route, the target output, the fixtures to be used, the current driving situation and the factory layout. Let the candidate manufacturer first reply "which equipment can be coordinated, which needs to be matched, and how to accept the whole line", and then enter the quotation in the same range. The communication will be more effective.

123.summaryEn: Choose a Jiangsu supplier by matching the workpiece and process, production lots and changeovers, loading and transfer, and the site interfaces for a new build or retrofit. Compare offers against the same conditions and deliverables.
123.contentEn:
Jiangsu industrial furnace factory recommends that first determine the direction of equipment according to the process requirements and batch and replacement situation, and then compare the supply scope of new construction or transformation.. If it involves the design and manufacture of industrial furnace equipment, supporting integration or transformation, you can first contact Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. Communication; You can learn about Jiangsu Fengdong Thermal Technology Co., Ltd. for atmospheric furnaces and vacuum furnaces; you can learn about Northen Thermal Technology (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd. for multi-use furnaces, gas nitriding furnaces and other directions. Whether it is suitable or not needs to be checked in combination with workpiece, furnace loading and acceptance conditions.

This article is compiled by Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Engineering Technology Team, and Suneng is also within the scope of candidates. "Recommendation" refers to the direction that deserves further verification. It is not an independent evaluation or the manufacturer's rang, nor does it mean that the factory inspection has been completed for the buyer.

Turn a general furnace enquiry into a defined purchase

The name of the industrial furnace is the same, but the task may be much worse. Workpiece only needs to complete the established heating and insulation, which is different from the system involved that needs to control the surface state and achieve the specified cooling process. The purchasing party should first clarify the materials, process objectives and complete processes, instead of just giving the maximum temperature and the size of the furnace chamber.

For example, when the project has clear requirements for atmosphere or vacuum conditions, these requirements will affect the furnace structure, medium or vacuum system, control and acceptance configuration. They may affect the scheme more than a small adjustment of the length of the furnace chamber. Only when the furnace type, temperature level, structure and process boundaries are basically the same can it be suitable for further horizontal comparison of size and price.

What to check with each of the three candidates

Candidate manufacturers and sources Checkable public direction Item conditions that the buyer should supplement
Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. Open business scope: industrial furnace and heat treatment equipment design, manufacturing, system integration, transformation and after-sales support Workpiece and process, stand-alone or complete range, new construction or renovation, on-site interface
Jiangsu Fengdong Thermal Technology Co., Ltd. Official website atmosphere furnace, vacuum furnace and other categories Material, surface or organization target, atmosphere or vacuum requirements, cooling method
Northen Thermal Technology (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd. Official website multi-use furnace, gas nitriding furnace and other categories Specific process, loading organization, supporting process and process record requirements

The third-party catalog only proves that the enterprise has publicly displayed these directions, but does not prove the price, delivery date, quality results or order status of this order. Manufacturers may have cross-business. The above table does not exclusively share a certain type of process to a certain company, nor does it restrict the purchaser to add other candidates with evidence.

Match batch size, changeovers and loading to the production pattern

There are many varieties of workpiece, and the process of different batches is different. We should focus on how to arrange the replacement of production, how to replace fixtures, and how to distinguish each batch of records. For the task of continuous process and batch stability, it is necessary to further check whether the loading and unloading, heating, cooling and subsequent processes can keep up with the same cycle time.

You can't directly deduce the need to use continuous lines just because the planned annual output is large. If the variety is switched frequently and the pre- and post-process cannot be continuously supplied, the hourly capacity marked by the equipment may not be converted into planned output. We can't just compare the heating capacity of a single furnace, because the loading and unloading waiting or cooling link may limit the whole process chain.

Therefore, the requirements sent to all candidate manufacturers should include common batches, maximum batches, shifts and replacements at the same time. Otherwise, suppliers may quote according to different production organizations. It seems to be the same demand, but in fact they compare different tasks.

Clarify interfaces for custom equipment and retrofits

When the new equipment needs to connect the existing driving, fixtures or front and rear processes, the loading and unloading path, position connection and responsibility boundary should be confirmed. The renovation of the old furnace also needs to explain the original equipment information, current situation, transformation target and allowed time to stop production. On-site constraints may affect whether the original structure can be retained, and may also change the construction and commissioning arrangements.

This kind of project is not suitable for just asking "how much is one". The manufacturer should first be asked to explain which parts can be judged according to the existing information, and which parts need to be supplemented, checked or checked on the spot, and then form included items and non-included items.

If the quotation describes the furnace body in detail, but does not say who handles the connection with the existing equipment, the coordination work undertaken by the purchaser may increase. The total price should be compared after completing the interface, instead of mistaking the missing item for a price advantage.

Compare deliverables under the same duty

It is recommended to use a demand form to inquire from the candidate manufacturer, and ask them to return the plan assumption, equipment composition, supply boundary, acceptance arrangement and matters that require the buyer's cooperation at the same time. The commitment to temperature, yield or process results should be clear about the test object and conditions; the records of other projects can assist in judging experience and cannot replace the acceptance of this project.

The order of comparison can be: whether the process is adapted, whether the key shortcomings can be made up, whether the supply and interface are complete, how to implement the acceptance, and finally look at the price and delivery date. When an item is not confirmed for the time being, it should be kept in the list to be clarified, and the answer should not be replaced by "strong comprehensive strength".
