122.titleEn: Buying your first heat treatment furnace: which credentials and records should you request?
122.summaryEn: For a first furnace purchase, verify the supplier’s identity and applicable credentials, process suitability, evidence from comparable deliveries and long-term service arrangements. Compare prices once the requirements and scope of supply match.
122.contentEn:
When buying a heat treatment furnace for the first time, it is recommended to screen the manufacturers in the order of "main body and necessary qualifications, process adaptation ability, project acceptance evidence, and service agreement". The certificate is used to check the corresponding qualifications or management scope, whether it can meet your production requirements, and also depends on the scheme and verification results for the workpiece. First, screen out the plan that is not suitable for this project, and then compare the price within the same delivery range, so that it is not easy to buy a furnace that is fully certified but can't be used.

Define the application before listing necessary qualifications

When making an inquiry, at least tell the manufacturer the material and size of the workpiece, the purpose of heat treatment, the process requirements, the loading and production cycle time, and the energy available on site. With the same furnace chamber size, different processing objects, furnace loading density or process requirements may change the heating, circulation, control and handling configuration, and the price will lose its direct comparability.

The qualification list should also be determined with the procurement object: does the supplier only provide the furnace, or does it also undertake the supporting equipment, installation or other work? When it involves special licensing, certification or customer-designated requirements, both parties shall confirm the scope of application one by one according to the actual equipment and undertakings. It cannot be generally determined that all heat treatment furnace manufacturers must hold the same "production license", and it cannot replace the verification of all matters with one certificate.

The enterprise name and registration information can be through The entrance of the national enterprise credit information publicity system provided by the General Administration of Market Supervision Check. First, it depends on who quotes, who signs the contract, and who delivers; if the subject is different, the relationship and responsibility should be clearly explained. Manufacturing is written in the business scope, which is a clue for further verification and cannot replace the on-site and manufacturing records.

Separate credentials, capability and demonstrated results

ISO 9001 is a quality management system standard, which shows that the certification is for quality management and does not directly give the temperature, energy consumption or workpiece qualification guarantee of this furnace. ISO official supply chain description There is a clear distinction in this regard. When checking, you should check the scope, validity period and current status of the certificate. The validity of the certificate can be reviewed through the inquiry method published by the issuing agency; for the certificate issued in accordance with the certification rules formulated by the State Accreditation and Supervision Commission, the basic information can also be queried on the website of the National Accreditation and Supervision Commission. Certificates issued according to the rules formulated by the certification body shall be inquired in the manner provided by the institution. The difference here is the purpose of inquiry and the scope of application, which will be implemented from September 30, 2026.Certification Certificate Information Inquiry Management Announcement 。

Materials such as patents or high-tech enterprises can be used as a supplement to understand the technical background of the enterprise; whether to solve your process problems still depends on the correspondence between the relevant technology and equipment. The following order is suitable for organizing information at the time of first procurement, and the specific threshold shall be subject to the applicable requirements of this project.

Screening level Suggested evidence How to advance after judgment
Subject and necessary conditions Enterprise registration information, relevant certificates and scope of application Clarify the identity, status and scope first; the necessary conditions that are not clear are not considered to have been met.
Process adaptability Plans, key configuration instructions, and manufacturing division of labor for your workpiece See if the design selection is interpreted; only supplement the targeted explanation when giving general samples.
Comparable delivery results Desensitization test, acceptance and problem closure records of equipment with similar conditions Look at the object, conditions and actual results; make up the verification arrangement of this project when the difference is large.
Service and long-term use Installation and commissioning, training, spare parts, maintenance division of labor and cost agreement It depends on who takes over the fault and how to deal with it; verbal commitment to implement executable matters

Which conditions would change the equipment design?

If the workpiece and temperature conditions are clear, first ask whether the loading, atmosphere, heavy handling, automation or special acceptance requirements change the equipment system. For example, from human fixtures unloading to automatic load transfer, it is necessary to consider the mechanism, action connection and on-site space at the same time, and you can't just compare the price of the furnace. Ordinary size changes may also affect the materials used; once the carrying capacity, transportation or on-site capacity is exceeded, the size may also become a decisive factor.

The manufacturer should explain why these options are suitable for this project and list the on-site conditions you need to cooperate with. If you only repeatedly emphasize high power and fast heating, but do not explain how much to install, how to install, and in what state to verify, the plan still lacks the basis of comparison. The power number cannot prove that the target cycle time has been reached alone, and the furnace chamber can be put in, which cannot prove that the loading method is suitable for the process alone.

Look beyond photographs to test conditions and results

When viewing similar equipment, first compare the workpiece, heat source, loading method and process requirements, and then check whether the record corresponds to the same equipment and the same test stage. Information with similar conditions is more valuable for reference, but historical acceptance still does not mean that the new equipment has met the standard.

Before purchase, it should be agreed how to verify the performance of the equipment, who will test the results of the workpiece, and how to deal with those who do not meet the requirements. If the furnace temperature record is qualified, it is not automatically equal to the hardness, structure or deformation of the workpiece, because the material status, loading, process and cooling will also affect the result. When only providing delivery photos or receipts, first ask if there are other performance records; the temporary lack of information does not mean that the work has not been completed, but it cannot be confirmed that it is qualified.

For special working conditions without directly comparable cases, sample verification or phased confirmation can be discussed. It is more helpful to explain the object, conditions and basis for verification than to force a similar project photo.

Compare the scope of delivery and support in service

When comparing quotations, installation, commissioning, training, random materials, spare parts and on-site work undertaken by the buyer should be listed on the same list. If one less job is included, the purchase price may be lower, but the follow-up arrangements and expenses will fall to the buyer. After-sales service should also be clear about the contact person, remote and door-to-door processing methods, response agreements and cost boundaries; the company's proximity does not automatically mean that it can be present immediately.

Does the supplier identify the outstanding questions?

The purchaser only said "I want a heat treatment furnace", and the supplier reported the definite configuration. It seems that the communication is very fast. In fact, the workpiece, furnace loading and output may have been assumed without explanation. In the future, once the actual conditions are different, the price, size, heating and loading and unloading plan may change.

A more useful answer should explain what the existing information can determine, what conditions need to be made up, and what these gaps will change. If several manufacturers have different assumptions, first unify the demand and then compare the quotation; otherwise, the cheaper plan may only be calculated according to a smaller task range.

Does the manufacturing evidence match the proposed scope?

When inspecting the factory, you can look at the manufacturing conditions, but what is more worth asking is: where the key process of this project is completed, who is responsible for the design change, which supporting equipment needs to be purchased from outside, and how to complete the assembly and inspection.

The factory does not automatically prove the adaptation of a certain process; the appearance of the whole equipment is similar, which does not mean that the insulation, circulation, control or bearing design is the same. If the other party only has similar photos, it should be recorded as a preliminary clue and continue to make up for it; if there is manufacturing process information, it is still necessary to agree on the inspection and acceptance of this project, and the results of other orders should not be transferred directly.

How will performance and delivery be verified?

"Stable temperature", "high production capacity" and "good service" all need to be checked content. Temperature performance should bind the working area, temperature, loading and measurement conditions; the production capacity should explain the workpiece, cycle time and operating conditions at the time of calculation or verification; the on-site service should clarify the contact entrance, on-site conditions and scope of responsibility.

If these conditions are not clearly written, the judgment of the equipment when leaving the factory and after the buyer is put into production may be different, and the two sides are also prone to repeatedly argue about whether it is completed or not. Ask which operations are performed in-house

A heat treatment furnace includes parts such as furnace body, insulation, heating, machinery, electrical control and instrumentation. The manufacturing division of labor discussed here should be specific to this equipment: who designs the structure, who makes the furnace body, who assembles, who compiles or maintains the control procedures, and who organizes the whole machine inspection.

Purchasing instruments, motors or other professional parts is a different scope of collaboration with entrusting the whole machine to another company for manufacture. Even if there is an external arrangement for the whole machine, we should continue to check the design control, process inspection and quality responsibility, instead of judging the quality of the equipment by the word "outsourcing" alone.

The purchaser can change the question "Do you do everything by yourself" to: "Which processes are completed in our factory, which external cooperation, and where is the whole machine assembled and inspected?" This kind of answer is convenient for on-site verification, and it can also be seen whether the quotation misses the key collaborative responsibility.

Compare in-house work, subcontracting and brand supply

The following table shows the procurement check method, not the legal classification of enterprises; different orders from the same manufacturer may also adopt different arrangements.

The arrangement explained by the other party What evidence should be supplemented? What judgment can the evidence support?
Complete the key processes by yourself This process list, manufacturing location, physical goods in production and corresponding inspection records Check whether the so-called process is actually undertaken and recorded.
Parts procurement or process external cooperation The scope, technical requirements, purchase or process inspection arrangement of external procurement Check whether the interface requirements are transmitted and verified after return.
The whole machine is entrusted to other enterprises to manufacture Actual manufacturer, scope of entrustment, design and acceptance division of labor Confirm whether the purchaser can verify the real manufacturing process
Supply by the seller's brand Brand, sales, manufacturing, warranty subject and mutual responsibility See whether the technical and service responsibilities behind the brand can be caught up with people and documents.

Several arrangements in the table may overlap. The brand name is different from the manufacturer, and it does not automatically indicate that the equipment is not qualified. What really needs to be alerted is that the contract party is unwilling to explain the actual manufacturer, but cannot provide design, process and acceptance information.

Match the documents to one identifiable machine

After obtaining the license and making confidentiality arrangements, you can choose a similar equipment that is being manufactured or has been recorded, and check the requirements, drawing version, parts or process records and the inspection results of the whole machine. Customer information can be hidden, and the key point of checking is whether the file points to the same object and whether it is consistent after the change.

If you can only see the photos of the factory and equipment, you can't see their relationship with the supply documents, and the manufacturer's identity has not been found out. On the other hand, there is no equipment that is exactly the same on that day, and it cannot be asserted that the other party has no manufacturing capacity; it can be agreed to supplement the checkable information or follow-up manufacturing witness nodes.

The value of this action lies in reducing the information gap that "the display is a set of ability, and the actual delivery is another set of division of labor". It cannot replace the performance acceptance of this project.

Who handles problems after delivery?

When there is a deviation in the equipment, if the contract party only allows the buyer to contact the foreign cooperative factory by himself, there may be no one to coordinate the design change, program maintenance and rectification. Before signing the contract, it should be clear who will receive the problem, organize the analysis, provide information, coordinate the supporting party, and be responsible for the agreed rectification results.

Therefore, the verification of manufacturing identity ultimately falls into two things: the actual manufacturing process can be checked, and the project responsibility can be borne by someone. The self-made ratio itself is neither directly equal to quality nor replaces the acceptance conditions.

119.titleEn: How to verify in-house furnace manufacturing during a factory visit
119.summaryEn: During a factory visit, trace a specific furnace through design, fabrication, assembly and testing. Compare the actual equipment and identifiers with the records, and identify purchased components and subcontracted operations.
119.contentEn:
When selecting the supplier of the heat treatment furnace, the identity of the enterprise, the scope of the certificate and the actual manufacturing records should be connected and checked. The business license is used to confirm who to cooperate with, the quality management system certificate is used to understand the scope of certification, and the design, manufacturing, inspection and commissioning records are used to determine who completes the specific work. To judge whether to produce by yourself or outsource, the key is to match the furnace body, control and supporting equipment to the actual undertaking party one by one; a photo of the workshop or a sentence of "all self-produced" cannot complete the verification.

Verify each certificate and what it actually covers

First, check the correspondence between the quotation, contract, collection subject and enterprise registration information. It is not appropriate to directly determine that there is a problem with different names, but documents that can explain the relationship and responsibilities of the two parties should be obtained. Enterprise registration information can be from The official service entrance of the General Administration of Market Supervision Enter the public notice system to check, avoid only scanning the QR code sent by the salesperson; the certification certificate should be checked separately according to the following query scope.

When checking the quality management system certificate, look at the organization, address, certification scope, standard, validity period and current status one by one. The validity of the certificate shall be reviewed through the inquiry method published by the issuing agency; the basic information of the certificate issued according to the certification rules formulated by the State Accreditation and Supervision Commission can also be queried on the website of the State Accreditation and Supervision Commission. The purpose and scope of the two queries are different and should not be confused. Based on the implementation from September 30, 2026 Certification Certificate Information Inquiry Management Announcement 。

ISO 9001 is a quality management system standard. It focuses on how enterprises manage quality and cannot replace the performance qualification certificate of a furnace. ISO's supply chain description It also distinguishes between management system conformity and product conformity. Therefore, the scope of the certificate is designed and manufactured, and the actual evidence of this equipment should also be checked; the requirements of temperature, loading and production capacity must be implemented separately in the technical agreement and acceptance record.

What to inspect on the shop floor

Before the inspection, please ask the supplier to split the design, furnace manufacturing, furnace lining construction, control cabinet, program, outsourced parts and installation and commissioning according to this project, and indicate their respective undertaking parties and locations. Then select the desensitizing similar in-production or completed equipment, and match the physical object with the record. It is recommended to check the following table, and the scope of specific information shall be agreed upon by both parties.

Check the object Corresponding evidence Judgments and boundaries that can be supported
Design Confirmed drawings, modified records, and instructions of the responsible personnel It depends on who makes technical decisions; having drawings does not mean that the drawings are designed by them.
Furnace body and mechanism Physical identification, production tasks, processing and assembly records It depends on who produces the item; having equipment on site does not mean that all processes are self-produced.
Furnace lining and heating configuration Materials and configuration files, construction or assembly inspection records It depends on whether the actual structure corresponds to the scheme; the material brand cannot prove the performance alone.
Control system Electrical diagram, program version and commissioning record It depends on who modifies, verifies and maintains; being able to operate the interface does not mean mastering the program.
Out-of-commission and out-of-the-commission Procurement technical requirements, arrival inspection, problem handling records It depends on whether the external supply is controlled; the external purchase is not directly equivalent to labeling.
Delivery of the whole machine Test results, rectification and acceptance records of the corresponding equipment See whether the agreed result is realized; the receipt cannot replace the performance record.

If there is no similar furnace in production at the site, you can check the historical desensitization record first, and then agree to witness the project at the appropriate stage. There was no equipment in production on that day, which was not enough to prove that there was no manufacturing capacity; but the display area and explanation alone were not enough to confirm self-production. Make up for the missing evidence, instead of asking the other party to disclose the business information of other customers.

Distinguish three subcontracting arrangements

One is to outse standard parts, such as instruments, fans or transmission parts. Buyers should be more concerned about whether the selection is suitable, how to check the arrival of the goods, and who handles the fault, instead of asking the furnace to manufacture every part.

One is to hand over a certain processing or an assembly to external production. At this time, it is necessary to ask: who confirms the drawing, who approves the key changes, what requirements the supplier inspects, and who verifies after the arrival of the goods. If these links lack corresponding records, it will be difficult to judge which section the problem is in when the size or installation problems occur later.

Another is that the supplier is responsible for the whole machine or system integration, and the manufacturing is borne by the partner. Whether this model is acceptable depends on whether it truthfully explains the division of labor, masters the design and commissioning, and assumes the agreed final delivery responsibility. Integration automation cannot be regarded as self-production, and the reasonable division of labor cannot be judged as branding. If the procurement clearly requires a certain item to be manufactured by itself, the item and the verification method should be written in the document, instead of just "manufacturer".

Do the records apply to the furnace you are buying?

It is also called a heat treatment furnace, which handles small parts and heavy-duty large parts. The requirements for loading, support, heat transfer and handling may be different. Historical records can prove that they have done a certain kind of work, but they cannot directly prove the ability of the project. Ask the technician to explain why the corresponding structure is adopted and which conditions will affect the scheme in combination with your workpiece and furnace loading methods.

For example, it is proposed to purchase a heavy-duty bogie hearth furnace, which only shows the temperature control curve of the light-load furnace, which is not enough to explain the furnace trolley mechanism, fixtures and load heating capacity. Design instructions and verification arrangements that match these key conditions should be supplemented. If the data record is incomplete or needs to be rectified, it cannot be judged as qualified because the number corresponds; the processing results should continue to be checked.

Identify the workpiece and the manufacturing responsibilities

Prepare the material and size of the workpiece, loading method, process requirements, and self-production and foreign cooperation matters that you want to be clear, which can be used to discuss the equipment scheme, manufacturing division of labor and acceptance scope; the specific capacity and delivery content are confirmed according to the project.

This article is compiled by Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Engineering Technology Team, and Suneng is also one of the candidate enterprises. It is not the strength ranking, and it does not confirm the current order, survey cost or arrival time for any manufacturer.

Which Jiangsu suppliers could you approach?

Candidate enterprises Location and public direction What should I confirm first when I contact you?

The information is used to determine the starting point of consultation, and does not replace the business status, manufacturing site and project acceptance and verification. The purchasing party shall continue to supplement the candidate enterprises according to its own process.

What must the visit resolve on site?

When the information of the new single furnace and factory is relatively complete, you can first submit the workpiece, furnace loading method, process curve and on-site plane to judge the direction of the equipment, and then decide the survey arrangement. Otherwise, the two sides have not even confirmed whether the furnace type is suitable, and they may only take photos and keep the size if they go there first.

When the old furnace is transformed or the new equipment is connected to the existing production line, the importance of the site will increase. The original foundation, inlet and outlet routes, energy interfaces, maintenance spaces and shutdown windows may limit the scheme; if these conditions are not found until installation, they may cause rework or additional shutdown. At this time, the manufacturer should be asked to list the matters that need to be confirmed on the spot in advance, and arrange personnel who can deal with the corresponding problems.

Being able to be there does not mean that the technical survey can be completed.. Whether the visitor can check the mechanical arrangement, electrical interface or process connection should correspond to the judgment of this task. Sales visits can help communicate, but they cannot be automatically considered as the program conditions have been confirmed.

Agree the scope of the visit

Matters to be agreed upon Specific answers to be obtained What's the use of procurement?
Service location Is the project address within the scope of this arrangement? Avoid relying only on the company's distance estimate of accessibility
People present The division of labor, which personnel need the buyer to cooperate with Let the on-site problem find the corresponding person.
Survey task Check which dimensions, interfaces, current situation and data gaps Distinguish between technical survey and general visit
Delivery of results What records, items to be confirmed and plan modifications are formed? Avoid seeing the scene but no available conclusions.
Time and cost Both parties prepare conditions, schedule, cost included items It is convenient to arrange production and internal procurement processes.

This form is for inquiry and appointment, not the service commitment made by the manufacturer. If the on-site information is not enough to determine the plan, the items to be confirmed should be reserved, instead of determining the size, power and construction scope of the equipment just because the other party has come once.

Verify pre-sales and after-sales site support separately

Pre-sale survey, installation and commissioning and fault support after production are different tasks, and the personnel, spare parts and on-site conditions required are also different. When purchasing, the contact entrance, remote judgment method, the situation of need to be present, scheduling conditions and cost responsibility should be confirmed separately.

For faults that must rely on special spare parts, simply shortening the distance may not shorten the downtime of production; we should also check the model of spare parts, the acquisition channel and the verification arrangements after replacement. For problems that require joint investigation of technology and electricity, it is necessary to confirm who is responsible for the coordination, instead of just leaving a phone number.

Therefore, the real comparative advantage of nearby manufacturers is whether the communication, survey, installation and service arrangements of this project can be implemented, not the straight line distance on the map.

117.titleEn: Choosing a motor rotor heating furnace for shrink fitting: loading and temperature measurement
117.summaryEn: Select heating equipment for the rotor core and its fixtures using the actual shrink-fit requirements. Check trolley loading and support, clearance for transfer and the workpiece temperature measurements needed for assembly.
117.contentEn:
The heating furnace used for the motor rotor core and hinge shrink fitting should first clarify the parts, cooperation requirements and assembly arrangements that need to be heated this time, and then choose to load the furnace trolley, fixtures, effective heating area and workpiece temperature measurement. If the large workpiece needs to be loaded, unloaded and positioned outside the furnace, and the whole vehicle is allowed to enter and exit on the spot, the track furnace trolley scheme can be focused on comparing; the size of the furnace body cannot be presumed based on the motor base number alone.

The heating equipment required for the assembly of the high-voltage motor rotor core and hinge is discussed here, and the rotor hot disassembly, operating heating failure or other drying tasks are not included.

A rotor heating furnace procurement specification lists the assembly purpose of the iron core and hinge, the track furnace trolley, fixtures, and the environmental and workpiece temperature records separately. This article summarizes the selection method according to this. This information is required by the buyer and cannot be used to prove that Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. The corresponding equipment has been delivered or the production capacity has been realized.

Identify the heated component and its actual loading envelope

Procurement should first make it clear whether it is the iron core, a kind of iron core assembly, or other combinations that need to be heated as a whole after design. The relevant parts for assembly do not necessarily need to be heated at the same batch and temperature. The specific object should be determined by the motor design and assembly process.

The seat number helps to explain the product series, but the equipment should be adapted to the shape, weight, center of gravity, support surface and protruding part of the actual parts. Therefore, a representative workpiece diagram should be provided, instead of allowing the equipment to estimate the furnace chamber based on the series name alone.

Then put fixtures into the same loading diagram. The bracket, base, positioning and temperature measurement connection will occupy space. Among them, the parts that need to be heated should be within the agreed effective area, and other components should also meet the empty conditions for entering and leaving the furnace.

When multiple pieces are in the same furnace, the quantity, position and total load should be checked separately. A single piece can be put into the furnace, which does not mean that several pieces arranged arbitrarily can share the same temperature verification result.

Match trolley capacity and travel to the assembly station

The track furnace trolley scheme allows the loading platform to be moved outside the furnace, which is convenient for the arrangement of fixtures and loading and unloading interfaces around the real workpiece. Whether it is suitable depends on the exit direction of the furnace trolley, the running stroke and whether there is enough handover space in front of the furnace.

The bearing check should include workpiece and accompanying fixtures at the same time, and consider the weight distribution according to the actual support position. The rated total load of the furnace trolley cannot alone prove that a centralized support position also meets the design conditions.

It should also be clear who will continue from the furnace trolley to the assembly station. The heating furnace supply includes furnace trolley, but does not automatically include assembly machines, cranes or all load transfer fixtures; these interfaces need to be confirmed according to the same group of workpieces.

If the furnace body can complete the heating on time, but the receiving or assembly position after leaving the furnace is occupied, the workpiece will wait. Therefore, the batch arrangement should match the subsequent assembly capacity, and the number of furnaces should not be increased only while ignoring whether the back end can undertake it in time.

Use workpiece temperature to support the assembly decision

The air in the box and the workpiece belong to different measurement objects. The procurement specifications put forward the environmental and workpiece temperature measurement respectively, indicating that this distinction needs to be retained, and the display value of the thermometer cannot be unified as the iron core temperature.

The measuring point should be determined according to the representative parts, heating area and assembly judgment requirements. Whether an accessible outer surface test point can represent the key part needs to be based on the corresponding basis; in the case of multiple pieces in the same batch, it should also be explained how the selected test point covers the loading difference.

The control function should follow: which temperature is used to display the record, which is used to judge the completion of a certain stage, and how to mark the status of this batch when the conditions are not met should be specified in the equipment and process requirements. Having a workpiece temperature measurement interface does not mean that the device has defaulted to start all timing according to the workpiece temperature.

This question cannot give a unified shrink fitting temperature. Different cooperation, size, materials and components allow heating conditions, which may require different processes; the highest temperature of the equipment and the temperature that can be used by the specific workpiece should be confirmed separately.

Selection input Configuration that should be implemented Boundaries that need to be checked
Actual heating parts and representative shapes Effective area, furnace mouth and entry and exit path The series or aircraft number cannot replace the complete appearance.
Workpiece, fixtures and support position Furnace trolley carrying and special fixtures Check the total load and the local force separately.
The number and combination of planned furnaces Loading position and temperature measurement arrangement You can't overwrite multiple pieces according to a single result.
Workpiece temperature and assembly judgment Temperature measurement channel, program and recording logic The furnace temperature record is not automatically equal to the workpiece state.
Follow-up load transfer and assembly arrangement Furnace trolley travel and receiving interface The completion of heating is not equal to the completion of the whole assembly.

Verify the heating-to-assembly transfer with a representative batch

When the program is confirmed, the same group should be allowed to represent the workpiece through the loading, heating, handover and follow-up assembly requirements. The equipment part focuses on checking the loading adaptation, agreeing the heat process and recording; the assembly results of the workpiece are evaluated according to the motor design and process conditions, and both parties clarify their respective responsibilities.

A smooth furnace temperature curve cannot replace this group of confirmations; a single assembly cannot be directly expanded to all models. After adding the combination of parts, fixtures or the number of the same furnace, you should identify which original conditions are still applicable and which need additional verification.

Before purchasing, the component drawings, materials and matching requirements, allowed heating range, batch, fixtures and on-site floor plans can be handed over to Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. to compare the track furnace trolley, furnace layout and temperature measurement schemes. The article does not provide the general recommended values of shrink fitting temperature, fitting gap or assembly force.

116.titleEn: Choosing a wheel mould preheating furnace: size the load for the complete mould and the press schedule
116.summaryEn: Size a preheating furnace for the complete casting mould, including mass, support and transfer. Compare staged and simultaneous preheating against the time the mould is required at the machine. Wheel diameter alone cannot define furnace capacity.
116.contentEn:
The hub mold preheating furnace should be selected according to the shape, weight, coating status and machine arrangement of the whole set of casting molds. When multiple sets of molds need to be ready at different times, you can focus on comparing the configuration of independent heating chambers and their respective loading, unloading and control; if the molds can be put in and out in batches, the organization mode of heating in the same batch can be compared. The choice depends on the mold turnover, and the number of furnaces should not be directly determined according to the annual output of the hub.

The heating here is the casting mold of the aluminum alloy hub, not the solution treatment and aging of the hub products. The product size can indicate which wheel models are served, but it cannot replace the shape and weight of the mold assembly.

Size for the complete mould rather than the nominal wheel diameter

The nominal size of the hub is different from the space occupied by the whole set of molds. The procurement should provide the length, width, height, weight and actual heating status of the mold, and then determine the loading platform, furnace mouth and effective heating area.

If the upper and lower molds, side molds or related components enter the equipment as a whole set, the drawings should be provided according to this real combination; if the process requires splitting and heating separately, the splitting status should also be clearly explained. You can't calculate the size of a single mold at the time of inquiry, and put the whole set in when it comes to production.

At the same time, check the support position and handling interface of the mold. The heating room can accommodate the whole set of molds, which does not mean that the furnace mouth, the material table and the on-site handling equipment can be completed. The material table and the furnace door mechanism need to be included in the design separately, because the capacity and loading and unloading need to be adapted together.

Match the heating chambers to the machine schedule

First, list the common mold change and preparation arrangements in production: which molds enter preheating at the same time, which need to be staggered out of the furnace, and whether there are often temporary mold replacement tasks. Then use these needs to judge whether the furnace room needs to be independent.

If different molds are often installed at different times, the independent heating chamber can provide conditions for arranging procedures and loading and unloading separately. However, "multiple positions" is not equal to "multiple independent heating chambers". It is necessary to check whether the insulation separation, temperature control and furnace doors are configured for this purpose, and how to confirm the impact of opening one room on other rooms.

If several sets of molds can adopt the same program, enter the same batch and be used at a similar time, sharing a batch of heating space is also worth comparing. At this time, it is still necessary to confirm the loading position and temperature performance of each mold, and the temperature cannot be fully synchronized by default because it enters the furnace at the same time.

Independent configuration also has corresponding land area and equipment input. It is not the more rooms the better. Each heating position should correspond to the real mold preparation task to avoid increasing long-term idle workstations in order to pursue the number of configurations.

Check coating condition, heating method and mould temperature together

The preheating conditions of the mold after spraying should be determined by the coating and casting process requirements. The state before entering the furnace, how it is allowed to be heated, and what are the requirements on the surface of the cavity all affect the comparison of the heating method.

If the project needs to avoid burning flue gas directly into the workpiece space, indirect combustion heating can be used as a comparative direction; however, the name of the heating method alone cannot be used to promise that the coating, surface or casting results are qualified, and it should also be verified in combination with the actual mold and process.

The highest temperature of the equipment and the working state to be reached by the mold should also be recorded separately. The procurement goal is to prepare the mold for the machine according to the process requirements, and the air in the furnace reaches a certain set value, which is only a part of the process information.

Procurement issues Input to be provided Corresponding equipment and acceptance priorities
Can the furnace be installed? The shape, weight and support position of the whole set of molds Joint adaptation of the furnace mouth, material table and effective area
Several independent heating positions are required. The frequency of mold change and the time required for the mold to be ready Each room controls, opens doors and influences each other
What kind of heating method should be used? Coating status, environment and surface requirements Heat source form and actual mold verification
When will it be ready to be completed? Mold process requirements and temperature evaluation methods Represents mold measurement and temperature conditions
Can the production be connected after it comes out of the oven? Handling route, waiting and on-board arrangement Complete connection from preheating to use

Verify preheating, transfer and arrival at the machine

The equipment can complete the heating of a furnace according to the agreed conditions, but if the mold waits for a long time after being baked, the state before the machine cannot be directly replaced by the record of the oven. Therefore, the handling route and waiting arrangement should be included in the joint confirmation of the equipment and the production organization.

This does not require the unilateral responsibility of turning all the casting results into the heating furnace. A more reasonable practice is: the equipment party confirms the heating and control ability under the agreed loading, the user confirms the mold process and on-machine organization, and the two parties clarify how to judge the status when handing over.

The representative mold should cover the commonly used combination and the actual boundary combination, instead of using only a set of smaller molds to prove all adaptation. It should also check the performance of independent door opening, off-peak preparation or heating in the same batch according to the planned usage method, so that the acceptance corresponds to the actual production.

Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. The preheating equipment configuration can be compared according to the mold assembly drawing, coating process, mold change arrangement and on-site logistics. After clarifying these conditions, determine the heating chamber, heat source and loading and unloading interface, which is closer to a procurable plan than asking "how many degrees the hub mold furnace is and how many sets can be placed" separately.

115.titleEn: Choosing a titanium alloy plate heating furnace: check the loading layout on the rollers
115.summaryEn: Draw the proposed titanium alloy plate loads on the rollers. One long plate, several short plates and oscillating operation create different support and travel requirements, even at the same total weight. Verify the result under the required process.
115.contentEn:
The titanium alloy thick plate heating furnace should be selected according to the planned plate combination, and then the effective heating area, roller support and operation mode should be determined. For the production arrangement that needs to maintain the unfolding state of the plate and enter and exit the furnace through the roller channel, we can focus on comparing the roller channel heating furnace; the loading combination of a long plate and multiple short plates should be checked separately. The furnace length cannot be determined only by the longest plate length, and then the output can be estimated according to the rated tonnage.

What is discussed here is the equipment configuration of titanium and titanium alloy wide and thick plates, and the unified temperature program is not recommended for different brands and heat treatment targets.

Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. A historical plan lists the outline of plate products, typical loading, in-furnace rollers, and continuous and swing operation modes separately. It provides an analysis basis for pushing back the equipment from the plate, and the program formulation index is not used as the accepted performance.

The longest single plate does not represent every load

The list of plates should cover the length, width, thickness and weight at the same time, and then list how to combine production in practice. The longest plate affects the longitudinal capacity, the widest plate affects the transverse space, and the thicker or heavier plate will change the heating and support requirements; these limits may not be concentrated on the same plate.

The actual loading may also switch between "one long board" and "more shorter boards". The latter needs to consider the interval, positioning and order of entry and exit between the plates, and cannot only add up the length and compare it with the total length of the furnace chamber.

The procurement drawing should separate three types of dimensions: the structural size of the furnace body and furnace chamber, the agreed effective heating area, and the space required for the operation of the workpiece. The fact that the plate can enter the furnace chamber does not mean that the entire specified processing part is always within the confirmed effective area.

If you plan to increase the plate specifications, you should first put the new combination into the loading diagram to see whether it changes the space, weight distribution or process residence conditions. In this way, it can be clear which part of the equipment needs to be adjusted, instead of amplifying the furnace body and power.

Roller loads depend on plate position and support distribution

The roller channel directly contacts and supports the plate. When purchasing, how many rollers the plate should be placed on and where the main contact position should be checked with the corresponding bearing conditions. The total weight of the two types of loading is the same, and the distribution of weight on each roller may also be different.

The total weight cannot be simply divided equally among all furnace rollers, and then it is considered that each roller meets the requirements. The length, placement position, contact status and hot working conditions of the plate all affect the actual load-bearing; the specific structural capacity should be confirmed by the equipment design.

The heating of thick plates also needs to pay attention to the relationship between the heating supply of the upper and lower surfaces and the contact of the support. The heating arrangement and roller structure in the scheme should be examined together, not only to meet the processing target, but also to explain how to verify the allowed surface state, straightness and other product requirements.

This does not mean that the use of roller paths will inevitably cause some defects, nor can it be promised that all specifications will not be deformed. Purchasing should write the real product requirements into the verification conditions, so as to avoid the direct derivation of "product quality must be qualified" from "sufficient roller load-bearing".

Continuous advance and oscillating travel serve different production patterns

Continuous operation requires a combination of forward speed, effective processing area and process requirements. The mechanical system can run very fast, which can only show a kind of conveying ability, and cannot be directly used as a production certificate for the plate to reach the required heat state.

Swing operation is to make the plate move back and forth within the agreed itinerary. If this method is adopted, the loading position should meet the repeating stroke, the effective area in the furnace and the boundary of the door at the same time, and it cannot only be checked that it can be put down when it stops. When multiple boards are running at the same time, it is necessary to confirm the position relationship between them.

The two methods do not have to simply correspond to the two devices of "continuous furnace" and "batch furnace". The same scheme can be designed with a corresponding mode, but whether it is included in the supply and acceptance should still be agreed one by one, and the ability cannot be determined just by the appearance of a button on the control interface.

Represent loading or production arrangements The main affected equipment part The basis that should be seen in purchasing comparison
A longer board Effective area length, entry and exit path and positioning The layout of the whole board including the entry and exit status
Multiple shorter board combinations Segment location, inter-board relationship and loading and unloading arrangement The position of each plate in the whole processing process
Thicker and heavier board Roller support, thermal load-bearing and heating configuration Corresponding contact layout and design accounting
Organize production in a continuous manner Conveying speed and actual processing conditions The ability base under the same product, loading and process
Handle by swinging method Rebound itinerary, effective area and boundary location The running range diagram including the positions at both ends

Trace plate movement from furnace entry to downstream handling

The equipment arrangement of long and wide plates needs to be extended outside the furnace. Whether the feed roller, positioning device, discharge and subsequent load transfer can catch the corresponding plate will affect whether the capacity in the furnace can be used continuously.

For example, the fact that the furnace can accommodate several plates at the same time does not mean that the discharge end can also receive according to the same combination. If the subsequent position is occupied, increasing the conveying speed in the front section cannot eliminate the waiting. Such problems should be solved through on-site layout and production arrangements, rather than just modifying the parameters of the heating furnace.

When making an inquiry, you can submit the commonly used and boundary specifications, single weight, planned combination, process requirements and on-site flow to Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. The technical scheme should correspond to the loading, loading, operation mode and handover position one by one, and then agree on the acceptance of equipment and products under the load, so as to avoid only obtaining only one maximum size and rated tonnage table.

114.titleEn: Choosing an oven for red adhesive curing trials: specimen temperature and records
114.summaryEn: For a red adhesive curing trial, link the adhesive, substrate, specimen ID and load position to the temperature record and material test result. Oven air temperature alone cannot establish what happened in the adhesive.
114.contentEn:
The curing oven used for red adhesive research and development or process verification should be selected based on the actual application of the sample: whether it can accommodate the representative loading, whether the real temperature of the sample can be recorded, and whether the program and batch can be matched with the subsequent performance test. If the material has been confirmed to be suitable for normal pressure air thermal curing, and the test is mainly to compare different conditions in batches, you can compare the hot air circulation oven with program control and independent sample temperature measurement.

Only the maximum temperature, volume and a box temperature curve are not enough to show that this equipment can undertake material verification. What is discussed here is the thermal process verification of the red adhesive application sample, and the unified temperature and time are not recommended for all red adhesive.

Define the specimen and adhesive before specifying the oven

"red adhesive" is the name of the material in communication. The specific product, curing mechanism and application method should still be clarified when purchasing. What enters the box is often not an isolated adhesive, but a dispensing, glue-coated or assembled substrate and components.

Therefore, the sample shape, substrate, glue layer status, pallet and loading quantity should be given at the same time. Thin samples and large metal components, even if the same material is used, cannot be judged that they have undergone the same heating process just by the air in the box reaching the set value.

The form of equipment should follow the boundary of the material. Samples that have been confirmed to be suitable for air heat curing can be configured around normal pressure hot air circulation; tasks that require vacuum, protective atmosphere or special volatile treatment should be compared with the corresponding equipment separately. Material safety data, actual volatilization and curing heat release should also be explained before determining the loading and exhaust conditions.

The effective working zone should be determined according to the sample, tray and circulation space. The layout of two boxes with the same nominal volume, the shelf and the return air may be different, and it is not possible to judge how many sets of samples can be processed at the same time only by the number of liters.

Record specimen and oven temperatures separately

The program setting value indicates what process is planned to be carried out, the box temperature indicates the state of the corresponding measurement point in the box, and the sample temperature provides the thermal process actually experienced by the sample. The three should have clear names and corresponding records to avoid mixing into a "curing temperature" after export.

The technical information of material manufacturers also illustrates this difference. For example, Henkel's LOCTITE 3609 data defines the timing starting point of the curing curve as when the adhesive reaches the curing temperature, and points out that the total oven time may also be included in the heating process. This is the description of the product. Its temperature and time cannot be transferred to other red adhesive. LOCTITE 3609 Technical Data

For the verification box, you should first determine which representative samples should be compared, where the measuring point is set, and what conditions are used for insulation timing, and then select the temperature measurement channel and control function. Multiple channels only measure resources; if the measurement points are not representative, multiple channels cannot automatically cover all loading.

If the test needs to compare the cooling process, it is also necessary to clarify how to cool the equipment. If the device is only equipped with natural cooling, it is promised that it can follow the specified cooling speed under arbitrary loading because the program interface can enter the curve. Whether active cooling is required should be decided by the actual test task.

Link the trial record to the performance test

The delivery of red adhesive verification should not be just a curve screenshot. Researchers need to know which sample, which program and what kind of loading the curve corresponds to in order to compare the curing conditions with the subsequent test results.

Questions that need to be answered What should be provided for equipment or records? You can't judge by anything alone.
Which materials and samples are actually handled? Material code, sample number and application status Only write "a batch of red adhesive"
What are the conditions for implementing this plan? Traceable program version and setting curve Only the current parameters after the end of the run
What temperature process does the sample really go through? The temperature of the box and the temperature of the representative sample are recorded separately. Replace the temperature of all samples with box temperature
Is this loading the same as the last time? Correspondence of pallet, quantity, location and measuring point Only compare two identical settings.
Does the performance after curing meet the requirements? The thermal process is related to the degree of curing, bonding performance and other test results. The temperature curve is smooth or the program is displayed complete.

The record should also retain interruptions and measurement anomalies, and the actual missing data cannot be made up into continuous measurement curves. In this way, we can judge whether a test has the conditions for comparison, instead of mistaking the record integrity problem for material differences.

For a small number of R&D tests, local viewing and reliable export may be sufficient; when multi-device or cross-team aggregation, compare online docking. Whether the networking function is necessary or not should be decided by the record how to use it, and cannot replace the temperature measurement and sample correspondence itself.

Assess equipment acceptance and material cure separately

Equipment acceptance can confirm the temperature performance in the agreed working area, represent the load response, program and recording function. Material evaluation needs to judge the degree of curing, bonding performance or other targets according to the detection method of the selected system. The equipment is completed according to the program, and it does not automatically prove that the materials are qualified.

Similarly, after a group of small samples is verified, adding pallets, replacing substrates or amplifying loading still needs to confirm the new thermal process. The original results can be used as a basis for subsequent comparison, but the scope of application should be retained within the verified materials and loading conditions.

Before choosing the red adhesive curing oven, you can hand over the material information, representative samples, procedures to be compared, loading methods and performance evaluation methods to Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. Only by determining the temperature and recording function of the box, pallet and sample can be determined by "heating" as "can complete this verification task".

113.titleEn: Choosing a flat-head coupling sleeve heating furnace for shrink fitting and on-roll removal
113.summaryEn: Heating a separate coupling sleeve for shrink fitting and heating a sleeve locally while it is still on a roll impose different requirements. Check the load envelope, moving equipment, support and workpiece temperature measurement for each duty.
113.contentEn:
Whether the flat-head coupling sleeve heating furnace can undertake shrink fitting and hot disassembly in the roller at the same time depends on whether the heating range, entry and exit path, support and temperature measurement can be adapted in both states. When independent flat-head coupling sleeve shrink fitting, it is mainly configured around the sleeve and assembly interface; when the flat-head coupling sleeve has been installed on the roller, the roller body, bearing part and disassembly equipment sticking out of the furnace should be included in the design together, and the furnace chamber should not be selected only according to the outer diameter of the sleeve.

The flat-head coupling sleeve here refers to the roller connection parts. This article discusses the equipment selection and interface boundaries, and does not provide hot disassembly operation steps or general disassembly temperature.

Independent flat-head coupling sleeve heating and local heating in the roller are two different working methods. The furnace door, translation lifting and lifting and workpiece temperature measurement should be checked according to the actual working conditions respectively. It cannot be determined that any flat-head coupling sleeve can be disassembled and installed with the same device.

A sleeve mounted on the roll changes the equipment envelope

The independent sleeve can determine the furnace loading method according to its own shape and supporting support. After entering the roller state, the sleeve is connected to the roller, and the furnace mouth needs to adapt to the relative position of the whole group of parts. The furnace body may also need to be close to the workpiece, instead of letting all the workpiece enter the furnace.

At this time, the target heating part, the part through the furnace mouth and the parts left outside the furnace should be marked on the layout diagram. The allowable temperature and protection requirements of the non-target part are confirmed by the workpiece designer, and the whole group of parts cannot be regarded as ordinary steel parts that can withstand the same temperature.

If the central height of the two working methods and the direction of entry are the same, it is possible to compare the common furnace body and the corresponding interface. If the posture is very different, the nearby equipment is blocked or the target area is difficult to cover, it may be necessary to adjust the workstations or use different fixtures. Only increasing the heating power cannot solve these geometric problems.

Design doors, horizontal travel, lifting and supports around a common interface drawing

Variable furnace mouth, mobile furnace body and height adjustment are for different workpiece and workstation positions. When selecting these functions, you should first have the workpiece assembly drawing and on-site layout, and then determine how much adjustment ability is needed, instead of treating the larger the adjustable range as the more universal.

The interface diagram should at least explain: how the furnace mouth is arranged relative to the workpiece, where the furnace body needs to move, and what structure the sleeve, roller, support frame and disassembly device are carried by. The lifting mechanism of the furnace body can support the furnace, which is not the same as being designed to support the entire roller assembly.

Similarly, the "one set of heating furnaces" in the scope of supply does not automatically include disassembly carts, hydraulic devices and all workpiece supports. If these devices are provided by different units, they still need to confirm the position and action boundaries together, and cannot be assembled after completing the design according to the size of a single device.

After the two working conditions are adapted together, there is a substantial basis for sharing a furnace. If you only take turns to process different sleeves, you should also check the time it takes to replace the interface and reposition, instead of changing the temperature program by default.

Define how heating will be judged before specifying sensors

The furnace temperature indicates the state of the test point in the furnace, and it cannot be proved alone that the matching part has met the requirements. Shrink fitting is different from the combination of workpiece hot disassembly in the roller, and the parts that need to be paid attention to and the measurable position may also be different.

When selecting equipment, the workpiece and the person in charge of the process should clarify the basis for judging the heating results, and then configure the temperature measurement position, record and temperature limit accordingly. Especially when it is difficult to measure directly with the matching surface, whether the outer surface measurement point can represent the required state should have a confirmed correspondence, instead of judging by seeing a temperature value on the spot.

Theoretical workpiece temperature, maximum temperature of equipment and disassembly state should be listed separately, and this distinction is worth keeping. The equipment can rise to a higher temperature, which is one of the equipment's capabilities. It does not mean that the workpiece can use this temperature, and it does not mean that the higher the temperature, the easier it is to achieve qualified disassembly results.

Comparative items Independent sleeve shrink fitting heating Heat disassembly and heating in the roller The content that should be implemented when selecting the model
The object that enters the furnace body Set and agreed fixtures Partial combination of the sleeve and the connecting roller Real appearance and entry and exit path
Target heating area Determined according to the assembly requirements of the sleeve Determine the local area according to the state of the roller Target and non-target parts are marked separately.
Mouth and height of the furnace Corresponding to the loading position of the sleeve Take into account the protruding part and the height of the on-site center ADJUSTABLE INTERFACE AND SCOPE OF APPLICATION
Support and load Sleeves, fixtures and load transfer undertaking Undertaking between rollers, sleeves and disassembly equipment Responsibility boundaries of each bearing structure
Temperature judgment Corresponding to shrink fitting process Corresponding to the actual cooperation state and hot disassembly process Measurement point, representative relationship and confirmation method

Include both real operating configurations in procurement

Procurement communication should provide shrink fitting and roller hot disassembly status diagram respectively, and indicate materials, cooperation requirements, heatable areas, non-target part restrictions, on-site support and disassembly equipment. Only submit the sleeve parts drawing, and usually it is not possible to clarify the interface in the rolling condition.

Technical confirmation and acceptance should also cover the two states of actual planned use. The one-time heating record of the independent sleeve cannot directly replace the confirmation after connecting the roller; conversely, a certain type is suitable for the roller group, and it cannot directly cover another shape and matching conditions.

The specific temperature, maintenance time and disassembly conditions shall be determined by the workpiece design and process documents, and shall be used after corresponding verification. On-site operation shall not be derived from the equipment publicity parameters.

112.titleEn: Spheroidizing bearing steel wire: a fixed pit furnace or a movable bell furnace?
112.summaryEn: Compare a fixed pit furnace with a movable bell using the actual bearing steel wire coil, carrier, circulation paths, full batch cycle and shared resources. Verify the process and the agreed product result for that load.
112.contentEn:
When the bearing wire is loaded with coil furnace, the fixed pit furnace and the movable bell furnace can be used as the comparative direction of spheroidizing annealing equipment. The starting point of the selection is how the coil is installed, how it is heated and cooled, and how long the heating equipment is occupied in a cycle. Loading and unloading and whole batch processing are organized around the fixed furnace position, and the fixed well structure can be focused on comparing. If you want to remove the heating cover at the stage allowed by the process and let another furnace base continue processing, you can compare the combination of removable cover and multiple furnace base.

This choice should not be decided only by "how many tons per furnace". With the same weight coil, the inner and outer diameter, stacking layers, support and circulation channels are different, and the required space and processing arrangements in the furnace will also be different.

Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. The two bearing wire spheroidizing annealing schemes list the fixed pit furnace body and the composition of the heating cover, furnace base, furnace tank and cooling cover respectively. This article compares according to the actual structure, and does not regard the program formulation cycle as the verified production capacity.

The coil load determines more than furnace diameter

First of all, the inner diameter, outer diameter, height and weight of the coil should be given, and then the batch should be single-layer or multi-layered, and what kind of bearing structure should be used. The empty furnace can accommodate several round outlines, and only a part of the geometric check has been completed.

The space between the middle, outer and upper and lower bearings of the coil is also related to the passage of circulating gas. The above scheme is equipped with a wind guide structure, a circulation fan and a bearing base respectively, indicating that the loading and the airflow organization need to be considered together. The coil should not be filled first, and then the remaining gaps should be treated as air ducts.

If the roll diameter, the number of stacking layers or the loading rack is changed, the original loading conditions will also change. Whether the new combination can meet the requirements of the temperature process needs to be confirmed under the corresponding load, and the result of another placement method cannot be directly followed.

When purchasing, the equipment should be asked to give the relative arrangement of coil, bearing structure, furnace tank and circulation channel. In this way, we can distinguish whether there is insufficient space in the furnace or the existing layout needs to be adjusted, instead of increasing the furnace body as soon as loading difficulties are encountered.

Which components stay in place in each design?

The fixed well scheme arranges the heating furnace body in the fixed furnace position, and completes loading and unloading and heat treatment around the furnace position. It can be used as a route for batch-by-batch production, but it is necessary to confirm the entry method of coil and fixtures, the hoist cover and the space above the furnace mouth.

The bell-type scheme can be moved to separate the heating hood, the load-bearing furnace base and the furnace tank. After meeting the process conversion conditions, the heating cover can be transferred, and the original batch of workpiece is still undertaken by the corresponding furnace base and furnace tank, and then the cooling is arranged according to the plan. This gives the heating equipment a chance to separate the whole stage occupation process from the workpiece.

Whether this opportunity is worth adopting depends on the actual production arrangement. If a batch still needs to be continuously heated according to the process during cooling, the heating cover cannot be removed in advance just to catch up with the next batch; if the hifting equipment and moving path are occupied by other operations for a long time, it cannot be produced only according to the theoretical action of the equipment.

Therefore, the transferable hood increases the resource combination method, and at the same time increases the cover parking, transfer, furnace base interface and scheduling needs. Whether these conditions can be implemented on site will affect the selection as well as the rated power of the furnace.

Compare the two arrangements using the same coil batch

The two types of equipment should be compared with the same representative materials, coil combinations and product acceptance requirements. Otherwise, the combination of light load and easy handling is used on one side, and dense heavy load is used on the other side, and the resulting cycle is not comparable.

Production conditions Key points of fixed well scheme Key points of the movable bell-type scheme
Changes in coil specifications and stacking methods Can the fixed furnace be compatible with fixtures and circulation channels? Whether the furnace base, the furnace tank and the heating cover are suitable together
It is necessary to organize loading and unloading around fixed workstations. Check the loading and unloading space and adjacent logistics Check whether the cover transfer brings additional occupation
The cooling phase takes up a long time. Clarify which equipment will be occupied during this period Confirm which stages are allowed to transfer the heating cover
It is proposed to configure multiple furnace bases Arrange production according to the actual independent heating unit The number of furnace base is accounted for together with the capacity of heating hood and cooling hood.
Requires stable access to spheroidizing annealing products Acceptance according to materials, loading and complete process Acceptance under the same conditions cannot be directly guaranteed by the bell-type structure.

One more furnace base does not mean one more set of simultaneous heating capacity. When a heating hood is equipped with two furnace bases, only the heating hood still undertakes its corresponding heating task. What stage the other furnace base can undertake should be jointly determined by the process, equipment configuration and scheduling, and the output cannot be directly doubled.

Accept the product against its spheroidizing requirements and choose equipment for the production pattern

The product requirements of spheroidizing annealing should be determined by the steel type, the state of the front road and the subsequent processing needs, and then form the executable process and inspection conditions. The choice of furnace type solves how to carry and organize this process. The well-type or bell-type name alone cannot promise the organization, hardness or processing effect.

Equipment comparison should at least correspond to the loading diagram, temperature process record, actual time occupied by each component, and product inspection results to the same batch of representative coils. Only when these evidences are complete can we compare the time and resources consumed by a batch of qualified products.

Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. According to the size, fixtures, processing requirements and workshop load layout, the selection and analysis of fixed well type and movable bell-type combinations can be carried out. The protective atmosphere and cooling conditions need to be confirmed according to the specific process. This article does not provide gas switching, temperature setting or hot lifting operation.
