111.titleEn: Can bolts and nuts share a heat treatment line? Check loading and transfer first
111.summaryEn: Bolts and nuts may use a common line only within verified loading, conveying and process limits. Check belt openings and transfer gaps for small parts, the orientation of long bolts, and handling at quenching, washing and tempering.
111.contentEn:
Bolts and nuts can be included in the product range of the same heat treatment line, provided that the processes required by each are within the equipment capacity, and the loading, support and full line handover can be adapted separately. Shared equipment does not mean that two workpieces can be mixed at will, nor does it mean that the same output can be obtained using the same loading method.

For long bolts and nuts sharing mesh belt quenching and tempering lines, the first thing that needs to be separated is often the fabric method. Nuts and short parts can be controlled and uniform fabrics, while long bolts need to pay more attention to the placement direction, head staggering and load transfer drop.

The feasible common line scheme is usually to configure the nut fabric and the controlled arrangement of the long bolt respectively, and then connect the cleaning, heating, quenching, tempering and other processes. Let's discuss how to judge this kind of common line scheme; the specific configuration still needs to be verified according to the actual bolt and nut specifications.

Different belt loading requirements for bolts and nuts

The number of nuts is large and the single piece is short. When fabricing, it is necessary to control the thickness and distribution of the layer to avoid excessive accumulation of parts. For long bolts, there is a difference in the shape of the rod and the head. After stacking, there may be head hanging, crossing and direction out of control. It is necessary to design the direction of the material together with the guide structure.

This is also why it is not enough to provide thread specifications. The actual contact between the mesh belt and the channel is the shape of the workpiece. The total length of the bolt, the size of the head and the weight of the single piece may affect the adaptation; the nominal specification cannot replace the complete drawing.

If the long parts are arranged in a certain direction, the procurement comparison should calculate the occupied area according to this arrangement method, and the loading amount should not be used when the nut bulk material is used. A mesh belt that can withstand the same weight may not be able to install two types of workpieces of the same weight on the same length of the belt.

The loading configuration can share some equipment or set it separately. Whether a special material mechanism is required, it should be based on the stability of the product, the burden of manual ingredients and the actual delivery test. There is no need to force all front-end equipment to be exactly the same for the "common line".

Follow each product through every transfer

Check that it can't be stopped at the entrance of the heating furnace. The workpiece also needs to be cleaned, baked, quenched, lifted, tempered and discharged. The long bolt works normally on the straight belt surface, and the posture may change between the belt and the belt, the steering point or the lifting junction.

Therefore, the conveying confirmation should cover both ends at the same time: whether the smaller nut will enter the unsuitable gap, and whether the longer or heavier bolts will cross, touch the channel or lose the original direction when crossing. The longest part, the largest head part and the heaviest part may not be the same product and should be covered separately.

If you are going to use pallets, load baskets or special supports, you should check along the whole line, instead of adding fixtures only in the heating section. They will go through the follow-up process with the workpiece, which may change the conditions of cleaning, quenching contact and load transfer, and also need to be arranged for recycling and re-loading.

This kind of confirmation is suitable for forming a loading and handover indication in the equipment design stage, and it is verified by representing the workpiece test. The article does not provide the operation method of modifying the mesh belt, removing the guide or adjusting the quenching device on the spot.

Define separately testable capabilities

The supplier said that "bolts and nuts can be made", and should continue to ask which products are suitable, how to load and under what conditions for acceptance. The following table can be used as a basis for comparing common line schemes.

Comparison link Focus on nuts and short parts Focus on long bolts The results to be given by the common line scheme
Top up Whether the distribution and layer thickness can be controlled Whether the placement direction and head staggering can be controlled The respective loading methods of the two types of products
Support and channel Adaptation of small parts and meshes and gaps Occupation after full length, head and posture changes Represents the adaptation range of workpiece and fixtures
Process handover Is there any accumulated material, omission or mixed batch? Is there any crossing, inter-hanging and steering obstruction? Transmission confirmation record covering the whole line
Special fixtures Whether to change the original fabric and processing conditions Can it be stable and complete the turnover? Fixtures weight, position and applicable process
Product switching Materials, grades and batch numbers can be traced back Materials, grades and batch numbers can be traced back Process and acceptance conditions of sub-products

The table emphasizes the itemized confirmation of equipment capabilities, and does not require each product to be equipped with a completely independent production line. The part that can be reliably shared can be retained, and the links with real differences can be adapted.

Keep product-specific evidence for output and quality

Both types of workpiece can pass, and their hourly qualified output is the same. The surface area occupied by the controlled placement, the accompanying weight of fixtures, the actual heating requirements and the processing capacity of the front and rear sections may make different products use different production arrangements.

The common line planning should establish a product portfolio according to the materials, specifications and performance requirements of regular production, rather than just listing a "maximum processing capacity". Different specifications under the same material name should also check the acceptance conditions; products of different materials or grades cannot automatically share a process curve because the equipment is the same.

If the production arrangement requires continuous batch change, the batch boundary and traceability method should be clarified in advance to avoid only recording the operation curve of the whole line, but not being able to correspond to specific products. How to switch should be implemented in the confirmed process documents, and the general operation steps should not be given by the equipment leaflet.

Before purchasing, you can provide the bolt and nut drawings, main product proportions, existing loading methods and inspection requirements to Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. The common line scheme should answer "how to go for each type of workpiece" and "under what conditions each type of product is a qualified output" at the same time, so as to judge which adaptations need to be added and which equipment can be shared directly.

110.titleEn: Pit furnace or mesh belt furnace: controlling bending when quenching and tempering long bolts
110.summaryEn: For long bolts, compare suspended pit furnace loading with controlled belt loading. Include fixtures, transfer and the full quench and temper sequence. Furnace type alone does not guarantee straightness or mechanical properties.
110.contentEn:
Choose pit furnace or mesh belt furnace for long bolt heat treatment. First, it depends on how the workpiece is suitable for loading, and whether to purchase a heating process or a whole quenching and tempering line. If the long parts need to be hung vertically one by one, processed in batches, and prepared to match the existing quenching and tempering equipment, you can focus on the pit furnace; if the product can be placed stably, transported and handed over through each section, and needs to be continuously cleaned, quenched and tempered, the mesh belt continuous line can be compared.

None of the "long bolts" can directly determine the unified length boundary of the furnace type. For bolts of the same length, the head size, rod diameter, weight, loading direction and yield arrangement are different, and the suitable equipment may also be different.

Is the purchase for pre-quench heating or a complete quench and temper line?

Quenching and tempering usually refers to the heat treatment combined with quenching and high-temperature tempering. Purchasing a pre-quenching heating furnace does not mean that you have purchased all the equipment required for this process.

Some well schemes are only responsible for pre-quenching heating and are connected with the existing quenching oil tank, excluding tempering furnaces. Therefore, factories that already have supporting equipment can supplement the pit furnace as a process; the new production line should plan the conditions of quenching, tempering and load transfer together.

The mesh belt scheme includes pre-tenching cleaning and drying, protective atmospheric heating, oil quenching, lifting and draining, pre- quenching cleaning, tempering and cooling discharge. This kind of organization is suitable for continuous production according to the confirmed product portfolio, but the equipment occupied, batch change arrangement and upstream and downstream supply have also become procurement conditions.

When comparing quotations, the scope of supply should be aligned first. One part only includes the heating host, and the other contains the complete quenching and tempering process. The price difference cannot be simply explained that a certain type of furnace is more expensive.

Choose the orientation before checking furnace space

The vertical suspension scheme depends on the overall loading of the bolts and the sling. In addition to the length of the rod, it also includes the head, the hanging position, the temperature measurement arrangement and the space required for loading and unloading. The workpiece part that needs to be heated should be in the agreed effective heating area, and the sling and connectors should be in an appropriate position in the furnace and on the entry and exit path.

This route is suitable for the organization of batch processing of long parts one by one. The price is that the sling, the loading and unloading space above and the connection of adjacent processes need to be implemented; the factory can only put down the furnace body, which is not enough to determine that it can be adopted.

The mesh belt type needs to confirm the posture of the long piece on the belt surface, the occupied width and the state of the transition through various places. The long rod can be placed flat on the mesh belt, which only proves that it can be placed in a certain position; it also needs to go through the cleaning section, furnace mouth, discharge and lifting and other positions. If you must rely on a special pallet for stable transportation, the pallet occupation, weight and turnover should also be included.

Therefore, long parts with small batches, multiple specifications and suitable for suspension can be compared first with the well-type batch organization; products with stable specifications and loading, and full-line transportation can be adapted, can be compared with continuous organization. This is the screening order, not a one-cut according to the size of the output.

Verify straightness against the product requirement

The buyer is concerned about the bending of the long bolt after heat treatment. This problem should be included in the acceptance requirements, but it cannot be directly guaranteed by "vertical release" or "mesh belt". It is necessary to verify the final straightness and other properties in combination with the actual steel, effective cross-section, loading and support, and complete heat treatment process.

The surface requirements should also be confirmed separately. The well-type heating furnace may only be configured according to air heating, and the continuous quenching and tempering line may be configured with a protective atmosphere. If the product requires control oxidation, decarburization or has a specific surface state, it cannot be determined that the two configurations can be interchanged just by the same maximum temperature. Changing the atmosphere requirements may also change the equipment structure and the scope of supply.

You can use the following table to exclude the obviously inappropriate combination first, and then enter the detailed design:

Workpiece and production conditions Prioritize the direction of comparison Key conditions before making a choice
Long pieces need to be hung one by one and processed in batches. Well-type heating furnace and special sling The overall shape of loading, the load capacity, the upper space and the adjacent process are connected.
There is already quenching and tempering equipment, and make up a heating process. Batch plan matching with existing equipment Confirm the compatibility of the actual supply range and the whole process
The product portfolio is stable, and it is planned to complete quenching and tempering continuously. Mesh belt type continuous quenching and tempering line Workpiece can be handed over through the whole line, and the supply and replacement of batches can be organized.
Long parts can only be transported by relying on special pallets. Compare the continuous scheme with fixtures with the batch scheme Compare fixtures, heat load and recycling turnover
There are requirements for straightness, surface or heart performance Verify according to the real product arrangement The name of the furnace type and the temperature index of the empty furnace cannot replace the product results.

Provide representative parts as well as maximum length

The representative workpiece should not only have the longest piece. It also includes the largest head, the heaviest single piece, the larger cross-section, and the most commonly produced specifications. The same line may be restricted by these products at different locations.

Hand over these workpieces together with materials, heat treatment targets, batches and shifts to the equipment side, and ask for the corresponding loading drawings and process scope. The well scheme explains how to arrange a batch and which supporting equipment is borne by the existing equipment; the continuous scheme explains how the workpiece goes through the whole line, what loading form is adopted, and the production basis of different products.

Acceptance should also be agreed upon by this group of representative products. Whether the delivery test answer can be passed stably, and whether the heat treatment verification answer meets the product requirements, both are valid, so that the ability in the plan can be used as the basis for procurement. The empty furnace runs smoothly and cannot replace the confirmation with real workpiece.

109.titleEn: Batch oven or continuous line for gas cylinder curing? Start with the product and process
109.summaryEn: Compare batch and continuous curing against the cylinder types, compatible programmes, waiting and rotation after winding, and any intermediate operations such as resin removal after preheating. Check that upstream and downstream operations can keep pace.
109.contentEn:
Whether the gas cylinder curing box-type batch furnace is still a continuous furnace, it should first be seen whether different bottle types can share the curing program, how the winding gas cylinder waits and rotes, and whether intermediate treatment such as preheating and scraping glue is required in the process. When it is often necessary to adjust the procedure in batches and different orders are not suitable for sharing the operating conditions, you can give priority to comparing the box-type batch scheme; when the product and process routes are relatively stable, fixtures can pass continuously, and each process can be continuously connected, focus on comparing the continuous curing line.

The comparison here is the resin curing route of fiber winding gas cylinders. "Box type" refers to the furnace form, and "batch" refers to the production organization. The two cannot be directly equalized on all equipment; the box-type scheme in this article is a device that executes a common temperature program after loading a batch.

Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. The two gas cylinder curing schemes adopt the continuous connection of the whole batch of heating, insulation, cooling, and material storage, rotation, preheating, intermediate treatment and continued curing respectively. The following is a comparison of the two organizational methods. The production capacity or energy consumption figures of different projects are not directly ranked, and the plan is not written as the production effect.

Group cylinders by curing programme before selecting a furnace

The similar shape of the bottle does not mean that the curing conditions required for the inner tank, winding layer and resin system are the same. When selecting models, the bottle type of planned production should first be matched to the confirmed temperature program, rotation requirements and loading method, and then judge which products can be classified into the same batch or the same continuous operation conditions.

For box batch equipment with the same furnace chamber sharing temperature program, the program can be changed between two batches, but the products in the same batch must be able to accept this set of common conditions. Multiple gas cylinders rotate separately, which does not mean that each gas cylinder can perform a temperature curve separately.

For the continuous line, the process requirements should be implemented into the heating area and transportation arrangements along the route. If a bottle type requires a significantly different residence time, just modifying its product name or loading order will not solve the problem; it is necessary to judge whether the current operating conditions can be shared or the production should be organized separately.

Therefore, if different bottle types in the order often need to run separate procedures, the batch scheme should be compared first; if the main products can run continuously under the same set of confirmed process paths, the continuous line will have the basis for further comparison. You can't just draw a general dividing line according to "how many per day".

Robots and conveyors can still serve a batch oven

In the box scheme, the robot loads one by one, and the furnace mechanism sends the workpiece to the corresponding position; after loading a batch, the common curing procedure is carried out. The robot solves the loading and unloading action, but does not turn the batch process into a continuous process.

The key to the continuous scheme is that the workpiece completes the process through all sections along the line. For gas cylinders that need to be rotated, conveying and rotating are two different tasks: one set of mechanisms makes it move to the next process, and the other set makes the bottle rotate around its own axis. When comparing equipment, it is necessary to check the support of the gas cylinder and fixtures, the drive connection, and the status when passing through each section at the same time.

Under the ideal uniform speed condition of continuous conveying, the passage time of a section is determined by the stroke and forward speed of the section. Increasing the rotation speed will not increase the passing time; increasing the forward speed will shorten the passing time, and the two adjustments cannot be mixed together. The design materials of conveyor heating equipment also use productivity, loading density and heat zone dwell time together for length estimation, instead of determining the furnace length only according to the target output. Conveyor length calculation data

This relationship is used to understand the configuration constraint, and the uniform speed cannot be directly regarded as the whole time when the bottle meets the curing requirements. The actual temperature experience should also correspond to the gas cylinder, fixtures and confirmed curing procedures.

Include resin scraping after preheating, where required

In the continuous scheme, the glue is scraped after preheating, and then enters the subsequent curing process. This is the corresponding process arrangement of the scheme, which does not mean that all winding gas cylinders must be scraped.

If the actual resin process really needs this intermediate treatment, it is not possible to compare only a box furnace that executes the complete procedure after closing the door, and directly compare the price with a continuous line containing the intermediate processing position. How the box route completes this process, whether it needs segmented equipment or additional load transfer, should be included in the plan; opening the door halfway cannot be regarded as an established process solution.

For continuous routes, it is necessary to check whether the time required for the intermediate process is compatible with the rhythm of entry and exit. There is a storage position in front of the furnace, which can bear a certain amount of waiting, but it cannot eliminate the long-term difference in process capacity. Whether to maintain rotation during the waiting period and how to connect after load transfer must still be implemented according to the process requirements.

This kind of problem may change equipment segmenting, load transfer and personnel arrangement, often affecting more than one furnace body part. Therefore, we should first confirm whether the process is needed and how the two routes are realized respectively, and then compare the price and site. The conditions involving manual approach to the workpiece should be confirmed separately by the project process and safety design. This article does not provide scraping glue or hot operation steps.

Compare both routes with the same cylinders and complete process

The following table can be used as a basis for selection when making an inquiry. It compares the configuration direction when the corresponding conditions are met, not the ranking of equipment.

Production problems that need to be solved How to compare the box-type batch plan How to compare the continuous curing line
Different bottle types need to perform curing procedures separately. Whether it can be reasonably divided into batches, and the procedure and fixtures adjustment when changing the batch Can the operating conditions be shared? How to arrange the replacement if it cannot be shared?
After winding, you need to wait and maintain rotation. Waiting for it to happen before loading or in the furnace, which institution will bear it? Is the connection between the storage position, rotation and transfer to the main line complete?
The process needs to be preheated and then processed. Do you need segmented configuration, load transfer and corresponding process confirmation? Whether the intermediate process matches the front and rear conveying, you can't just look at the speed of the main furnace.
It is necessary to expand stable output. How long does the whole batch of curing, cooling, loading and unloading and waiting take together? Whether each process can continue to supply and receive materials, and whether the residence time can meet the requirements
Bottle type or fixtures interface change Is the batch loading and support adjustment convenient and still within the scope of the equipment? Can the whole line section pass continuously, and whether the driver and handover interface are compatible

When comparing outputs, both sides should use the same group to represent the bottle type, process quality requirements and production arrangements. Batch equipment cannot only use the number of loads per furnace to calculate the production capacity, and continuous equipment cannot only use the theoretical discharge interval to replace the complete operating results. The specific comparison should include the lifting and lowering temperature, loading and unloading, waiting and changing production processes required by each person.

The scope of supply should also be unified: self-transfer storage, fixtures, load transfer, intermediate treatment, cooling and process exhaust treatment interfaces, which are provided by the equipment party and which are undertaken by the factory's existing system. If one quotation includes these accessories and the other only includes the furnace, the two prices are not answering the same procurement question.

When purchasing a gas cylinder curing production line, you can go to Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. Provide representative bottle type and fixtures diagrams, resin information and curing procedures, whether there is intermediate treatment, incoming material arrangement after winding, target output and factory layout. Based on this, first judge whether it is suitable for batch organization or continuous connection, and then determine the number of equipment and specific configuration; do not rely on the parameters of other projects to commit to the production capacity, energy consumption or curing quality of this project.

108.titleEn: Choosing a long gas cylinder curing furnace: size the trolley and chamber around the mandrel load
108.summaryEn: Size the load around the wound cylinder, mandrel and end fittings. If several cylinders must rotate and be loaded outside, verify full trolley withdrawal and handling clearance. Where front clearance is limited, compare fixed stations and dedicated transfer equipment.
108.contentEn:
The long cylinder curing furnace should be selected according to the "winded bottle body connected mandrel", and an extension furnace cannot be bought only according to the length of the bare bottle. For long gas cylinders that need multiple side-by-side, loading outside the furnace, and self-rotating during the curing process, if the site can accommodate the complete exit and loading and unloading operations of the furnace trolley, the overall furnace trolley scheme can be focused on comparing; if the space in front of the furnace is not enough, the combination of fixed workstations and special load transfer equipment should be compared, and the loading and unloading methods should be re-determined.

The discussion here is the resin curing equipment of fiber winding gas cylinders. The mandrel and the connecting parts at both ends will affect the loading, support and rotation configuration, and the selection conditions of metal inner tank solution treatment and aging equipment cannot be directly applyed.

Draw the cylinder and mandrel together before sizing the chamber

The purchase form only fills in the bottle length, bottle diameter and bottle weight, which is often not enough to determine the equipment. The actual entry into the furnace may include mandrel protruding ends, connectors, supports and drive interfaces; some of them need to enter the heating area, and others need to occupy the end installation space.

Three things should be distinguished on the loading diagram first: where the bottle that needs to be heated is, where the support at both ends is, and where the whole set of components passes when entering and leaving the furnace. The effective heating area, the furnace can be determined by the space and the total length of the furnace trolley are determined by these conditions respectively, and they cannot be regarded as the same size.

This will directly affect the choice of structure. If multiple bottle types only change the length of the bottle, and the support is consistent with the drive interface, priority can be given to comparing the adjustable scheme of the tail frame; if the mandrel shaft neck, end connection or support form also changes, it is not enough to increase the adjustment stroke, and the support or interface may also need to be replaced.

One way is to support the core shaft at both ends of the head frame and the tail frame, and let the tail frame be adjusted along the furnace trolley rail. It shows an adaptation method, which cannot be used to determine that all mandrels can be shared directly. When making an inquiry, you should provide the assembly drawing representing the bottle type with the mandrel, not just the shape drawing of the bottle.

Allow for loading and waiting outside a trolley furnace

The characteristic of the overall furnace trolley configuration is that the workstation support and rotation mechanism are arranged on the car, and the workpiece enters the furnace with the furnace trolley after the furnace is installed. For long gas cylinders, this can complete the head and tail position adjustment outside the furnace and maintain the established loading relationship into the furnace.

But there is a clear premise for choosing it: the factory can not only put the furnace body, but also accommodate the space required for the complete exit of the furnace trolley, the handover of the workpiece, and the normal loading, unloading and maintenance. There is an open space next to the furnace, which does not mean that the long furnace trolley has enough travel along the direction of entry and exit.

If this condition is not true, the arrangement of fixed workstations and furnace load transfer equipment should be compared, instead of buying bogie hearth furnace first, and then temporarily compressing the loading and unloading space. Changing the loading method will also change the furnace door, support handover, power supply connection and operation organization. You can't just delete the "fornace trolley" in the quotation.

It is also necessary to divide the three stages of loading, waiting and curing. If the confirmed resin process requires rotation when waiting before entering the furnace, it should be clear where the waiting takes place and which set of institutions should bear it. Whether the rotation drive is arranged on the furnace trolley depends on the actual process, and it is not a unified requirement for all gas cylinder curing furnaces.

When there is only one furnace trolley, it runs in the furnace with this batch of workpiece, and the next batch cannot occupy the same furnace trolley loading at the same time. If the production plan needs to prepare materials in advance, the preparation support, waiting method and its connection with the main furnace should be checked separately. The outer material outside the furnace should not be naturally understood as two batches in parallel.

Check supports, rotation and airflow when changing cylinder lengths

The tail frame can be moved to a new position, which only solves part of the length adaptation. After changing to another bottle body and mandrel combination, it is also necessary to confirm the support position, rotation connection, total weight and center of gravity, and whether it occupies the original hot air channel after adjustment.

For hot air circulation curing furnaces, the loading method will affect the path of air passing through the workpiece. The technical questions and answers of equipment manufacturers also pointed out that loading and blocking the airflow channel may slow down the heating. Therefore, it is not possible to judge whether it is feasible to increase the workstation only by "one can be stuffed into the furnace". Equipment manufacturer's instructions on loading and airflow

When comparing the configuration, you can use the following table together with the representative bottle type loading diagram:

Products and production conditions The configuration of priority comparison Under what conditions the plan needs to be adjusted?
Long and short bottle types alternate, but the mandrel support is consistent with the drive interface. ADJUSTABLE TAIL FRAME AND CORRESPONDING POSITIONING METHOD When the interface and support form change, you can't just increase the itinerary.
Multiple long bottles are ready outside the furnace, and then the whole car is put into the furnace. Overall furnace trolley and on-car workstat mechanism When the front of the furnace cannot accommodate exit and loading and unloading, compare the fixed workstation and load transfer scheme.
The process requires waiting for the stage to turn. Waiting for the position to support the rotation mechanism and its connection Only configure the rotation inside the furnace, and cannot automatically cover the waiting outside the furnace.
Change the bottle diameter, the number of side-bys or the form of fixtures Corresponding to the support, spacing and hot air path under the loading combination It can be put down geometrically, but the temperature performance of the belt material still needs to be checked.
Single-piece trial production often interrupts mass production. Single-station trial equipment for independent control and recording When it is occasionally tested and the main furnace can be arranged, there is no need to automatically add a furnace.

The support, bearing and driving capacity here should be determined by the actual workpiece and fixtures data, and the table does not provide the general load or speed. Only when the selection is compared to this level can we judge which configurations can be shared and which need to be added, instead of converting all the differences into furnace length.

How a single-station trial oven fits the production plan

If the new bottle type, resin formula or curing procedure often requires a single test, the single-station trial furnace can arrange the program and record separately to reduce the scheduling conflict between the test task and the whole batch production of the main furnace. The premise is that the trial equipment can accommodate real long bottles and mandrels, and retain the support, rotation and temperature measurement conditions required for the test; the small sample oven cannot replace this task just by the same maximum temperature.

On the other hand, if the trial production frequency is very low, the existing main furnace can arrange the corresponding working conditions, and the new trial furnace may not be the first choice. We should also compare the footprint, power supply, exhaust and loading and unloading resources of new equipment, so as to avoid only counting the purchase price of the furnace.

The result of single-piece trial production cannot directly replace the confirmation of multiple loading of the main furnace. The loading density, hot air path and fixtures combination of the two are different, and mass production still needs to check the process records and product requirements under the planned loading conditions.

Before purchasing, the assembly drawing, total weight and support data, curing curve, waiting stage requirements, batch and trial arrangement, and on-site floor plan can be handed over to Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. to judge the combination of the overall furnace trolley, fixed work station and trial equipment. The resin data and exhaust treatment interface should also be clear at the same time; if the process involves pressure control in the bottle, it should be confirmed according to the process, and the pressure setting or operation method should not be derived from the furnace body selection.

107.titleEn: Choosing a mesh belt tempering furnace supplier for stress relieving cold-coiled compression springs
107.summaryEn: Suneng, Sanli and Zhongdaqiang list equipment relevant to an initial enquiry. For stress relieving cold-coiled compression springs, check wire condition, effective treatment time, continuous conveying and verification with a representative load.
107.contentEn:
If you are going to purchase a mesh belt tempering furnace for destressing, you can contact Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd., Hangzhou Sanli Electric Furnace Co., Ltd. and Shenzhen Zhongdaqiang Electric Furnace Co., Ltd. Suneng can first evaluate the continuous mesh belt tempering, destressing and upstream and downstream connection schemes; Sanli has a continuous hot air tempering furnace for springs; Zhongdaqiang has compact continuous equipment for small springs and other parts.

The communication starting point of the three families is different. When you need to customize the equipment in combination with the actual spring, loading method and on-site cycle time, you can discuss the plan with Suneng; when comparing the spring application model, you can also inquire from Sanli and Zhongdaqiang. Whether the specific equipment can meet the requirements of this product should be determined in combination with the status, size and material verification of the steel wire.

What to ask each of the three suppliers

Candidate manufacturers The direction of equipment related to this purchase The key points of the first round of communication
Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. (Publisher of this article) Mesh belt furnace scheme Including the continuous tempering and destressing direction of small parts, according to belt loading, effective time and upstream and downstream cycle time evaluation Whether the compression spring is suitable for stable transportation; how to match the furnace section, temperature zone, belt speed and incoming and out of materials; how to verify the destressing requirements of this material
Hangzhou Sanli Electric Furnace Co., Ltd. RJC series continuous hot air tempering furnace Using mesh belt conveying, there are spring applications. Can the corresponding model adapt to the wire diameter, outer diameter, free height and placement method of this compression spring?
Shenzhen Zhongdaqiang Electric Furnace Co., Ltd. Compact continuous tunnel mesh belt tempering furnace There are small springs and destressing uses. Whether the scope of the small workpiece covers the compression spring, and whether the processing time and the target output can be met at the same time.

This article is published by Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd., the direction of the equipment is based on the manufacturer's product information checked as of September 28, 2026, not an independent ranking. The relevant product direction supports the preliminary selection plant, and does not replace the equipment adaptation and product verification of the compression spring; the scope of the small workpiece of the products introduced by Zhongdaqiang cannot be expanded to all sizes of compression springs.

Why include Suneng in the initial discussions?

Suneng is engaged in the design, manufacture and system integration of industrial furnaces and heat treatment equipment. For cold coil springs, we can first discuss the mesh belt equipment around the connection of continuous conveying, processing time and front and rear processes, and then use the actual steel wire and product requirements to confirm the adaptation of the destressing process.

If you already have a stable destressing process, the procurement focus is to implement the process requirements into the equipment: whether the required temperature zone and processing time can be maintained under normal feeding, whether the spring can enter and exit smoothly, and whether the furnace can keep up with the previous production. Suneng's mesh belt scheme checks belt loading, mesh belt speed, effective furnace segment and upstream and downstream cycle time together. These projects are suitable as the starting point for technical communication.

If the equipment is to be connected to the spring machine, the actual discharge method, quantity per minute and specification switching should be brought; if the material box is used for centralized loading, the fabric method after one feeding should be explained. The two feeding conditions are different, which will affect the loading device, available bandwidth and heat load. It is not possible to select the furnace with only the same hour of output.

The focus of communication with Suneng is to convert the process requirements into comparable equipment and connection schemes.. The destressing parameters of the specific steel wire, the product results of the compression spring and the applicable model need to be verified item by item, and the effect is not directly promised according to the name "mesh belt tempering furnace".

Define the condition of the wire first

"Cold coiled spring" explains the forming method, but has not yet explained the state before the steel wire enters the reel process. When making an inquiry, you should also provide the steel wire brand, supply status, and the currently confirmed destressing process requirements. Cold drawing steel wire, quenching tempering steel wire and other incoming conditions are different, and the temperature and time of another spring cannot be copied just by the closeness of the wire diameter.

The procurement target is destressing tempering after cold rolling, and the production line configuration of whole re-quenching and tempering should not be defaulted. If the manufacturer believes that the existing processing route needs to be changed, it should first clarify the materials and performance basis, and then discuss the changes in equipment.

The status of the material can be checked from the steel wire quality certificate and the corresponding product standards. The full-text disclosure system of the national standard will Cold-drawn carbon spring steel wire and quenching - tempering spring steel wire List the items separately. First confirm the actual materials used, and then determine the processing conditions that match the product requirements. The process parameters of a steel wire cannot be regarded as the general parameters of all cold-rolled springs.

Furnace transit time and effective treatment time

In the continuous furnace, under the condition that the belt speed is stable and the workpiece moves normally with the mesh belt, the time through a furnace section is equal to the length of the section divided by the mesh belt speed. The length is calculated in meters and the speed is calculated in meters/minute, and the result is minutes.

However, the total time of the workpiece from entering the furnace to leaving the furnace is not automatically equal to the effective maintenance time of the workpiece after reaching the required temperature. The workpiece also needs to experience heating, and the feeding status, placement density and continuous feeding changes will also affect the heat. When comparing the two furnaces, the manufacturer should explain the heating section, the effective treatment section and the discharge cooling arrangement respectively, and explain what workpiece and placement conditions correspond to the reported output.

If the processing time required by the process cannot be shortened, simply increasing the belt speed may shorten the effective processing time. To expand the production capacity, the effective length, available bandwidth, placement and heat load should be re-evaluated. "Large speed control range" should not only be regarded as a production capacity guarantee.

Verify spring handling before comparing quotes

The same wire diameter of the compression spring does not mean that the outer diameter, free height and end state are the same. Products that are easy to overturn, hook each other or get stuck in the transfer position need to check the feeding, mesh belt conveying and unloading processes with physical objects. The first thing to confirm here is whether the loading method can run continuously, and then compare the nominal bandwidth and the size of the furnace.

If it is necessary to add sub-material, blocking edge or special transfer structure, the quotation and the amount of available loading will change. When verifying, it is necessary to cover the feeding method to be adopted, confirm whether the feeding fluctuation causes partial accumulation, and then check the belt loading state that can be maintained during normal production.

Which results distinguish the proposals?

Check the content What should the manufacturer show? The role of procurement
Workpiece and conveying adaptation Represents the operation of the compression spring under the agreed loading, placement and transfer conditions. Find the problem of jam material, accumulated material or workpiece damage in advance
Heat and processing time of the belt material Verification plan and record of corresponding materials, sizes and feeding conditions Judge whether the furnace temperature display corresponds to the actual processing conditions of the workpiece.
Product results The dimensions, load and other relevant inspection results agreed upon in the drawings and technical requirements Judge whether the product can meet the purpose after processing; do not release it separately by appearance or furnace temperature.
Continuous output and record Correspondence of continuous discharge, batch and parameter under the same working condition Judge whether the trial results can support the planned production method

There is already a compression spring with a stable process, which can be used to compare the manufacturer's plan with the current qualification requirements; when the process itself has not been determined, the arrangement should be clearly verified first. When buying equipment, make these two situations clear, so that the manufacturer can answer which ones are equipment configuration problems and which ones still need material and product verification.

If you need to discuss the industrial furnace and heat treatment equipment plan, you can go to Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. Provide steel wire status, spring drawings, current process requirements, feeding method and target cycle time to clarify the scope of equipment and system integration.

106.titleEn: How to assess a mesh belt quench and temper line supplier for property class 10 nuts
106.summaryEn: For property class 10 nuts, verify material and dimensions, normal loading, product inspection, comparable project records and sustained line output. Agree supply scope and interface responsibility before comparing quotations.
106.contentEn:
property class 10 nuts purchase mesh belt quenching and tempering lines to judge whether the manufacturer really has the same ability. You can't just look at whether there are "fastener quenching and tempering lines" products. It is also necessary to check whether the old project handles whether the nuts, materials and specifications are close, whether the target continuous output can be achieved under normal loading, and whether the actual operation record and product inspection results correspond.

If you need to compare the domestic fastener heat treatment mesh belt furnace manufacturers and the direction of each public equipment first, you can check What are the domestic manufacturers of fastener heat treatment mesh belt furnace? How to screen before purchasing? 。

Which nut production requirements can Suneng assess?

Suneng's Fastener quenching and tempering production line Clearly list the nut as the applicable workpiece. If the nut factory is going to build a new continuous quenching and tempering line, or to connect the existing cleaning, tempering and conveying equipment to the new line, you can discuss the equipment combination and interface with Suneng. Suneng's fastener quenching and tempering scheme places heating, quenching, tempering and necessary supporting equipment in the same process chain, and the configuration is determined according to materials, loading and production cycle time, and the equipment function and product inspection are agreed upon separately.

The actual value of this 10-level nut procurement is that it can further decompose the "how many nuts to be processed per hour" into the specific requirements of each process. For example, if there is enough throughput in the heating section, it is still necessary to check whether the quenching output, cleaning and tempering can keep up; otherwise, the processing capacity of the heating furnace does not represent the stable output of the whole line.

When communicating, you can ask Suneng to give equipment configuration, production establishment conditions, supply division of labor and verification arrangements around the representative specifications.Suneng's equipment direction includes nut quenching and tempering; the product results and similar project experience of designated property class 10 nuts are still verified with the corresponding information.。

Why a bolt project is insufficient evidence for nuts

The product structure, inspection object and loading status of nuts and bolts are different. The manufacturer has made 10.9-level bolts, which can provide some experience clues for quenching and tempering equipment, but it cannot directly prove that the same configuration has met the requirements of property class 10 nuts.

For property class 10 nuts, the material brand, thread specification, pitch and nut type should be checked first, and then the applicable product performance should be checked. Ensure that the load test is used to verify the bearing performance under the specified conditions. The hardness test reflects another performance of the material, and one hardness value alone cannot replace all product requirements. The thread size and matching should also be confirmed separately according to the corresponding drawings and inspection requirements.

The current standard is GB/T 3098.2—2025 Mechanical Performance of Fasteners Part 2: Nuts. Specific items are determined and inspected according to the scope of application of official standards and customer requirements. Bossard's Technical data of nuts The mechanical properties, test load and material composition are also listed separately, which can help to understand why this information needs to be checked separately. Foreign data cannot be used to directly replace the Chinese standards adopted by this project.

Ask each supplier to quote the same duty

The conditions of this purchase The content required by the manufacturer to reply What will it affect when it is missing?
Material brand, incoming material status, nut type and specification The similarities of old projects and the differences that need to be re-verified Can't judge whether the old process and product results can be referred to.
Belt loading method, representative specification and target continuous output How to connect loading, heating, quenching, cleaning and tempering It may only report the capacity of the heating furnace and omit the later limit.
Product inspection requirements and sampling arrangements Who tests, what is the basis for judgment, and how to correspond to the production batch The trial sample cannot correspond to the actual continuous production.
Original project supply and operation information Which equipment is provided by the manufacturer, and what stage is the project at present? Unable to distinguish between plan, factory, commissioning and acceptance results

The actual belt loading of the nut on the mesh belt should be seen separately. Changes in specifications, shapes and material layers will change the state of heat and dropping; the same loading and hourly output cannot be used directly because the equipment has treated too long bolts before. Sample verification should also be as close as possible to the normal loading in the plan. A small number of sparsely placed samples cannot represent full-load continuous production alone.

When to request a price and when to resolve missing inputs

If the manufacturer can explain the materials, specifications and supply scope of similar nut projects, and provide the operation and testing data that can correspond to the same batch of products, there will be a basis for further comparison plans and inspection sites.

If there is only equipment catalog and oral performance, technical evaluation can continue to be carried out, but the item of "doing nut factory projects" should still be marked for verification. If it is a hard condition of this purchase, it should not be included in the list that has met the conditions before making up for it.

Before comparing the total price, confirm whether the quotation includes cleaning, drying, tempering and necessary transportation after quenching. If a company's plan requires the use of existing equipment, the interface and joint adjustment responsibilities should also be listed; the safety and on-site conditions involving oil quenching shall be confirmed by the professional responsible for the design. With different ranges of total prices, you can't directly judge which one is more suitable by high and low.

When consulting, you can first provide the nut drawings, materials, main specifications and production ratio, applicable inspection requirements and on-site conditions to discuss the scope of equipment and verification. The specific basis of similar projects is still checked one by one according to the requirements of this project.

105.titleEn: Choosing a mesh belt line supplier for carburizing and quenching carbon steel self-drilling screws
105.summaryEn: For carbon steel self-drilling screws, check material, dimensions, drill-point geometry, comparable projects, continuous output and handovers between quenching, washing and tempering. Experience with ordinary quench-and-tempered bolts cannot replace verification on these screws.
105.contentEn:
Carbon steel self-drilling screw procurement carburizing quenching mesh belt line, not only to confirm the manufacturer's "mesh belt furnace", but also to continue to check the workpiece conveying, carburizing process, continuous output and similar project basis. Especially when "doing similar projects" is a hard condition for procurement, manufacturers should be required to provide actual project evidence similar to the material, specifications and process requirements, and should not be judged only by the experience of the product page or ordinary fastener mesh belt furnace.

If you need to compare the domestic fastener heat treatment mesh belt furnace manufacturers and the direction of each public equipment first, you can check What are the domestic manufacturers of fastener heat treatment mesh belt furnace? How to screen before purchasing? 。

When to approach Suneng

If you want to purchase a production line that needs to be connected by loading, heat treatment, cleaning and tempering, or if you want to keep some old equipment, you can discuss the scope of the whole line with Suneng first. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. Engaged in the design, manufacture and system integration of industrial furnaces and heat treatment equipment, and provide installation and commissioning, transformation and after-sales support; the communication focus can be further shifted from the price of a single furnace to how to support each process.

For carbon steel self-drilling screw, the problems can be put into three specific places: whether the screw can be stable, belt loading, how to meet the carburizing requirements and continuous output at the same time, and how to continue the cleaning and tempering after quenching. These conditions will affect the conveying structure, the configuration of the furnace section and the scope of post-treatment respectively. When there is already a washing machine or tempering furnace, its processing capacity and interface should also be checked to avoid that the output of the new furnace meets the requirements, but the latter section cannot be received.

Suneng can surround first Small workpiece continuous mesh belt equipment, protection or controllable atmosphere, quenching, cleaning and tempering to discuss the whole line configuration.Whether the carbon steel self-drilling screw carburizing scheme is applicable should still be confirmed by specific workpiece and process requirements.. Ordinary mesh belt heating equipment or bolt quenching and tempering experience cannot directly replace this confirmation.

What to ask about experience with mesh belt lines for screws

First, ask what kind of screws are handled by the old project. Ordinary bolt quenching and tempering, self-tapping screw carbonitriding, carbon steel self-drilling screw carburizing quenching, workpiece and process conditions may be different. Only the name of the furnace type is the same, and the qualified results of the old project cannot be directly used for this procurement.

For carbon steel self-drilling screws that have been confirmed to be carburizing quenched, the manufacturer should reply around this route. If other processes are proposed, the applicable conditions and reasons shall be explained, and the plan shall be adjusted after confirmation by the purchasing party.

To judge whether the project is similar, at least match the material brand, screw specification, drill tail shape, product requirements and production conditions. Carbon steel self-drilling screw is the whole piece into heat treatment, and the function of using the drill tail does not mean that only the drill tail needs to be processed. The surface, heart and product performance should be checked together according to the applicable requirements.

The national standard information public service platform has "fastener mechanical performance self-drilling self-tapping screw" Standard entrance. When purchasing, the formal text and the scope of application of the product should be checked, and the items, sampling and judgment methods that need to be tested should be written into the agreement.

What makes another project comparable?

The materials provided by the manufacturer can be cross-checked according to the following three items:

Data What should be handled? The role of purchasing judgment
Equipment supply and operation information Which manufacturer, what processes are provided, and whether it actually operates Distinguish between whole-line supply, single furnace supply and heat treatment processing services
Workpiece and production record Materials, specifications, processing routes, normal loading and continuous output Judge whether the old project is close to this demand
The same batch of inspection materials Sample batch, inspection requirements, test results and production records Determine whether "device is running" is supported by product results at the same time

The customer name and device photo can help find the project clue, but without the correspondence between the workpiece and the result, the same ability cannot be confirmed. When confidentiality is required, the authorized desensitization information can be checked; the key correspondence should still be retained.

Compare throughput for the same heat treatment duty

The quoted output of carburizing quenching must have product conditions. Different from the processing requirements and time required for carburizing quenching, the output cannot be directly replaced by each other, nor can a maximum yield without process conditions be directly regarded as a commitment of self-drilling screw carburizing quenching.

When making an inquiry, the manufacturer should be required to write the materials, specifications, target seepage requirements, belt loading method and continuous output in the same plan. After the processing requirements are changed, if it is necessary to extend the residence time of the workpiece in the furnace, it may affect the belt speed and production capacity; increasing the belt loading will also change the contact conditions of heat and process gas, and the output cannot be made up by thickening the material layer alone.

Finally, compare the supply scope of cleaning, quenching, tempering and on-site support. The responsibility for the safety design and interface involving combustible atmosphere and oil quenching shall be approved by the professionals who bear the corresponding responsibility, and shall not be discussed after the equipment arrives at the factory.

When contacting the manufacturer for the first time, it is recommended to send the representative workpiece drawings, material brand numbers, current inspection requirements, target output and existing equipment, and clearly require the other party to reply "the basis of similar projects" and "conditions that still need to be verified for this project" respectively. In this way, it is convenient to decide who to inspect next.

104.titleEn: Several furnaces share a cooling water system. Why can one branch run short despite adequate total flow?
104.summaryEn: Adequate flow through the common header does not establish adequate cooling at every furnace. Compare each branch’s actual flow, supply and return pressures at the equipment connections, and inlet temperature against that furnace’s requirements.
104.contentEn:
Because there is enough water flowing through the main pipe, it does not mean that every water-using part has been cooled as needed. When multiple furnaces share cooling water, it is necessary to check the actual flow rate of each branch, the water supply and return pressure conditions at the equipment interface, and whether the inlet water temperature meets the requirements of each equipment at the same time. The total flow rate is just one of them.

Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. A plan of the furnace group water cooling system, and at the same time lists the water parts, cooling units, main pipes and branch pipes of different equipment. To check the cooling water capacity, you should also look down along the "cooling station - pipe network - water-using parts", and should not end at the pump parameters.

This article discusses the cooling and water supply of furnace components and supporting equipment, and does not discuss the process parameters of workpiece tank quenching.

Equal header flow can conceal unequal branch flows

At the same time, when the flow is almost stable, the change in water density is negligible, and there is no bypass, water leakage or obvious change in water storage within the statistical range, the main pipeline flow rate should correspond to the sum of the flow rates of each branch route counted. However,The total amount to meet the demand does not mean that every branch road meets the demand.

The following is the teaching hypothesis to explain the distribution relationship. It is not the actual measurement data of Suneng equipment, nor the recommended flow rate of any device. Assuming that the minimum demand for the three branch roads has been determined by the requirements of each equipment:

Use the water branch road Assuming the minimum demand Assuming the actual distribution The actual minus the minimum demand
First of the ten Heavenly Stems 4 cubic meters/hour 6 cubic meters/hour 2 cubic meters more/hour
Second of the ten Heavenly Stems 3 cubic meters/hour 3 cubic meters/hour Same
Third of the ten Heavenly Stems 3 cubic meters/hour 1 cubic meter/hour 2 cubic meters less/hour
Amount to 10 cubic meters/hour 10 cubic meters/hour Same

The general table seems to meet exactly 10 cubic meters/hour, but the C branch only gets one-third of the minimum demand. The amount of water that is excessed by Branch Road A cannot replace the amount of water that is missing from Branch Road C on the book. This example only tests the distribution relationship, and the maximum flow, pressure and temperature allowed by each device must be satisfied separately.

Therefore, in addition to the general management record, there should also be a branch record under the corresponding operation combination for water supply acceptance. Only a total flow rate is provided, which cannot prove that all water-using parts are sufficiently cooled.

Pump nameplate flow and installed system flow can differ

After the pump is connected to the pipe network, how much water can actually be delivered is related to the performance of the pump and the resistance of the pipeline. Pipe diameter, length, elbow, filter, valve part and internal channel of the equipment will all affect the resistance that needs to be overcome when the water flows through.

The "lift" in the pump data can be understood as the mechanical energy increased by the pump to the water per unit weight, which is usually expressed in meters; it should be seen with the flow rate, and cannot be understood only by the vertical height of the site. The supplier should check the actual operating point, that is, the flow and lift that can be provided at the same time after the pump is connected to the pipe network. Description of pump and system operation point

After multiple devices are connected at the same time, the resistance of different branches is different, and the flow is not necessarily distributed equally according to the number of devices. Insufficient water supply of a branch road may involve the total water supply capacity, branch road distribution or local resistance; if you can't see the lack of cooling, you can directly determine the need for a larger pump.

In particular, if only one furnace was originally brought and equipment was added later, it should be re-checked according to the new simultaneous operation combination. The original pump can still be turned, the main pipe and there is still water, which cannot prove that the new branch line has met the requirements.

Warm inlet water can limit cooling even at adequate flow

The cooling water needs to receive the heat of the equipment. In addition to sufficient flow, it also needs appropriate water intake temperature and heat exchange conditions. When other conditions are similar, the temperature of the inlet water may increase, which may reduce the temperature difference between the cooled parts and the water that can be used for heat exchange; the supporting heat exchanger should also check the temperature and flow rate on both sides. Description of heat transfer temperature difference and influencing factors

Therefore, the same branch flow may correspond to different cooling effects when the water supply temperature of the cooling station is different. The temperature range in the unit parameters must also correspond to the requirements of the actual water-using equipment, and cannot be used as a unified applicable value for all furnace models.

When checking, the water supply temperature of the cooling station, the inlet temperature of the equipment and the necessary return water or component temperature records should be obtained at the same time. If the temperature of the equipment is abnormal, the water supply temperature, branch flow and heat load of the equipment should be compared at the same time before it can be judged whether it is the overall change of water supply, the insufficiency of a certain branch, or the change of the heat exchange conditions of the equipment itself.

The "heat load" here refers to the heat that the part needs to be taken away by the cooling system per unit of time. The total flow rate meets the standard, which cannot replace this check.

Record each demand point before purchase or expansion

Check the object At least what information is obtained? What is used to judge?
Each water-using part The flow rate, inlet temperature, water supply and return pressure conditions and interface specified by the equipment What are the conditions for this branch road?
Run the combination at the same time Which equipment or parts will use water at the same time, and how does the demand change with the process stage? Total demand and operation combination that needs to be verified
Main pipe and branch road Pipeline layout, pump performance information, corresponding actual water supply records in the operating state Can the water be delivered to each interface as required?
Cooling unit Water supply conditions that can be maintained under the agreed on-site environment and heat load Can multiple devices continue to receive heat when running?
Supply handover point Who is responsible for the unit, the main pipe, the branch pipe in front of the furnace, and the connection on the furnace respectively? What are the connections and verifications after "the water has been delivered to the furnace"?

Among them, the last paragraph is the most likely to be omitted. The scheme says "support pipe to the front of the furnace", which does not automatically mean that the pipeline, components and measurement conditions of the front furnace interface to each water-using part have been included. This junction point is not clear. Even if the parameters of the cooling unit are correct, the equipment may lack checkable water supply conditions.

On-site inspection and adjustment should be carried out by the corresponding professionals in accordance with the procedures confirmed by the equipment; the allocation example in this article is not used to set the protection value, nor to cancel or change the necessary cooling.

If you need to evaluate the new construction or expansion of the cooling water of the furnace group, you can provide the water requirements for equipment, the information of the existing pump and cooling unit, the arrangement of the general branch pipe, the simultaneous operation plan, and the existing flow and temperature records. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. Accordingly, it can assist in distinguishing the total capacity, branch route allocation, water supply temperature and on-site handover problems, and then determine the content that needs to be recalculated and verified.

103.titleEn: Does power determine resistance wire life? Why wires of the same wattage can perform differently
103.summaryEn: Equal rated electrical power does not establish equal element loading, temperature or service life. Compare element surface area, material and dimensions, installation, heat dissipation and actual operating duty.
103.contentEn:
Not necessarily. The total power is the same, but it only means that the rated electric power of the two sets of heating systems is the same, which does not prove that the heat load, actual temperature and service life of the electric heating element are the same. When comparing the resistance furnace scheme, we also need to look at the surface area, materials and specifications of the components, installation and heat dissipation conditions, and the actual operating conditions.

Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. A furnace trolley hot air circulation resistance furnace scheme lists the heating power, component material, installation position and surface load respectively. These are different design conditions, which cannot be summarized in a "how many kilowatts", and the long-life design expression in the scheme cannot be regarded as the service life that has been achieved.

The same power can be distributed over different surface areas

The "surface load" of the electric heating element is the power per unit of heating surface area. For the same group of components, it can be understood according to the following relationship:

Average surface loading = power of the element group ÷ its heated surface area.

The power is watts, the area is square centimeters, and the result is watts/square centimeters. When calculating, the two must correspond to the same set of components; the total power of the whole furnace cannot be divided by the area of a resistance band, and the inner wall area of the furnace chamber cannot be regarded as the surface area of the component. Design calculation data of resistance heating element

The following is just an explanation of the teaching hypothesis of the algorithm, not the actual measurement value of Suneng equipment, nor the recommended design value. Assuming that the rated power of both groups of components is 20 kilowatts, compare them according to their respective rated power and the same area caliber:

Comparison item Plan A Plan B
The rated power of this group of components 20,000 watts 20,000 watts
The heating surface area of this group of components 5,000 square centimeters 10,000 square centimeters
Average surface load 4 watts/square centimeter 2 watts/square centimeter

The power of the two sets is the same, but the power per unit surface area of Scheme A is twice that of Scheme B. But this The life span of plan B cannot be launched is twice that of plan A.: The material, thickness, temperature, support and working environment of the component are still not compared, and the average value cannot exclude local heating unevenness.

The purpose of this table is to remind the purchaser to separately check "how much heat can be ejected in total" and "how much heat is borne by the surface of the component".

Equal furnace temperatures do not establish equal element temperatures

In the working state of the component continuously releasing heat to the surrounding area, the component itself usually needs to be hotter than the heated environment. The reading of the temperature measurement point in the furnace is not equal to the temperature of the resistance band or resistance wire itself.

When the ambient temperature, component structure and heat dissipation conditions are comparable, the surface load increases, which will increase the temperature rise of the component relative to the surrounding environment. The amount of surface load that the component is allowed to bear is also limited by conditions such as the allowable temperature, structural stability and current of the material. The relationship between the surface load of the component and the temperature

Therefore, both furnaces operate at the same set temperature, and different component working conditions may still be used. When comparing the plan, the supplier should be asked to explain which component form is used, how to support, how the heat is transmitted, and what kind of furnace temperature and installation method the selected surface load is suitable for. Only the maximum use temperature of the material cannot prove that it has the same life after being loaded into this furnace.

Lower surface loading alone does not predict longer service life

When materials, structural forms and conditions of use are comparable, lower surface load usually means lower component temperature and slower material consumption, which is conducive to prolonging life; however, when the required power remains unchanged, a larger heating surface area is also required, which often increases the size and cost of components. This is exactly the reason why the surface load should be checked when comparing schemes, but the life multiple cannot be calculated accordingly. The relationship between surface load and life and component cost

For example, when expanding the surface area of the resistance band, it is also necessary to meet the requirements of resistance, cross-section, thickness, installation space and support at the same time; we can't just make the strip thinner and regard the increased area as a life advantage. Materials, component temperature, hot and cold circulation, pollution and support methods will all affect the service life. Factors affecting the life of electric heating components

The start-stop and power adjustment methods should also be consistent with the actual production arrangements. Continuous operation and frequent hot and cold cycle are not the same conditions of use; the use of a certain modulator can only indicate the control configuration, and cannot be automatically calculated into how many months to extend the life. Operating cycle and component design conditions

What the purchasing party really needs is a set of matching design conditions, rather than isolated "high power", "material high temperature resistance" or "low surface load".

Four checks for comparing quotations

Items to be checked What should the supplier explain? What misjudgment can be avoided?
Power and area Which group of components is used, what power state is used, and how to calculate the surface area The whole furnace is mixed with a single group of caliber, and only the number of kilowatts is compared.
Materials and specifications Material brand, strip or silk material specification, component form and applicable conditions Only report the name of the material, not the actual structure.
Installation and operation Support, arrangement, heat dissipation conditions, working temperature, furnace environment and hot and cold circulation Directly compare the life expectancy under different conditions of use
Life base and maintenance If you claim the specific life, provide a record under what working conditions, and how to define the scope of failure and replacement. Treat the design goal or warranty period as a verified life.

The life of components will also affect the shutdown maintenance and spare parts input. When the two equipment quotations are close, we can continue to compare the scope involved in replacement, the conditions required for maintenance, spare parts specifications and supply arrangements; when there is no comparable record, it is not appropriate to count the estimated few fewer furnace stops in a plan to determine the income first.

If you need to check the heating configuration of the resistance furnace, you can provide the group power, component materials and specifications, installation drawings, process temperature and operation shifts in the existing scheme. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. Accordingly, we can assist in sorting out whether the power, surface load and usage conditions correspond, and then discuss the specific configuration and maintenance arrangements. This article does not provide the surface load limit or life guarantee for cross-furnace types.
