102.titleEn: When does annealing soak time start? Why furnace temperature alone is insufficient for a coil
102.summaryEn: Use the timing basis in the process specification. Where soaking starts at material temperature, check the agreed representative workpiece measurement. Where a loaded furnace programme has been validated, confirm the load remains within its range before changing the hold.
102.contentEn:
Let's look at the timing basis stipulated by the process first. If the workpiece is required to keep warm within the specified temperature range, the calculation cannot be started just because the furnace temperature display reaches the set value; it should be confirmed that the agreed representative material temperature measurement point meets the conditions. If the current process adopts the furnace temperature procedure that has been verified with material, it should be checked whether the loading of this batch is still within the scope of verification. It is not allowed to add another period of material temperature to wait, and it should not be terminated in advance at will.

For coil annealing in pit furnace, Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. is recommended to record "when the furnace temperature arrives", "when the material temperature meets the conditions" and "when does the heat preservation start timing" separately. Only by reading these three times clearly can we judge whether the soaking is sufficient, instead of just looking at the countdown on the screen.

Distinguish furnace temperature, material temperature and the soak clock

The furnace temperature thermocouple mainly reflects the temperature of its installation location and is used to control the heating in the furnace. The material temperature thermocouple reflects the temperature of the corresponding position of the workpiece according to the measurement scheme. The accurate display of the sensor does not mean that it measures the temperature inside all coils.

The external coil receives heat first, and the internal heating is also affected by the coil shape, stacking, gap, contact state and heat transfer path. Therefore, it is not contradictory that the furnace temperature has stabilized and the material temperature is still rising. Forced circulation can improve the heat exchange between the gas and the workpiece, but it cannot be determined that the inside of the coil has been synchronized with the furnace temperature.

Record or function What can you answer? You can't launch anything directly.
Furnace temperature curve Does the temperature control point follow the setting procedure? All workpieces have reached the same temperature inside.
Material temperature curve What kind of temperature process has the corresponding measurement point gone through? The measured point represents the slowest heating position of the whole batch without verification.
Heat preservation timing When are the conditions of the design met and how long does it last? As long as the countdown is over, the performance of the whole batch will be qualified.

The large number of test points does not mean that the representativeness has been established. The position of the coil center, close to the bottom of the furnace or away from the main air flow can be a candidate for point verification; which part is the slowest should be determined by the temperature measurement results under the representative loading, and it cannot be pre-determined that "the positive center must be the coldest".

After changing the roll diameter, single roll weight, furnace loading position or stacking method, whether the original measuring point and timing conditions are still applicable should also be checked together. Only increasing the total soak time may not explain or eliminate the differences between different positions.

Trace one batch on a single timeline

The following is a pure teaching hypothesis, which is used to illustrate the timing caliber, not the actual annealing system. Assume a confirmed process requirement: after the two verified and representative material temperature measurement points enter the specified temperature range, keep warm for 90 minutes continuously; after the two measuring points enter, they remain within the range, the measurement is valid, and other process conditions continue to be met.

Incident Assuming the time of occurrence
The furnace temperature reaches the set value. 09:00
Material temperature measurement point A enters the specified range 09:25
Material temperature measurement point B enters the specified range 09:50
The two material temperature measurement points meet the timing conditions of this case at the same time. 09:50
The 90-minute soaking specified in this case is completed. 11:20

If the timing starts from 09:00 by mistake, the countdown will end at 10:30. However, the test point B was only experienced within the specified range from 09:50 to 10:30. 40 minutes, did not meet the 90 minutes required in this case.

Under the premise that all agreed test points continue to meet the conditions and there is no measurement failure or process interruption after entering the range, this example can be written as:

Soak start = the time at which the last agreed measurement point enters the specified temperature range.

Soak completion time = soak start + the hold duration specified in the process.

These two relationships are only applicable to the above conditions. We can't just take the moment when each measuring point reaches the temperature for the first time, and ignore whether the test point that reaches the temperature first has left the range later; nor can a number of sporadic temperature-reach time be added together as a continuous soaking completion.

If the process adopts a verified furnace temperature program, it may already include the time required for the workpiece to follow the temperature. At this time, it should be implemented according to the original program and its loading scope, and the waiting time of this case can no longer be mechanically superimposed. The timing and product disposal after temperature deviation, power failure or measurement failure shall be determined according to the specific process documents. There is no unified make-up rule in this article.

Which measurements can be recorded, and which can start the timer?

The material temperature thermocouple and temperature recorder are written in the procurement configuration, which can only indicate that there are corresponding measurement and recording functions, and cannot automatically prove that the material temperature will participate in the program timing.

The supplier needs to explain: which route or which channel temperature is triggered by the timing, whether it is manual confirmation or program judgment; after starting the timing, it only alarms when the temperature deviates, or will the timing be changed; whether these events can be found in the same batch record.

The functional definitions of different controllers are not the same. For example, Nabertherm's controller instructions describe different logics such as entering heat preservation after temperature, multiple selected temperature areas entering heat preservation after temperature, and suspending timing when deviating from the temperature range. It only says that the actual configuration must be checked when purchasing, and the function of a certain controller cannot be regarded as the default capability of all annealing furnaces. Original factory instructions

The acceptance record should be able to correspond to the batch, furnace loading diagram, measurement point position, furnace temperature and material temperature curve, timing start and stop and abnormal events. In this way, we can answer "why does this furnace start timing from this moment", instead of leaving only a seemingly stable temperature curve after the fact.

If there is a difference in the softness and hardness of the same furnace coil at the site, the temperature record can help check the heating process, but the reason cannot be determined by a curve alone. The condition of the material and the front channel, the cooling process and the product inspection may also affect the result; the correct soaking timing does not mean that the whole annealing process or product performance is automatically qualified.

During the consultation, you can provide the material brand, wire specifications, coil inner and outer diameter and weight, furnace loading photos, current process sheet, and the same batch of furnace temperature and material temperature records. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. can assist in sorting out whether the temperature measurement position, timing conditions and equipment configuration correspond. The specific temperature system and product judgment are determined by the process requirements.

101.titleEn: Does heating half the length of a variable-volume trolley furnace halve gas consumption?
101.summaryEn: Shortening a gas-fired furnace with a movable rear wall changes some losses, but the workpieces and fixtures still need to reach process temperature. Doors, hearth, flue losses and auxiliaries do not all scale with chamber length. Compare gas per batch and per tonne of accepted product for the same duty.
101.contentEn:
The change in heated length alone cannot establish the percentage of gas saved. For the gas bogie hearth furnace that adopts a mobile back furnace wall and can change the length of the heating chamber, shortening the heat zone can reduce the heat and heat loss of part of the furnace body; however, the same batch of workpiece and materials should still reach the same process temperature, and the door wall, furnace bottom, smoke exhaust and auxiliary equipment will not be reduced in length year-on-year. How much can be saved? The gas consumption of the whole batch and the gas consumption of unit qualified products under the same production task should be compared.

When buying variable capacity bogie hearth furnace, Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. is recommended to make it clear first: how many short workpieces appear, how many are packed in each batch, whether the process curve is the same, and how to measure the two operation modes of long and short respectively. Only by putting these conditions together can the value of the variable capacity function be calculated.

Which heat loads change when the hot zone is shortened?

The function of the variable capacity structure is to match the boundary of the heating chamber with the loading needs. What is discussed here is the equipment that forms a shorter heating chamber by moving the rear furnace wall; only a few burners at the rear are disabled, and the furnace is still open, which cannot be directly regarded as having the same capacitance effect.

The heat provided by the fuel will enter the workpiece, material tools and furnace body, and will also leave the system with smoke exhaust, surface heat dissipation, opening, etc. The industrial process heating data of the U.S. Department of Energy lists these directions separately, and specifically explains that the heat lost after the furnace trolley comes out of the furnace needs to be made up in the next heating. This shows that energy saving should be analyzed according to the direction of heat, not just the volume of the furnace chamber. References

The direction of heat How to change after shortening the heating chamber What should be grasped when comparing?
Workpiece absorbs heat In the same batch of materials, weight and starting and ending heat conditions, the required heat basically does not change with the length of the furnace. The two modes must complete the same process tasks.
The material absorbs heat In the same material, loading and starting and final heating states, it will not be automatically halved. At the same time, record the weight of the material, not only the net weight of the product.
Heat storage in the furnace body and the bottom of the furnace The actual range of heat may decrease when it is reduced; adjacent structures may still be heated by heat transfer. According to the actual heat boundary, the disabled area cannot be regarded as completely heat-absorbing.
Heat taken away by heat dissipation, air leakage and smoke exhaust It is jointly affected by the heating area, sealing, combustion conditions and duration. It needs to correspond to the thermal balance or measurement results of the short furnace mode.

The shorter the workpiece and the less the workpiece are two different comparisons. The short workpiece of the same weight is concentrated in the shorter heat area, which is suitable for comparing the changes brought about by the change of volume itself. If the furnace length is shortened and the loading is also halved, less gas in a furnace does not prove that each ton of products is more gas-efficient.

After moving, the furnace wall should also be sealed with the corresponding heating area, furnace door and furnace trolley. The new seams, the temperature distribution near the rear furnace wall, and the smoke exhaust path of the short furnace mode may affect the final energy consumption. The quotation only writes "variable capacity". Without the corresponding operating mode and verification conditions, there is still a lack of basis for the energy-saving ratio.

Calculate gas consumption per tonne before estimating savings

To compare the two modes, the material, product weight, material, process requirements and quality judgment should be fixed, and the starting heat state of the furnace should be recorded. The start-up of the cold furnace is connected to the hot furnace in continuous production, and it should not be directly put together to calculate the capacity yield.

Under the condition that the caorific value of gas is comparable, the gas volume is equivalent to the same measurement benchmark, and the statistics start and end are the same:

Gas per tonne of accepted product = metered gas consumption ÷ mass of accepted product within the same reporting boundary.

Gas savings fraction = (baseline gas per tonne − comparison gas per tonne) ÷ baseline gas per tonne.

The following is just a teaching hypothesis to explain the algorithm. It is not the actual measured value of Suneng equipment, nor is it an energy-saving commitment. Assuming that the same batch of 10-ton qualified products, the same tools and process tasks are completed in a comparable starting state of the furnace:

Comparison item Whole furnace mode Short furnace mode
Corresponding to the weight of qualified products 10 tons 10 tons
The whole batch of gas consumption, the same measurement benchmark 300 cubic meters 210 cubic meters
Gas consumption of qualified products per unit 30 cubic meters/ton 21 cubic meters/ton

According to the hypothesis, the gas savings fraction is （30－21）÷30＝30%. This 30% gas consumption data from two modes has no direct conversion relationship with "how much the heating length is shortened".

If the short furnace mode still consumes 210 cubic meters, but only completes 5 tons of qualified products, the unit gas consumption will become 210÷5=42 cubic meters/ton. It is higher than the benchmark of 30 cubic meters/ton; the gas consumption of a single batch is reduced, which cannot replace the improvement of energy consumption per unit product. This group of comparisons cannot evaluate the quality of the variable capacity structure alone, because the loading task has changed.

The contract or test record should also clearly state the scope of measurement: whether it includes heating, soaking, gas use during process cooling, and standby and rework gas consumption within the agreed range. Auxiliary electricity consumption is recorded separately; when comparing comprehensive costs, it is calculated according to the consistent energy price, and different units of gas and electricity cannot be directly added. Meeting the same process and quality requirements is the prerequisite for energy saving. You can't rely on a shorter soak or changing product judgment in exchange for low readings.

When does a variable-volume design suit production?

When the batch of workpieces and short parts with obvious differences in length are often produced, and it can be concentrated in a shorter effective hot zone, it is worth including the variable capacity scheme in the key comparison. Its value comes from repeatedly avoiding the space and structure that cannot be used temporarily by heating, rather than being cost-effective by making short parts occasionally.

If the vast majority of batches need to be used full length, there will be fewer opportunities to use the variable capacity function. If the short parts must be distributed and loaded to meet the requirements of support, heating or process, it cannot be determined that the heating chamber can be shortened just because of the short length of the single piece.

When comparing equipment investment, the estimated number of short furnace batches and the verifiable energy cost difference in each batch should be considered together with the increased maintenance and replacement time of the variable capacity institution. When there is no representative working condition data, the structure and test conditions can be compared first, and there is no need to give a fixed return period in advance.

Before purchasing, you can sort out the length distribution of commonly used workpieces, the net weight of each batch and the weight of materials, the typical process curve, the batch ratio of cold furnace and hot furnace, and the available furnace gas and electricity records. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. Accordingly, a preliminary analysis of the heating chamber gearing, loading range and energy consumption comparison conditions can be carried out.

This article discusses the energy-saving comparison, and does not provide combustion adjustment, smoke exhaust throttling or safe interlock operation methods; the operation license and protection conditions of each variable capacity mode should be determined by specific equipment design and on-site verification.

100.titleEn: Choosing a mesh belt carbonitriding line for self-tapping screws: case depth, core hardness and sustained output
100.summaryEn: For carbonitrided self-tapping screws, verify surface hardness, core hardness and case depth alongside sustained output under the same material, dimensions, loading and process conditions. Agree the definition and measurement of case depth.
100.contentEn:
It has been determined that the self-tapping screw adopts the carbonitriding process. When selecting the mesh belt line, you should first check the surface hardness, heart hardness and case depth, and then confirm whether the equipment can meet the continuous production requirements under the agreed materials, specifications, belt loading and process conditions. The heart is the inside of the part; the depth of the layer should be tested according to the definition and method confirmed by both parties. The results of the three products and the continuous output need to be established under the same working conditions to judge whether the production line is really applicable.

Carbonitriding is a process that allows carbon and nitrogen to enter the surface of the steel, and then cooperates with the subsequent heat treatment to obtain the required surface performance. It is different from the task that only requires overall quenching and tempering. It cannot be considered that the process ability is the same just because there is "mesh belt furnace" in the name of the equipment. Bodycote carbonitriding process description

Can surface hardness, core hardness and case depth be met together?

Surface hardness, heart hardness and case depth should be checked together. The surface hardness describes the ability of the outer layer to resist local pressure; the hardness of the heart reflects the internal hardening state; the case depth should indicate what method, what position and what judgment caliber should be measured. They are related to each other, but one result cannot replace the other two.

If you only require "the surface as hard as possible and the seepage layer as deep as possible", it may deviate from the requirements of the product itself. The performance of the outer layer and the inside of the screw need to be coordinated, and whether it is qualified depends on the applicable product inspection. The target scope should be clarified first, and then the manufacturer should explain how to achieve these scopes through equipment and processes.

Small specifications cannot automatically follow the layer depth requirements of large specifications. When other conditions are similar, the hardening layer of the same depth accounts for a larger proportion of smaller cross-sections, leaving different internal areas. Therefore, when a line is ready to cover multiple specifications, the workpiece verification that can represent the difference should be selected, and only the specification that is easiest to meet the standard should not be detected.

The requirements to be clearly written by the purchasing party Why does it affect the judgment of the device? The answer that the manufacturer should give
Screw material, specification and state before entering heat treatment Determine the response, pretreatment and transportation conditions of raw materials Coverage, and materials or process verification that need to be made up
Surface, heart and layer depth requirements The decision to deal with the target cannot be replaced by a single hardness. Measurement method, sampling location and corresponding process verification plan
Product performance and inspection requirements The hardness result cannot represent the actual performance alone. Arrange relevant tests and judgments according to applicable standards or technical agreements
Normal belt loading and target continuous output Decide the heat, atmosphere contact and rear load of the workpiece The belt speed, loading and whole line capacity that can be used under this working condition are based on

As of September 24, 2026, "Fastener Mechanical Properties Part 5: self-tapping screw" GB/T 3098.5-2025 has been implemented and replaced the 2016 version. The version of the procurement document should be clearly adopted, and the specific inspection items, values and methods should be determined by consulting the formal standards and combined with the scope of application of the product. Self-drilling self-tapping screw and stainless steel self-tapping screw also need to check the applicable standards separately. Official standard information

Does the output figure apply to the same workpiece and process?

The output of carbonitriding must correspond to the specific screws and processing requirements. The same mesh belt width, if the material, specification, layer depth target or belt loading thickness is changed, the processing time and loading conditions allowed may change. Answer the carbonitriding inquiry with the hourly output of ordinary quenching. Lack of process conditions and cannot be used to confirm the purchasing capacity.

Although belt loading thickening increases the mass of the workpiece on the belt surface, it will also change the heat of the workpiece and the contact conditions with the process gas in the furnace. If the original verification adopts a thinner belt loading, it cannot only increase the loading volume and continue to follow the original quality commitment; the product results should be reconfirmed, and it should be checked whether quenching, cleaning and tempering can be undertaken.

Do the atmosphere system and auxiliaries cover the complete duty?

The manufacturer's plan should also indicate whether the supply, control, monitoring and recording of the process gas required by the target product are included in the quotation.Adding a gas to an ordinary quenching furnace does not mean that it has qualified carbonitriding ability. The safety design, discharge and on-site support of the atmosphere and oil quenching involved shall be approved by the professionals who bear the corresponding responsibilities. This article does not provide gas ratio or operation settings.

After the basic transportation conditions are established, when comparing the plan, we should first look at whether the process control and product verification can be met, then see the continuous output, and finally check the total input. If the atmosphere system, pretreatment or follow-up equipment needs to be changed to meet the requirements, the investment difference cannot be explained only by the size of the furnace.

99.titleEn: Choosing a mesh belt quench and temper line supplier for property class 8.8 and 10.9 bolts
99.summaryEn: For property class 8.8 and 10.9 bolts, request evidence for comparable material, critical section, loading and sustained production. The critical section here is the dimension that affects heating, cooling and hardening, distinct from the tensile stress area used in thread calculations.
99.contentEn:
For property class 8.8 and property class 10.9 bolts, mesh belt quenching and tempering line manufacturers should check whether the manufacturers can provide technical and verification evidence that are close to the materials, key cross-section dimensions, loading and continuous production conditions of this project. I only know that the manufacturer has made a mesh belt furnace, which is not enough to judge its similar quenching and tempering ability. The key cross-sectional size here refers to the representative size that will obviously affect the internal heating, cooling and hardening response of the workpiece. It is not the stress cross-section in the thread bearing calculation.

Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. is suggested to further ask the question to the specific workpiece: "What materials, specifications and output of the bolts have been made, and what are the requirements for inspection after delivery?" property class 8.8 and property class 10.9 are fastener performance levels, and the configuration of mesh belt quenching and tempering lines cannot be determined alone.

Compare material and critical section dimensions

Compare the material and the key cross-section size first, and then compare the grade name. The quenching permeability of different materials is different, that is, the ability to obtain a certain hardening depth under a given cooling condition is different; the cross-section changes of the workpiece will also change the internal cooling process. The qualified results of small-sized bolts cannot directly cover the bolts with larger cross-sections. The relationship between the material, size and cooling conditions can be referred to Description of Bodycote quenching process 。

Comparison item What can I refer to when approaching this project? How to deal with differences
Material brand and incoming material status Applicable basis of heating, quenching and tempering schemes Recheck the material response, and you can't directly copy the original process.
Key cross-section size, as well as the rod, head and length Applicability of internal and external temperature difference, cooling and transfer methods Select representative specifications for verification
Belt loading method and continuous feeding amount Heating and cooling load in the material state Recalculate the capacity of the whole line, and you can't just compare the temperature of the empty furnace.
Grade and product acceptance requirements Which product indicators are covered by the verified results? Supplementary inspection according to the requirements of this project, not just look at one hardness value.
Scope of supply of production line What processes and joint adjustment responsibilities have the manufacturer been responsible for? List the new equipment, interfaces and responsibilities separately.

Can both bolt classes use the same line, and how are batches traced at changeover?

Whether property class 8.8 and property class 10.9 can share the same line, it is necessary to check their respective processes and replacement conditions. Even if both types of products are suitable for mesh belt processing, it is necessary to confirm the material, heating and tempering time, loading amount and cooling requirements respectively. If a certain type of product must be significantly slowed down, the manufacturer should explain the production capacity of the two types of products separately, and cannot only quote one maximum value for the whole line.

The replacement should also explain how to identify the previous batch of workpiece, how to distinguish the workpiece in transit, and how the parameter record corresponds to the batch. Only two sets of temperature settings are saved, and it cannot be said that the two types of products can be switched to production stably.

Continuous production verification should cover the loading, belt speed and post-section processing conditions agreed upon by the two types of products respectively; the verification period and sampling arrangements shall be determined by both parties in advance. If the two types of products are qualified for trial production, they should also check the correspondence between the transition material identification and record at the time of actual production change in order to judge whether the trial production results can be used for planned continuous production.

Verify comparable experience using results from the same batch

A useful similar project information should be able to establish such a correspondence:Manufacturer's supply scope → actual bolt materials and specifications → continuous production conditions → test results of the same batch of products. Photos can help you understand the layout. Running videos can show that the equipment is working at a certain moment, but these materials alone cannot prove that the product has reached the agreed level.

As of September 24, 2026, the National Standard Information Public Service Platform has listed GB/T 3098.1-2010 of "Fastener Mechanical Performance Bolts, Screws and Studs" as the current standard. For specific projects, we should first check whether the product is within its scope of application, and determine the inspection item and judgment method according to the customer's technical requirements. If the standard name cannot be written on the plan, it is considered that the equipment or product is qualified. Official standard information

In the procurement stage, the manufacturer can be required to submit a representative specification verification plan, indicating what materials and workpiece to use, what loading and production conditions to operate, who will test, and how the results correspond to the production records.If a sample meets the hardness requirements, it can only explain the result of this sample; the whole line judgment should also cover the agreed product indicators and representative continuous production conditions.

If the information of the old project is missing, the manufacturer's qualification to propose a plan is still different from "verified to have done similar projects". The purchasing party may continue to arrange technical evaluation and agreed verification, but should clearly write down the unproved ability and not regard verbal promises as historical achievements.

Manufacturers can provide product introductions and enter the preliminary communication; they can provide the actual operation and testing information of similar workpieces, so that they can continue to compare the project experience. If the information needs to be kept confidential, you can check the authorized desensitization version, but you still need to match the workpiece, equipment and results.

97.titleEn: Can a multi-station curing oven run different products at the same time?
97.summaryEn: Six stations do not necessarily provide six independent processes. Compare each product’s programme, thermal separation, circulation, exhaust, loading and shared resources. Verify the intended combination before scheduling different products together.
97.contentEn:
Six workstions are not equal to six sets of production units that can not affect each other.. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. is suggested to compare the process required by the product first, and then check the temperature program, thermal space, circulation and exhaust, loading and unloading actions and shared resources of each workstation. Only when these conditions support the product portfolio in the plan can we further recognize "can put six batches" as "can make different products in parallel".

This article discusses the multi-workstation combination and batch-by-batch curing equipment. The "workstation" here is the loading or processing position, which does not automatically represent the independent furnace chamber or the independent temperature area, nor the six processes passed in succession on a continuous line.

The concept of multi-station and public supporting relationship, non-project real shooting; the number of works and independent panels do not prove that different processes can be run at the same time.

Do the products require different processes?

If the material system, temperature and insulation requirements of several products can use the same set of verified processes, the key is to check whether different fixtures and loading are still within the allowable range, and whether the records can be traced separately.

If a batch needs to be heated, the other batch has entered heat preservation or cooling. Even if the final set temperature is similar, it belongs to a different time process. At this time, it relies more on the thermal separation, independent control and off-peak loading and unloading ability between the workstation.

Therefore, "support multiple formulas" can only indicate that there may be multiple sets of parameters in the program. It can't answer separately whether these formulas can be in different positions.Execute at the same time It cannot prove that the process of other workstations will not be affected when a certain workstation opens the door and changes the batch.

What can each station control independently?

Check the level Questions to ask the supplier What will it affect if it is not clear?
Temperature program and execution Can each workstation set, execute and record curves separately? Which workstation corresponds to the measuring and heating actuators? Multiple displays may still control the same thermal process.
The furnace room is separated from the thermal industry. Do the worksties share the hot space, send back the wind or open the mouth? How is the temperature change of the adjacent worksty transmitted? Different processes may interfere with each other, and independent settings are not equal to independent temperature performance.
Circulation and exhaust Which windways are independent and which are connected to the public system? How to allocate the capacity when different combinations run at the same time? The normal operation of a single work stable does not prove that the simultaneous operation of multiple works still meets the requirements.
Loading and unloading and fixtures Can the furnace door, furnace trolley, support and load transfer paths be used separately as planned? Will there be a queue for shared loading and unloading equipment? It can be processed in parallel in the furnace, but the batch change may wait for each other.
Public energy supply and protection scope According to what concurrent working conditions are gas supply, power supply and public facilities configured? What protection will affect multiple workstions? If the number of units is sufficient, the public capacity or the scope of joint deactivation may still limit the schedule.
Data and batch Can the workstation, product, fixtures, formula version and curve correspond? Multiple curves have been saved, but it is impossible to prove which set of processes a certain batch has gone through.

This is a procurement checklist, which is not a recognition of the independent operation ability of a device, nor does it stipulate the security interlock operation.

Identify the control boundaries and physical separation

Multiple independent temperature processes can be managed by the same main control system, as long as the measurement, execution, program and recording are correctly assigned to the corresponding objects. Conversely, even if each workstation has an independent operating panel, if they share hot spaces or wind channels that cannot meet different requirements, they cannot promise to run different processes at the same time.

A work station may also contain multiple temperature control zones; multiple work stations may also be affected by the same temperature zone. Therefore, when comparing quotations, the supplier should be asked to draw the corresponding relationship of "workstation-temperature zone-heating-wind channel-control". It is easy to overestimate the independence of the thermostat, burner or fan, and may also misunderstand the shared control as inparallel.

Can shared systems handle simultaneous demand?

Public gas supply, power supply, exhaust main pipe or load transfer equipment does not naturally exclude multi-station production. However, the selection should be based on the simultaneous operation combination allowed by the plan, not the demand of a single workstation.

For example, verifying that only one workstation is heated and the rest is idle cannot prove that multiple workstations can also reach the target curve. If the design adopts off-peak start to control the peak demand, the off-peak conditions should be constrained by scheduling, and cannot be started and calculated at any time according to all work positions in the capacity commitment.

The same goes for shared loading and unloading resources. When multiple workstations are completed at the same time, whether the workpiece is allowed to wait, whether the loading and unloading equipment can be picked up in time, and when the next batch can enter may affect the actual batch completion.

The parallel ability that can really be used for scheduling is the ability that can be achieved under the constraints of confirmed product portfolios and public resources, not a simple addition of the number of workstations.

Test the intended product combination

The supply and demand sides should choose a representative combination consistent with the planned production according to the approved verification plan, and evaluate the process records of each workstation separately:

  • Same process, simultaneous operation: Look at the performance of public energy supply and supporting systems under the demand at the same time.
  • Different processes, simultaneous operation: Within the scope allowed by the design, see whether each workstation meets its own curve and loading requirements respectively.
  • Change the batch at the wrong peak: Under the normal operating conditions allowed by the equipment, check whether the curves and records of the remaining operating positions are still in accordance with the agreement when changing the batch of a workstation.

The comparison must bind the product, material system, fixtures, loading, program version and work position. The original verification was to run synchronously with the same formula, but later it was changed to different formulas to run at different peaks. The original conclusion may not cover the new combination.

The operation, scope of protection and abnormal disposal of the equipment in the specific verification shall be carried out in accordance with the project documents; public protection or artificially creating dangerous working conditions shall not be lifted on its own in order to prove "independence".

Define the simultaneous duties before requesting a quote

It is recommended to prepare a product portfolio table first: which workstation corresponds to each product, what process is used, when the plan starts and ends, and what public resources are occupied by the replacement batch. Then ask the supplier to answer item by item which combinations can run at the same time, which must be staggered, and the impact of these restrictions on the pace of output and delivery.

If the requirement is only parallel to multiple batches of the process, there is no need to require all systems to be completely separated for the sake of the word "independent"; if it is really necessary to change batches with different curves or off-peaks, the corresponding control, thermal separation, public capacity and verification conditions should be written into the technical agreement.

The product portfolio, curing curve, workstation loading and on-site public supporting information can be sent to Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. to explain "multi-station independent operation verification". Confirm the parallel scenario in the plan first, and then compare the equipment configuration and procurement scope.

96.titleEn: A gas cylinder curing oven heats up slowly. Would a larger burner solve the problem?
96.summaryEn: On an indirectly heated curing oven, a larger burner can help only if effective heat supply is the limiting factor and the heat exchanger, circulation path and auxiliaries can carry the extra heat. Distinguish heat delivery to the oven from heat transfer to the workpiece.
96.contentEn:
For indirect equipment, only after confirming that the limitation comes from the effective heating capacity, and verifying that the heat exchanger, circulating air channel and supporting system can undertake the new heat, can the burner be increased.. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. is suggested to distinguish between "heat is not sent into the furnace" and "heat enters the furnace but is not transmitted to the workpiece as required". Both of them will show full-load slow heating, but the processing direction is different.

This article mainly focuses on the indirect gas curing furnace with heat exchanger. The combustion products of the direct heating equipment enter the working area without going through the isolated heat exchange link described in the article; the verification ideas of wind channel and loading can be used for reference, but the heat exchanger diagnosis is not applicable, and the exhaust, combustion and protection requirements must be rechecked according to the specific equipment. This article does not provide the general curing temperature or heating speed.

The appearance concept of indirect heating and curing equipment is indicated by non-project real shooting; the specific heat exchange structure, air path and configuration shall be subject to the actual equipment information.

Trace heat transfer from the burner to the workpiece

The main heat transfer path of the indirect equipment discussed in this article is:

Fuel heat dissipation → heat exchanger → circulating air → working area with gas cylinder → workpiece.

The rated capacity of the burner is not equal to the actual heating power obtained by the workpiece. The heat transfer capacity of the heat exchanger, the air-side flow, the heat dissipation of the pipe and the furnace, the heat taken away by the exhaust air, and the heat absorption of the workpiece and fixtures will all affect the final curve.

Therefore, before choosing a larger burner, you should first answer: Does the existing system continue to achieve the allowed heating output? Can the heat be transferred to the circulating air through the heat exchanger? Does the air delivery pass through the workpiece area that needs to be heated? If the problem occurs in the last two sections and only the fuel input is increased, it may still not be able to eliminate the heating lag of the workpiece.

More circulating air does not necessarily deliver more heat

The circulating wind is responsible for transporting heat and organizing airflow. The air volume and the temperature difference of the return wind should be seen together, and you can't just compare the fan nameplate.

For the same cycle branch, under the condition that the mass flow of the return wind is approximately equal and the air state can be similar to the visible heat relationship, the net heat rate of air brought into the working area can be understood in the following way:

The net heat power carried by the air ≈ air mass flow × average specific heat × (sending air temperature - return air temperature).

The air quality flow rate is kg/second, the average specific heat is kilojole/(kg·°C), and the temperature difference is °C. The result is kilowatts. The measurement position and time of the return wind must correspond; when there is obvious mixed wind, diversion or exhaust wind, the calculation range should be delimited according to the actual wind path first.

This shows that:The air volume and temperature difference together determine how much heat the air carries, but not all of these heat will become the heat absorption of the workpiece.. Part of it is also used to heat up the furnace body, fixtures and other objects, or for heat dissipation and exhaust loss. The above values cannot be written directly as the effective power of workpiece.

If the data is the volumetric air volume, it is also necessary to confirm the corresponding air temperature, pressure and measurement conditions. The nominal air volume of the fan is not equal to the actual operating air volume after connecting to the heat exchanger and air channel and completing the loading.

Compare temperature trends to locate the bottleneck

First, verify the reliability of the measurement record, and compare the bottle type, loading, fixtures, initial temperature, target curve and measurement points of the comparison batch. Then align the curve of the heat exchange section, the return air, the space in the furnace and the representative workpiece with the heating output, circulation and exhaust air states.

Observed performance What should be checked first? Impact on "whether to add power"
The heating continues to be at the allowable high output, and the air delivery, the space in the furnace and the workpiece are all lagging behind. Actual heat load, effective heating, heat exchanger capacity and heat dissipation exhaust loss It is necessary to continue to account whether the heating supply is insufficient; high output alone cannot exclude excessive losses or limited heat exchange.
The temperature on the heat source side of the heat exchange section is already high, and the heating of the air supply is still weak. Heat transfer status of heat exchanger, actual air flow rate and bypass The heat transfer bottleneck should be checked first. Increasing the burner may not be able to send more heat into the working area.
The air delivery and some space points have met the requirements, but the local gas cylinder is still obviously lagging behind. Loading cover, return wind short circuit, bottle spacing and actual wind position Prioritize the evaluation of airflow distribution and loading; blind heating may make the temperature area beyond the process allowable range first.
The empty furnace performs normally, but it slows down after being changed to some kind of loading. The total heat load, airflow resistance, fixtures and bottle type changes of this batch First, judge whether it is a new heat absorption or a local heat exchange change, which cannot only be attributed to the aging of the equipment.

The performance in the table is a diversion clue, not a separate troubleshooting conclusion. Multiple problems can exist at the same time; when there is no corresponding record, the heat exchanger or workpiece state cannot be inferred from the controller screen.

Separate additional thermal mass from restricted airflow at full load

The same furnace chamber, loaded with more or heavier gas cylinders and fixtures, usually requires more heating heat in the similar temperature zone. At the same time, the denser arrangement may also change the airflow resistance, so that the hot air is biased towards the position where it is easy to pass, and the heat exchange obtained by some workpieces is reduced.

The two effects have different characteristics: the overall curve slows down together, which needs to be combined with load and heating accounting; a few locations repeatedly lag, and the airflow and loading of these positions should be focused on checking. In the end, it is still necessary to record cross-judgment with comparable working conditions.

The rotation of the gas cylinder cannot replace the circulation wind channel check. The rotation changes the experience of wind and heat in the perimeter of the bottle, but it cannot automatically eliminate the obstruction or short circuit between the workpiece; whether to adopt and how to set it should be subject to the requirements of the product and resin process.

Exhaust requirements still apply during heat-up

In-furnace circulating wind, combustion flue gas discharge and process exhaust gas discharge undertake different tasks. The large number of cycles does not mean that the process exhaust gas has been discharged as required; although reducing the exhaust may reduce the heat taken away, it also changes the process and safety conditions.

Reducing the necessary exhaust cannot be regarded as a heating optimization method.. Heating accounting shall be based on the ventilation, waste discharge and material process conditions determined by this project. The adjustment of combustion, waste discharge or protection system shall be carried out by the corresponding professionals according to equipment information, project design and safety requirements. This article does not provide gas adjustment or safety setting methods.

Three questions for the supplier

  1. Where is the current calorie limited? Question mark Provide the curve and operation record of the corresponding working conditions, indicating whether it comes from the heat source, heat exchanger, circulating airway or loading.
  2. Why can the proposed configuration be changed to eliminate this restriction? Question mark The additional burner should indicate the subsequent heat exchange and wind path bearing capacity; the modified air channel should indicate the affected position and applicable loading, and not only promise to "heat up faster".
  3. What working conditions should be used to compare after modification? Question mark Fix the representative bottle type, fixtures, loading, initial temperature and process curve, and check the heating time, space temperature and workpiece process records respectively. The resin process requirements and product inspection shall be carried out according to the applicable documents, and the acceleration of heating does not mean that the curing result is qualified.

When communicating, you can send the bottle type and loading photos, fixtures information, target and actual curves, return wind and heating operation records, existing wind path map and waste discharge conditions to Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. to explain the "curing furnace full-load heating check". Find out the location where the heat is limited first, and then discuss adding power or changing the configuration.

95.titleEn: How many baskets do solution treatment and ageing furnaces need? Compare turnaround and batch intervals
95.summaryEn: Size the basket fleet from the full time between loading a basket and its return ready for reuse. Compare solution treatment, quenching, transfer, ageing and unloading with the batch launch interval. An empty furnace waiting for a basket and loaded baskets queuing downstream call for different actions.
95.contentEn:
The number of load baskets should be calculated according to the complete occupancy time of "a set of load basket from the beginning of loading to return to the loading level and meeting the conditions for reuse", and cannot be matched only according to the number of furnaces. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. is suggested to draw the solution treatment, quenching, load transfer, aging and unloading back basket on the same timeline first, and then compare them with the planned batch interval.If the furnace is empty but there is no available load basket, it may be that the turnover is insufficient; if the load basket is queued up with the workpiece, the downstream capacity and load transfer arrangements should be checked first.. In these two cases, the purchasing actions are different.

This article discusses the batch production of reusing load basket. Whether to follow the same load basket into aging after solution treatment should be determined according to the actual process and equipment interface; after winding, the curing process of rotating fixtures should be used, and it cannot be directly merged into the same load basket turnover pool.

The concept of load basket occupation and back basket is a non-project real shot; the quantity and arrows in the figure do not represent the actual process order, and the configuration quantity must still be calculated according to the complete occupation time.

Count the time until the basket is ready to load again

After the furnace is heated once, it does not mean that the load basket is idle. The workpiece may still be waiting for the next process, or it may not have been removed after processing; even if the empty basket has been unloaded, it may still need to be cooled, cleaned up, checked and returned according to the on-site requirements.

Therefore, the starting point of the timing should be when this load basket begins to be used by this batch, and the end point should be when it returns to the loading level and can undertake the next batch. Only count the soak time, and the occupancy of the basket outside the furnace will be omitted.

The link where the load basket is located The time to be included Occupancy that is easy to miss
Preparation for loading Place the workpiece and complete the batch basket preparation While waiting for the material, has the basket been occupied?
Solution treatment and quenching The batch is processed according to the process, and the time occupied by load transfer After quenching, wait for load transfer to aging or follow-up material
Ageing and inter-process turnover Load transfer, queuing and aging occupation when using the same load basket "Aging furnace has not started to work" is mistakenly counted as load basket idle.
Unloading and returning the basket Unloading, and applicable cooling, cleaning, inspection and return The empty basket is stopped in the unloading area, and the next batch still can't be picked up.

Solution treatment The transfer time from the end of heating to quenching is limited by the process and does not belong to the time that can be used to queue up. The transfer time needs to be included in the load basket occupation, but the occupancy does not mean that the queue is allowed; the waiting after quenching must also meet the subsequent process requirements.

These time periods should be divided according to the real timeline. Tasks that can occur at the same time cannot be added repeatedly; processes that do not occur in this loop should not be forcibly added.

Calculate the theoretical minimum, then check the batch schedule

Under the simplified condition that each batch occupies a set of load basket, the load basket can be interchanged, the complete occupation time of each batch is the same, and the batch is issued at fixed intervals:

Minimum number of circulating basket sets = ceiling(total time occupied ÷ interval between batch starts).

The same unit must be used for the complete occupation time and batch interval. "Batch interval" refers to the time difference between the two adjacent batches starting to occupy the load basket, not a certain period of soak time.

This formula gives a mathematical lower limit under stable cycle time, which does not automatically include maintenance spare baskets, special baskets of different specifications and temporary backlog. If the on-site batch intervals and processing time are different, the occupation intervals should be marked batch by batch, so as to The maximum number of load baskets occupied at the same time Check, but don't just divide it by the average time.

Worked example: two furnaces may need three basket sets

The following numbers are only used to demonstrate the algorithm, not the actual measured value of the project, nor the recommended process time. Assuming that each batch occupies a set of general load basket, the complete occupation time is 5 hours, and a batch starts every 2 hours:

Round 5 ÷ 2 up to the next whole number: 3 basket sets.

Batch Start to occupy the basket Available again Turnover judgment
The first batch The 0th hour The 5th hour The first set of baskets cannot be used for the new batch before that.
The second batch Hour 2 The 7th hour Need a second set of baskets
The third batch The 4th hour The 9th hour The first two sets have not been returned, and the third set of baskets is needed.
The fourth batch The 6th hour The 11th hour When the assumption is true, the first set of baskets that have been returned can be reused.

When there are only two sets of baskets, the third batch will encounter missing baskets in the 4th hour, even if a furnace is already empty at that time. The three sets of baskets can connect this set of ideal schedules, but whether it meets the actual production needs to check whether the furnace, quenching, load transfer and unloading can also catch the same cycle time.

How much return-time margin remains with three sets?

Under the condition that each batch uses a set of load basket, the load basket is interchangeable, the complete occupation time is the same, and it rotates according to a fixed batch interval and a fixed order:

Basket return margin = available sets in rotation × batch launch interval − total occupied time.

This example is 3 × 2 − 5 = 1 hour, giving a theoretical margin of one hour between a basket becoming ready and its next scheduled use.

The number of sets here does not include baskets to be repaired, special baskets that cannot be exchanged or spare baskets that do not participate in rotation. When the complete occupation time is exactly an integer multiple of the batch interval, it is configured according to the theoretical lower limit, and the margin is zero; any delay may affect the next batch. Whether to add a spare basket should be determined by comparing this margin with the actual delay fluctuation and maintenance demand.

This is the schedule margin of the load basket, which is not the amount required by solution treatment to quenching or other process time.

Basket shortages, downstream queues and incompatible sizes need different remedies

There is an empty space in front of the furnace, and the workpiece has been prepared, but the empty basket has not come back.: First, track which link the basket stops at. If each process and load transfer have the ability to complete the target cycle time, and the necessary occupation leads to the number of baskets in use at the same time exceeding the existing number, there is a basis for increasing the turnover baskets of the corresponding specifications.

With load basket long-term stuck in front of the ageing furnace: First check the ageing furnace time, available furnace space and release arrangement. Buying more load basket can increase the cushioning of the product, but it can't make the aging furnace process more workpieces per hour. If the average feed is longer than the downstream processing capacity, the queue will continue to grow; how long the process allows to wait should also be constrained at the same time.

There are many empty baskets, but the next batch still can't be loaded.: Check the specifications, support, interface and applicable status. The two types of load baskets that cannot be exchanged should be calculated separately. If you mix the special basket, the basket to be repaired and the currently available basket together, you will get the conclusion that "the quantity is sufficient, but the actual use is not".

Keeping the load in one basket or transferring it midway

If the same load basket is used from solution treatment to the end of aging, it will continue to be occupied by the whole process. The advantage is to reduce intermediate reloading and handover. However, this set of baskets must meet the process, support and load transfer conditions confirmed in each section at the same time.

If the process and equipment allow the replacement of the basket in the middle, the load basket in the front section may be released earlier, but the load basket in the latter section should have its own, and the replacement operation will also take up time, location and personnel or equipment.The release of the front section load basket does not mean eliminating the need for fixtures of the whole line.. When purchasing, two sets of turnover loops and new handover conditions should be compared respectively.

The above accounting does not determine the hot handling method, load basket bearing design or quenching operation. The relevant plan should still be determined according to the equipment design, process documents and on-site safety requirements.

Three sets of information for a quotation

  1. Product and load basket correspondence table: How much to install in each batch, what kind of basket to use, whether fixtures can be interchanged, and the interfaces of each segment that have been confirmed.
  2. Batch-by-batch time record: The time to start loading the basket, enter and leave each process, unload the material, and return the empty basket to the loading level; wait to write the reason.
  3. Target scheduling and resources: How long do you want to send a batch, the available time of each furnace, the load transfer and unloading arrangement, and the actual maintenance and backup needs.

When you need to account for load basket configuration, you can send these three sets of data to Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd. to explain the "load basket turnover accounting". First, check the number of occupations, specification groups and queues at the same time, and then determine whether to make up the basket, change the turnover arrangement, or adjust the downstream capacity.
